It is said that even after her greatest enemy, the Demon Fox Uzuki was defeated, the kimono continued to protect her for many, many years.

704.lore: A sword used by a girl living in the Far East who was chosen by a sealed Demon Fox to become the vessel for its soul. The sword -which was originally used to exterminate Demons- unleashes flames with a crimson tint, resembling that of the blood moon. Seeking the complete resurrection of the Demon Fox, she used the blade to overwhelm even the most skilled of shinobi. However, it is said that she eventually met her end due to the blade's ability to sharpen by draining the life force of the user.

705.lore: A girl's sword that became the vessel for a Demon Fox. Although the blade was once used by the founder of Ginzo's clan to defeat a Demon Fox, it turned into a threat for the shinobi when it fell into the hands of a girl controlled by the Demon. The sword is able to become sharper by whittling away at the user's life force. However, this power has been changed thanks to the power of the Demon Fox, and it now can also be fed by draining the souls of those it cuts. This sword, that can burn away most of anything with a single stroke, came to be called a Demonic Katana.

708.lore: The true form of Vermilia's weapon. When the soul of the legendary beast inside resonates with its holder, it can release an all-consuming, everlasting blaze. Lengthy training in the magical arts gave her a realistic but earnest perspective of its nature. This pure heart was recognized by the spirit of the staff, allowing her to draw out its maximum power.

710.lore: There were times when Veronica brought out Lizaverde's power even more than usual. However, she limited herself to only doing so in extreme situations, as making one mistake when releasing that much power could destroy everything in existence. Legend says that when Veronica was unable to contain Lizaverde after it went berserk before, even the sky was cut in half, and she continued to destroy the monsters that appeared around her until the end of her life.

712.lore: Aluze was hailed as a prodigy in martial arts. As unique as his bow was, it was just another weapon he handled effortlessly. Rumors of his peerless talent spread like wildfire, and the people feared him. Becoming more attuned with his weapon brought more strength and more isolation. Since he never seemed to care what others thought about him, he had no idea if that lonely path to superiority would ever crumble beneath him.

714.lore: After fighting with Yulibert many years, Garlan realized his partner could harness the power of nature itself. The immense vitality sleeping in the trees and the land flowed through his weapon, bestowing him with a great strength. Though it could be used purely for destruction, that thought never entered his mind. He may have been rough around the edges, but his heart was pure gold.

715.lore: The cape of Phantom Ragsherum when it was possessed by a pumpkin ghost. Donning this, he was seen around the land, wandering through the darkness of the autumn nights. The reason as to why he would perform "tricks" on those he would encounter until he was quelled with a "treat" is still unknown. No one could see his face, as it was covered by a pumpkin, but he somehow seemed joyous when he received a treat and disappeared into the night.

716.lore: Mm... Tastes like the bursting flavors of autumn (no, seriously, it will burst. Immediately)!

717.lore: Mm... Tastes like the bursting flavors of autumn (no, seriously, it will burst... eventually)!

718.lore: The costume of Berwick, Templar of the Kingdom of Granadia. Because Berwick preferred to don more formal garb, he was perplexed at his Queen's request for him to participate in the costume party--a traditional celebration in a world separate from theirs. It was then when he remembered when the previous captain of the Templars was forced to deal with diplomatic matters in the Queen's place when she fell ill. Those who saw him, confident and donned in royal garb, could only assume he was royalty, not a stand-in. Remembering how gallant his former captain looked that day, Berwick knew exactly what he would wear.

719.lore: The costume of Riviera, Templar of the Kingdom of Granadia. She had always had an interest in the garb of the students she happened to see in the kingdom, so she immediately procured her costume as soon as she heard she'd be dressing up. She apparently got it from one of her comrades, who was an alumna of an academy, who borrowed it from a current student. It is said that the kingdom's citizens were quite excited to see Riviera dressed in the uniform, despite her womanly figure, which was quite a mismatch for the uniform normally reserved for younger girls.

720.lore: The costume of Thetis, Templar of the Kingdom of Granadia. This cooking fanatic immediately got out this item after hearing that all citizens of the kingdom would be dressing up in costume to celebrate the harvest. After all, a festival always has to have a feast. Imagining his Queen and comrades eating his dishes with glee, master chef Thetis knew this was the time he had to show his true skill. However, those who saw his delicacies had one thought: if he was really going to cook, could one really call his garb a costume?

721.lore: The costume of Duke, captain of the Templars of the Kingdom of Granadia. Despite his busy schedule, Duke was forced to choose a festive outfit. Not sure of what to wear, he chose the jacket he found in the basement of the castle storehouse. According to tome about another world, it was the garb of the leader of a certain kind of combat unit. While he was always happy to see his comrade grow in the ways of the sword, Duke had a secret competitive spirit. It's said that in order to continue to become stronger as captain, he donned this jacket a sort of oath to himself to train even harder.

722.lore: The costume of Rosetta, Templar of the Kingdom of Granadia, Leone's friend from school, and master of magic. Excited for the festival, Rosetta and her best friend promised to choose each other's costumes. Seeing the outfit meant for the enchanted undead in another world and its bold design, the magic genius' cheeks turned red. It is said that while she had refused to wear it at first, unable to fight back against her friend's puppy eyes, she ended up donning the outfit and enjoying the festival to the fullest.

723.lore: The costume of Leone, queen of the Kingdom of Granadia. After finding a tome with records of an otherworldly festival in which people dressed in costume to celebrate the harvest, Leone was inspired to have her own kingdom hold the event as well. Her magic-using friend chose Leone's garb for her: an outfit that was apparently the uniform of female youth in another world, and anyone who wore this spent their days in good health being adored by the populace. Watching Leone spend the entire festival with a vigorous smile on her face, her friend prayed that those days of happiness would continue without end.

724.lore: With strenuous effort, Filia gained the power to communicate with her weapon. Its blade resembling the blue of pure water could slash through evil with a single stroke. When she stopped to rest in a certain village, a sudden storm caused the river to overflow and strand it. With the help of her sword, she cut the sediment blocking the flow and drained the water. This is one of her favorite stories, but few believe it happened.

725.lore: The famed rifle manufacturer Swagger & Vecket made these pistols in a bid for official adoption by the Isliid army. Boasting high precision along with ease of handling and maintenance, many soldiers found them to be reliable side arms. The Fenrir Corps too considers them optional gear. They lack stopping power, but imperial-style gunplay has always placed a greater emphasis on technique over sheer force.

726.lore: A full-auto handgun used by the Isliid military and developed by the rifle-maker Swagger & Vecket in hopes of escaping bankruptcy. It's not well-liked by other nations' militaries that don't use Imperial Gun Arts, but other members of the firearms industry praise the weapon for its technical finesse. The company successfully regained its financial footing, while also obtaining approval within their own industry (however, the company did not continue developing pistols, but instead went back to making rifles).

727.lore: The outfit adopted by the Imperial Information Bureau. It was designed to be both durable enough for regular duty and formal enough for official functions. As the Isliid military does not enforce uniforms, many knights choose to stow theirs during peacetime. In contrast, bureau agents find the flexible fabric highly suitable for office work, so they usually wear them except for undercover or plainclothes operations.

728.lore: The armor that was once used by God of the Heavens Marzex. His armor always shined remarkably in the numerous battles he fought. The beauty of the armor amazed the enemy and it was so hard, it could break not only the sword but also the bones of his opponent. It was one of the most iconic symbols of Marzex and the other Gods admired it, but they say no one could ever wear it.

729.lore: This is the armor of the hateful Marzex, hungry for revenge on the Humans. Once shining in gold, now it is soaked in darkness. To accomplish revenge, he even rejected mercy, prideful attribute distinctive of the Gods, and altered his armor. Not only does it protect him, but it is also able to translate his hostile feelings into magical blades and use those as his weapon. It is said that his endless hostility has produced countless blades which slaughtered Humans.

730.lore: A mysterious armor that was owned by Marzex. The name appears in the history of Gods, but the details are unknown. Some say it was his daily armor and some say it is a replica made by someone who admired him. Some even say that this armor is Marzex himself right before he was sealed by Humans... But this theory is questionable, and of course, no one can prove it. This armor encloses magical power beyond people's imagination.

731.lore: A healing staff once held by a divine tree's Spirit guardian. It was crafted from a branch of that tree and transformed after absorbing the stars' power, granting it a faint green glow. The Spirit, moved by the actions of a nature-loving girl, gave this staff to her. However, when bandits harmed her to steal it away, the Spirit swore revenge against the rest of Humanity and was overtaken by thoughts of scorn and hatred.

732.lore: Deep within the ancient sacred forest, there was a giant tree and the Spirit that protected it. The Spirit gave her jade staff to a Human girl as protection, but thieves stole it, gravely wounding her in the process. The Spirit poured out her own power to create another staff and save the girl's life. However, great sadness stained the result an umbral shade of green.

733.lore: This sword slices through the air like a meteor, shining brightly on battlefields in the dark of night. It was forged from a specifically made alloy of blessed orihalcon and meteorite, and legends say that the first wielder of this sword shattered an entire mountain with just one swing. It is also said that the sword should be kept unsheathed, as the blade never rusts and continuously hums, as if it is breathing.

734.lore: Many blessed armaments have been passed down through generations of the royal family. This sword is one of them. While the sword is difficult to handle, it responds to the power of its wielder, and ever since Princess Cestina of the Gran Verge Kingdom, nobody has ever been able to unleash its true power. The name reflects how a single swing of this revered blade is powerful enough to end any battle.

735.lore: One of the garments given to Beasts serving the Gran Verge family. This breastplate was only given to the precious few who showed true talent for close combat, making it a point of pride for those who had the chance to wear it. A crystal that improves magic energy conversion is embedded in the center, and it amplifies the wearer's offensive capability on top of providing protection.

736.lore: Bestowed upon an adventurer named Petra by the Emperor of Isliid himself as proof of conquering an active volcano. As a symbol of his courage and perseverance, only those who share those qualities can touch it. Its undying flame may indicate Petra's soul is still burning bright somewhere out in this world.

737.lore: Once belonged to the beautiful mermaid of a tranquil lake in East Famelle. Formerly Human, she agreed to change herself in order to stop the flooding. She succeeded, but the ritual made it so no other creatures could live in those waters. The fabric contains a large portion of her power, and the image reflected in its sheen resembles that lake's ultramarine shores, silent except for her singing.

738.lore: An instrument carried at all times by those known as the Forest Wanderers. Those who lose their way in the wilderness are transformed by nature's magic into beings that live among the trees. With their flutes, they play an enchanting melody to invite more to join them. A certain adventurer received this from one of those Wanderers, and its tone bestows the power of the deep woodlands.

739.lore: It is said that the best way to measure a mage's power is to examine the catalyst for their magic. This magic broom is one of the finest examples. It was considered one of Gran Verge's greatest treasures. Its handle has highly magically conductive meteorite blended into it and is significantly heavier than it looks. Due to this, only a great mage would be able to pick it up, but Liza wielded it easily with just one hand--a sign of her fearsome and incredible magical power.

740.lore: The name of the blacksmith who created this legendary magic broom has been lost to time and there are no other brooms like it. True to its name, this broom might have been created in a spark of inspiration which faded away moments after. In the Gran Verge Kingdom, the broom was cherished by Princess Liza, who became the first head of the Royal Academy of Magic, and it was passed down from her to the future heads of the Academy.

741.lore: The trees planted in the magnificent garden of the Gran Verge palace were all so special that any ordinary blade could not cut them. This magic saw was prepared for that purpose. Normally, it was activated with the weak magical power that flowed through its user's body and then used to cut the trees in the garden. However, there was one gardener with an incredible amount of magical power who proved that the magic saw could also be used as a deadly weapon.

742.lore: This is a plushie that resembles Vox, the former leader of the Leone Templars. The girl finished making the presents for the Templar members and looked at the plushies she just made. After thinking for a while, she started making another one. She gently added the last swordsman to the others. Made from her special feelings, this plushie brought a heartwarming night to the winter wonderland in Granadia.

743.lore: This is a plushie that resembles Berwick when he was a magic sorcerer. Compared to before, his personality changed quite a bit, so his comrades, especially the young sorcerer girl, were teasing him. Listening to them, he remembered the words of their former leader, who saved him and gave him a home. "People change... other people change you." With these words in his heart, he finally accepted his feelings and had a wonderful time.

744.lore: A plush toy in the likeness of Riviera, the commander of the "Vanguard Battalion." It has a bold design with a plunging neckline to match Riviera's vivacious character. The plush was a gift from the Princess and Riviera was very pleased with it, going so far as to climb a ladder so she could find a good place on the decorative tree to put it. Riviera even dressed up like her plush to celebrate, which made for an uncomfortable situation for her serious compatriots who didn't know where to look.

745.lore: This is a plushie that resembles Thetis, the warrior full of kindness. Running through the sky in just one night, the red-nosed subordinate devoted himself to the holy one. Knowing his feelings towards his comrades, the Princess made this plushie first. The receiver smiled embarassed, but seemed pretty satisfied with his handsome little new buddy.

746.lore: The plushie that resembles Duke, the brave warrior of the Templars. The strong knight who led the way of his knights on countless battlefields became a very cute red-nosed reindeer plushie, made by her hands. He did not seem so happy recieving this gift at first, but since he had it with him the whole time at the party... the Princess concluded that he really loved it.

747.lore: A plush toy in the likeness of the genius sorcerer Rosetta. The Princess had heard of a custom in another world where one would celebrate a holy night by feasting with a loved one. To show her gratitude and love for Rosetta, who was both her knight and her best friend, she sent her a plush with a cake design. On the day of the festival, Rosetta and the Princess had tea amid the laughter of the Templars and chatted the day away.

748.lore: Granadia's young princess Leone made this plush toy for Christmas, a festival from another world. After finding out that it was a festival spent with loved ones, she decided to hold a party with the Templars. She wanted to make individual presents for everyone too, so she started knitting away to make plush toys in everyone's likeness. This winter should bring happy memories for Leone and all her knights.

749.lore: A doll modeled after a certain Paw Person decorated for Christmas by Iris. Ru, hearing that Fen has a cute doll in his quarters, snuck in to check if the rumor was true and found the splitting image of himself, dressed up for the holidays. It was then said when Fen suddenly returned to his room, he started to scold the furry intruder, but after seeing him shed tears of joy, his expression softened into a slight grin and he patted him on the head.

751.lore: The divine glow of this blade clashes with its macabre design. It was once sealed away as a cursed weapon, but its horrific power dissipated over the course of centuries, reversing its nature. The skull which represented its taboo strength now shines brightly to purge evil.

752.lore: A sword with a wing-shaped hilt consumed by darkness. It was once a divine weapon, but after defeating thousands of wicked beings, it was thought to have served its purpose. However, while it lay in the lonely corner of a temple for centuries, the evil residue combined with its innate knowledge of light. This gave rise to a fearsome new power: a cursed shadow that swallows brightness.

753.lore: An assault rifle procured by the military for Forte. Because it requires advanced techniques and an enormous amount of magical power to handle, no one has been able to master it for a long time, and it has been quietly laying dormant in some country's armory. The moment she first picked it up, Forte said she may have been chosen for the gun herself, because the gun was glowing. The bullets that are fired are overflowing with extremely strong magical power, and each shot is powerful enough to crush boulders.

754.lore: Forte's beloved magic gun, forged and strengthened by using the Adelite Obsidian of Garrah. The original destructive power has been retained, while also having the capability of enhancing the user's latent talents. A magicsl barriere merges as an aura around Forte when she wields it. It is said to have a variety of effects, not only on herself, but also on the people around her. The power of this gun will allow Forte to reach even greater heights as a formidable commander.

755.lore: The military boots Forte wears as a memento of her late mother. They're made of a fabric tinged with magical powers, and are unbelievably strong for a piece of fabric equipment. They are not threatened by blades and bullets, and also have resistance to magic. Forte told her troops, "I feel like I'm protected and supported by a mysterious force while I'm wearing these boots. The powerful force that flows from these boots may be the thoughts of her dear parents.

756.lore: The twin axes wielded by the guild master Ganan since when he was a knight. He received this weapon from the Emperor himself and soon it became his symbol, back when they called him "the Blasting Berserk". He once left the battlefield, but went back to hard training to lead young adventurers in battle. Through his training, his axes gained blazing magical powers and brought out his true stregth. The magical powers reflect his indomitable fighting spirit.

757.lore: A shield-shaped object discovered inside a collapsed tunnel deep under the Mines. It senses oncoming attacks with the eye-like orb and adopts the most suitable configuration to deflect it. A thorough analysis has proved difficult, but the occasional bursts of magical energy from the central apparatus hint that it was originally the control unit of a much larger weapon.

758.lore: A shield-shaped object found deep inside the Mines, fallen from a rusted wall of metal. It transforms into the best form to repel attacks, giving unparalleled protection. The completely impervious quality is only one of its many mysteries. The limitless power and total autonomy of the dark center have led many to believe it is truly a life form.

759.lore: A king's reputation changes drastically depending on the times and how people view him. The decisions he makes always follow his reputation. In this sense, the symbolism of this great sword is significant. The blade has the ability to detect the character of its owner and can only be wielded by someone whose will and determination point them in the right direction. It only responds to those of royal blood who seek and nurture courage, wisdom and strength.

760.lore: It is only a sword. A sword made to take lives. It is no different from any other sword. You take it in your hand, brandish it, and cut with its blade. However, Prince Orvell once said that the sword became heavier the more he wielded it. While the weight of the sword cannot actually increase, there is a heaviness to it that can only be felt by those qualified for it. It asks its wielder to become worthy of its weight. That is the true value of this sword which raises kings.

761.lore: The Gran Verge Kingdom has a long history, but the first commander of the knights that comes to mind is none other than Prince Orvell. The prince would put himself at the front line of the battlefield. The mantle he wore gleamed even in the dark of night. It looked like a pair of silver wings tearing through the battlefield. A man who crossed blades with Orvell once said that the prince in his mantle was unlike anything he had seen before, and the sight was breathtakingly beautiful.

762.lore: A battle axe which chooses its master. First, the axe itself emits an intense scorching heat meaning it can only be held by those who can withstand its scorching hell. Second, its heaviness. Many a powerful man challenged this battle axe in hopes of becoming its master, but none that challenged were able to lift it. In the end, a small girl of the Dragons was chosen. The axe is not something that responds to physical strength. Rather it responds to those who wish to bring about pain and those who hold blazing emotions within.

763.lore: This axe was not sought after for the sharpness of its blades. Leaving burning wounds that cannot be dealt with through healing or even revival. The cursed lacerations left behind by its blade reveal the true essence of this axe. The scars burn so hot that a gentle breeze brings rise to screaming pain from slightest touch. Those wounded by this axe are said to have lost them themselves in a world in madness and despair. Gouging away at their very flesh, burning their hearts, and devouring them whole. Throughout the ages the axe has been feared as the manifestation of a Dragon once swallowed whole by vengeance and led by obsession.

764.lore: Shoes covered in beautiful sparkling jewels, through the jewels resonating with one another magical power is brought forth. Furthermore, the very vibration of the shoes as they tread on the ground further amplifies the magical power even greater, sending it throughout the body of the user. It has been said that those who wear the boots are supplied with a neverending well of magical power, allowing for extended battle. In fact, it has also been said that they could read the vibrations within the earth and predict the incoming activation of magic. The boots themselves were favored by supreme warriors in battle.

766.lore: The magical spear of the Demon Grad that hungers for vengeance against a certain swordsman. It absorbed Grad's desire for revenge over countless battles, gaining incredible lethality in the process. Although feared as a cursed spear that drives its wielder mad, causing them to fight until its foes are annihilated, Berserk has no such power. These rumors came from the lunatic appearance of Grad, who shouted crazed warcries as he wielded the spear on the battlefield.

767.lore: Beloved blade of Captain Ashleigh, crafted to replicate a certain prop used in a play and fine-tuned to match the wielder's thrusting swordplay. While the sword itself has no particular history, the prop it was modeled after represented a blade from Bamint legend; a connection not lost on fans. To the wielder, though, it's mostly just part of the outfit.

768.lore: Ashleigh's sword, though he used a variety of weapons during his career as a knight. He tends to choose a weapon depending on the nature of his mission, and this blade helps in his public relations work with its flashiness, readiness, and ease of handling. Even so, He would likely rotate through other options were it not for its popularity with his fans.

769.lore: Ashleigh's outer garment. The Stella Squad has no particular dress code, so anything goes. Originally a costume for a play, it was fitted for everyday use. While it may look like a sturdy garment that can handle all manner of missions, it always seems to end up requiring constant mending. Perhaps it's time for a change of wardrobe...

770.lore: Spear once belonging to the soldier who saved Salyssa, now in her care. Its similarity to other standard-issue weapons makes finding the original owner a difficult task. While it had been her intent to meet them and issue a proper thanks, her busy days in the Stella Squad have pushed that mission to the back of her mind. In the meantime, her diligent care and mending keep the old weapon up to a usable standard.

771.lore: Salyssa's trusty spear. Her painstaking efforts keep it looking surprisingly new for its age. She wants to have it ready to return to the original owner at a moment's notice, which is the only reason she has not removed the unwieldly banner. (She has also unconsciously used it to wipe the sweat from her brow, so she washes it regularly.) When her mother found it more practical as a laundry pole, she made her first attempt to leave home.

772.lore: Salyssa's cap, granted to her upon initiation into the Rose Garden knighthood. While dress codes vary and Stella Squad requires no uniform at all, Salyssa dutifully displays her issued attire, both on and off duty, perhaps owing to her penchant for the garb. "It's not like coming up with outfits to wear on my days off is too much of a bother or anything...", or so she says.

773.lore: A ring that holds the power of a two-headed inferno beast born in a volcano. Hardy enough to eat rocks, it easily destroyed the careless adventurers that came seeking strength. One mighty warrior managed to subdue it, sealing its residual power into several vessels such as this. The swirling monster blood inside generates a perpetual flame.

774.lore: A ring that holds the power of the two-headed beast that reigns over the blazing volcano. It massacred many adventurers, and the despair in their final moments turned its flames black. Hungering for more prey, it attacked the nearby towns until a devout nun threw herself into its dark fire to extinguish it with her pure soul. It returned to the volcano, but all that remained of the nun was her ring, warped by the heat.

775.lore: A transforming shield invented by a master Human crafter to fight large enemies like Gods, Demons and Dragons. What the Human race lacked in strength was made up by their remarkable creativity and altruism. Together, they devised a weapon with solid defense that could shift to offense at any moment. Any opponent who underestimated it as a simple barrier soon learned that finding a chance to attack left no time to rest.

776.lore: A shield invented by Humans that combines offense and defense. Originally carried by soldiers protecting the front lines, it was adapted for use by single units in guerilla warfare. They would force their way to the enemy's weak point then switch to their blades, felling them in one swift motion. Although a reckless strategy, this change was necessary with the Humans often being split into small groups. The fear and hatred born from each battle also imbued their weapons with a dark aura.

777.lore: A streamlined version of the shield created by Humans to fight against larger races like Gods, Demons and Dragons. It's said if the user activates the blade-release mechanism with exact timing, it'll be launched at supersonic speed. It can also cause panic in enemies when they suddenly get torn to shreds by a target presumed to be on the defense.

778.lore: A chalice with the fire dragon god's intense magic. Although many warriors have fallen to its hellish blaze, a handful managed to obtain this treasure. It only recognizes those with unshakable bravery and unbending fortitude, both necessary to withstand the heat. Their reward is a ferocious power as if hosting the dragon god's soul.

779.lore: A bejeweled chalice filled with miraculous deep-blue water. A tyrant, believing the one who controlled the source of life controlled life itself, fought to subdue the water dragon god. Enraged by his arrogance, the divine beast flooded his sprawling capital in a single night. How that was possible in a land-locked location was considered an enigma until the existence of this artifact came to light.

780.lore: A chalice with lively magical power. It is said to be a sign of a sage recognized by the guardian dragon of the World Tree. From ancient times, the guardian dragon was worshiped as a symbol of wisdom, and seekers of knowledge believed that to be recognized by the guardian dragon was a great milestone. Thus they gather under the World Tree and try to solve the ultimate question. It is said that they talked with the dragon about what they are and what the consciousness is, and they encapsulated their answers in this chalice.

781.lore: All living things are driven by desire. These were lyrics written by a famous minstrel. Though his songs were popular among the nobility and the educated, he himself died with his greatest wish unfulfilled: love. His soul, holding despair great enough to be visible on his lifeless face, was then taken into a deep violet jewel. Whoever owns it will gain power at the cost of having their being gradually taken over by darkness.

782.lore: Whoever gazes into this gem will be overwhelmed with pain and anger of every variety. It is doubtful any Human, Divine, or Demon can withstand such trauma. Regardless, it is still highly sought for its promise of great power. There was one who obtained it for the sake of revenge, but all that remained after its fulfillment was a hollow, shriveled figure.

783.lore: Throughout history, people who want authority could be found in spades. Though most would find a crown to sit awkwardly upon their hollow heads, they still dream of this in their bouts of stupidity. Should their fantasy become reality, the weight of the heavy headpiece would crush their spirit and turn them into puppets manipulated by silver tongues. Throughout history, nothing has caused as much trouble as these assertive fools.

784.lore: A grail containing Arc's power, transformed by the passage of time. It also gained the moon's magic by constantly bathing in its light as it sat on the ancient altar. The two powers joined with each other, creating a golden shine. Bestowed with both the moon's affection and the light dragon god's majesty, whoever drinks from it will be granted the strength and bravery to stand in the face of true adversity.

785.lore: A holy vessel containing Vajara's power, transformed by Oldeus' curse. Bereft of its former divinity, it now brims with the hatred of those killed by the Burier. When one with a dark heart drinks from it, that malice spills out and causes calamity. Only the user will be spared from its ill effects, as the remnants of the dark dragon god's power grant protection.

786.lore: Part of an automatic defense system discovered in an underground ruin, implanted with Eed's bioengineered cells. It boasts incredible regenerative ability but will grow around its holder if left undisturbed. Should this happen, they will be granted with both impervious defense and an overwhelming urge to battle.

787.lore: Garb worn by Leone, the young princess of Granadia. It was once her sister's until she perished in the Sea of Trees, then it was altered to fit her. She's more confident when she wears it since she feels like her sister is watching over her when she does. That's why she brings it to nearly every national event. And although she isn't aware of it, it was the remnants of her sister's power in the robe that controlled her blood rage at the Coffin Ritual.

788.lore: One of Marika's inventions. She uses it as a weapon, but how it works is a complete mystery. Despite being comprised of commonplace materials, its unique construction leaves every other engineer flummoxed. Some even believe she repurposed an artifact from another dimension.

789.lore: One of Marika's inventions. It has gone through many revisions over the years to better match her needs. Although many are impressed by her talent to make ordinary objects do extraordinary things, she only sees herself as staying true to her parents' lesson of "treat your belongings with respect".

790.lore: One of Marika's inventions. She wears it to protect her eyes from sparks and debris while metalworking. Lightweight yet sturdy, it is comfortable enough to wear for hours at a time. It also boasts night vision and magic-detecting functions, but they rapidly drain the rechargeable battery. This prevented her from adding the ability to shoot laser beams as planned.

791.lore: One of Marika's inventions. It was designed to only fit her own head, so she has no plans for mass production. Several companies have approached her with licensing offers, but the quality she demands drives up the manufacturing costs to unprofitable levels. Since most of the features she wants to add will increase its weight, she is always trying to make it lighter.

793.lore: A strange instrument-shaped weapon that can only be used with the breath of Spirits. Unlike normal weapons, it does not strike flesh and bone. Instead, it releases unique vibrations carried by sound waves to destroy internal organs. The fact they are difficult to tell from normal instruments meant there was a time where they were common assassination tools and heavily restricted as a result.

794.lore: A fearsome instrument that destroys the target's body from the inside. It's indistinguishable from a standard instrument by amateurs, but a trained expert can unleash a destructive blast with pinpoint accuracy. As it receives air directly from the wielder, it can also convey their emotions. Some have even theorized the proper frequency can affect intangible things like memories and ideas.

795.lore: A hat preferred by musicians. In wearing it, they can become one with their instrument and perform at a level impossible for ordinary people. However, both mental strain and dependence can develop, leading to addiction with overuse. This forced a ban that continues to this day despite protests from critics claiming they are being deprived of the masterful performances they once enjoyed.

796.lore: A weapon from a tribe of the eastern mountains, forged by a blind swordsmith in the sunless dark. As if infused with his passion and soul, whoever uses it will be able to sense the invisible such as what lies in the hearts of others and even the future itself. Its name was earned from anecdotes describing these sorts of feats.

797.lore: An sword from the east carried by Luahn, second prince of Gran Verge. This blade chooses its wielder. Depending on how its power is used, it can become so great a burden that it even crushes the mind. However, it becomes a truly exceptional ability once mastered. The opponent's bloodlust, their circulation, their consciousness, and more will be revealed in fine detail, allowing victory with a single slash.

798.lore: Long ago, this armor was worn by a soldier known as the Voracious Emperor. Its fearsome aura made approach impossible, so he was unscathed after every battle. Gran Verge found this story very interesting, so the country that owned it offered it as a gift. It was said that the aura was revealed to be a curse, but the kingdom's priests were able to dispel it. Even so, records showed that it remained in storage for a long time, with one of the few exceptions being when Prince Luahn sometimes wore it.

799.lore: A short sword created by the Ancients said to be able to withstand unfathomable heat. The light it reflects has the power to annihilate anything it touches. Although it vanished along with the Ancients, a few records mention it came into the possession of the first queen of Granadia. Even so, the authenticity of these records are often debated.

800.lore: A short sword masterfully crafted in a massive kiln by the Ancients. It is made of an impossible metal, said to need heat millions of times stronger than the sun to forge. The blade itself also bears three high-ranking Crests layered over each other. This lets it synergize with the powers of its owner, making it much more than a mere dagger.

801.lore: The crown belonging to Queen Juno of Granadia. Though it has seen the birth and death of stars, legends tell that its luster shall never fade. Records of her ancestor receiving it from the Ancients were eventually found, becoming proof of the Ancients being cooperative with races outside their own. To prevent theft, replicas of the crown were made while the original was hidden.

802.lore: A battle outfit worn by assassins of the Cult. The enchantment-layered fabric grants more than high defense; it senses when the wearer is preparing to strike and activates a concealing spell to let them blend into the night. This also heightens their ability to sense fear and nervousness, demanding the self-control to stop from premature action. When their mind has attained the hardness of steel, they can become darkness itself.

803.lore: The summer season has come once again, bringing with it the bright red sun in the skies and the scorching heat of the sandy beaches. Taking a break from his life as an adventurer, Rayas came to the beach in a bright red aloha shirt, ready to spend his time like an adult. Well, that was the plan anyway, until he quickly got bored of relaxing on the beach while looking up at the sky. The moment he heard the voices of his friends having fun, he instantly dashed towards the voices with a smile on his face. It looks like Rayas, still isn’t quite yet ready, to act like an adult at the beach.

804.lore: The straw hat with a sky blue ribbon on it that Iris wore with her pure white dress. Iris was so excited for the beach, she made a straight line for the ocean after getting off the carriage that Mira had prepared, with her swimsuit all ready to go, thanks to having put it on that morning before heading out. Without a thought in the world Iris paid no heed to the others who laughed about her innocent excitement. The summer memories of her running towards the waves without a care, will surely become a treasure to her.

805.lore: The Third Lady of Bamint, Mira has appeared once again to take it easy at the beach after inviting Rayas and the others to come along. Standing on the pure white beach with her exotic outfit on display, she took in the ocean breeze. Though she initially hesitated to join Rayas and the others in the water due to her outfit being something a tropical dancer would wear, she ended up running over to join them. With a smile brighter than any sun, she brings a vibrance to a midsummer trip that no one else could.

806.lore: Upon hearing that Rayas and the others would be going to the beach once again this year, Master Strategist Fen decided to escort them. Supposedly, he has to come to the realization that there is no one else besides him who is capable of taking care of them. In a completely different style than that of before, Fen has come to escort them this time in a more relaxed manner and much more relaxed clothing. As he lifted up his sunglasses while looking out over the others playing in the water, he quietly said to himself “Ah… I forgot to bring Ru with me…”

807.lore: Serah’s maid clothing is made specially for scientific experiments, with excellent protection against various forms of acids and liquids. While maintaining those capabilities, a swimsuit designed by Marika took form. The swimsuit has a near-perfect resemblance to Serah’s maid outfit and it fits her perfectly! It also has functions to improve blood-circulation and a system that helps her from getting lost by showing her where she is at all times. Serah likes the swimsuit so much that she sometimes even wears it while doing experiments.

808.lore: After Rayas invited Marika to a beach vacation, she quickly set to work on a new kind of water gun. She used her Scatter series as the base but installed a dry heater to expand air for propulsion. This lets it fire a forceful stream with nearly no charge time. It also has a distillation mode to remove salt from sea water.

809.lore: Footwear that contains Ifrit's power. They once belonged to a God whose determination to master the art of combat led him to form a pact with the avatar of flame itself. The wearer will obtain both its scorching might as well as the God's aggressive soul, eager to know the thrill of battle once more.

810.lore: Noel's military jacket. The lightweight yet sturdy fabric not only shields against everything from intense sunlight to frigid air, glancing blades and bullets will leave nary a mark. Essential to his duties in the Zero Guard in a practical sense, the fact he received it directly from the Emperor of Isliid after his induction gives it sentimental value as well.

811.lore: A jacket worn by Noel, knight of the Zero Guard, fitted to his measurements and perfect to the last detail. Its design is fancy but not garish, allowing him to discreetly protect the emperor as well as carry out his less exciting duties. The tailor, surprised by how stunning it looked on him, is expecting much more business from Noel in the future.

812.lore: A pair of blades used by Noel, knight of the Zero Guard. They can be wielded as separate weapons to deal with multiple enemies or as a single double-edged sword to break the defenses of a powerful foe. However, this versatility takes a lot of training and refined judgment to master. Anyone besides Noel might find the blades difficult to use.

813.lore: Noel's boots, made to be comfortable and sturdy enough to wear on long missions. The Zero Guard's outfitters make all their accoutrements by hand, a lengthy and laborious process. This applies to the shoes as well which are molded to each soldier's unique fit and gait. However, that effort grants them sure footing on even the roughest paths.

814.lore: A set of blades owned by Noel. The hardened tips and sharpened temper lines allow him to use a variety of techniques. They do not bend at all despite being crafted of ordinary steel, revealing the blacksmith's superb talent. The reason for their asymmetrical design was to allow for greater versatility, necessary in his unpredictable line of work..

817.lore: It was summer, when the royal children longed for freedom in body and spirit. Running along the white coastline and diving into the blue waters helped relieve the stress of their daily duties. Cestina returned to her favorite beach in her favorite swimsuit, and this time with Luahn. All of the siblings together at last had the makings of the best summer ever. Though she wanted to plan something special, she also thought it just as productive to jump right in.

818.lore: Liza waited for her younger siblings by the castle gate early in the morning. It wasn't because she was looking forward to visiting the beach; she was simply doing her duty as the oldest. In truth, she found the whole idea of sunburn-risking leisure to be illogical. That was why instead of packing her swimsuit, she wore it beneath her clothes. It was more sensible than needing to change into later, of course -- certainly not a sign of anticipation.

819.lore: The beach was a training ground. Running along the sand built endurance and stability. Swimming improved breathing and focus. As the next king, Orvell always needed to better himself. He didn't visit just to sample Ces' shave ice, or feast on Luahn's cooking, or watch Liza's dazzling firework displays. Those were reserved for special occasions, such as today.

820.lore: During his family's visit to the summer island, Luahn hunted. He set traps on animal trails, fished along the shores, and felled birds with stones. He also gathered wild plants, mushrooms, nuts, sea salt, and fruit for their oils and juices. What were once pure survival skills were now employed to prepare a sunset barbeque fit for royalty. Watching his siblings joyfully stuff their mouths also put a slight smile on his face, as well as Chloe's.

821.lore: Chloe couldn't decide what swimsuit to wear. Since Luahn only responded with indifferent mutterings, she decided to ask the fashion-conscious Cestina. Immediately, the princess brought her to the tailor to spend a whole day trying on a hundred different designs. Dazed and confused when she made her choice, it wasn't until later that she took another look at the daring ensemble and realized her mistake.

822.lore: Of course I can swim. I simply wear this as a precaution, not because I'm afraid of the water. It is my duty to rescue the royal children should one start to drown, and it wouldn't do if I needed rescuing myself. Therefore, I must take every possible measure. Moreover, the thought of what might lurk in the depths is terrifyi-- No, never mind. The point being is I need your help too, Virago.

823.lore: The enchanted outfit of the Blue-eyed Black Fox of La Riiz, Melia. Its mana-absorbent threads are woven into magic circles. Any mage can technically use them, but a thorough understanding of the mystical arts is necessary to even activate the effects. Melia is able to take full advantage of every facet along with the revealing design, giving the impression it was tailor-made for her.

824.lore: The outfit that holds the power of Ugetsu, a feared fox spirit from a far eastern land. The graceful yet ominous design embroidered into the cloth resembles her flames that nearly brought an entire country to ruin. Wearing it will cause one to see hallucinations of a burning city, and only by withstanding that grim sight will they know the robe's true power.

825.lore: The outfit of Ugetsu, an infamous fox spirit from the far east. Her blood has been woven into the fabric, granting it her hexed flames. Whoever wears it will also be exposed to those fires of hatred, turning their very soul to ash. At that time, the spirit of Ugetsu will claim their body as a new vessel, letting her continue to spread disaster.

827.lore: Unique paint that Raine uses in battle. As they are a key element of her personalized fighting style, she regularly checks to ensure they are full. She also takes great care not to mix them with her regular paints as the results can be disastrous. Though she has avoided using them in her artwork, she has brought non-combat pigments into more than one confrontation.

830.lore: Just as Alulu improved her magical technique, she also refined her wand-making skills. This third version still uses the basics she learned from the magic school, but she added several fine details to make something truly unique. Although it earned high praise from her teacher, she doesn't feel like it's at the same level as her father's, so she is hard at work on the next revision.

832.lore: A dress belonging to Juno, the first queen of Granadia. It was said she wore it at every major ceremony. Though made of thick, sturdy fabric, it was as light as a feather. This meant the skirt's hem swayed with each step, earning her many comparisons to a black lily in the breeze. It was also a superior magic catalyst that transformed to match her needs in combat. This outfit always gave support to the mighty ruler when she needed it most.

833.lore: A shiny brooch awarded to Juno from her supporters to commemorate Granadia's founding. Painstakingly crafted from a special alloy with techniques advanced for the era, it granted a number of benefits such as magic amplification. The great joy she felt in receiving this gift renewed her conviction to become a queen worthy of such warmhearted people.

834.lore: A curious iron ball in the shape of a cat's head that seems to guide itself toward the enemy when thrown. Besides the cute and cuddly design, it leaves a distinct pawprint after impact. On flesh, that mark lasts for at least a week, so criminals who value their dignity find the humiliation to be punishment enough.

835.lore: This morning star is one of the Black Cat Tails treasured by the head cleric of Reigrad. The Seven Tails are unique items that can be controlled with magic. A wielder with both high magic affinity and a pure heart can also hear the Seven Tails' thoughts, but the tone of the voice changes according to the listener. Their words are sometimes strict and sometimes gentle, but they always give guidance down the path of righteousness.

836.lore: Headgear that amplifies intellect and concentration. A gentle warmth stimulates blood flow in the cranium, both activating brain cells and relieving stress. Although it sets up the perfect conditions for inspiration to strike, it also makes the wearer crave sweets. Careful use must be exercised for the waistline's sake.

837.lore: Cestina pondered what to wear for the costume party. As royalty, it would have been improper to wear anything too outrageous, but her sister warned against wasting a rare opportunity to show her inner aspirations. In her youth, she adored the white vestments of the healers, compassionately bringing relief to the suffering. Normally they were the only ones allowed to wear them, but they made an exception for one night.

838.lore: When Angeles first received the invitation to Liza's costume party, she didn't want to go. Only after Victoire suggested it would be the perfect chance to get revenge did she pull out her traditional party outfit. Incidentally, they both threatened Eagle to receive his vote for best costume, so he was not seen in the capital on the day of the event.

839.lore: As someone who rarely appeared in public, the thought of doing so in costume was enough to make his face turn bright red. Even so, he couldn't refuse Chloe, who wore a rare smile as her needle worked the fabric. The compromise was he be allowed to bring his sword in case a rambunctious reveler lost control. That mismatch between his scant outfit and his stately weapon earned adoration from some of the Humans.

840.lore: "I shall be number one." The city was abuzz with word that whoever was voted to have the best costume at the upcoming party would receive a prize from the royal family. She believed winning would take those fools down a peg and place revenge in her grasp. Climbing to the top of the castle, she declared victory in a bold performance that sang her praises. However, when it came time to actually reveal her attraction, she resorted to a forbidden tactic: relying upon the charm of a cute kitty.

841.lore: While Liza was systematically organizing the otherworld data in the tower, their custom of costume parties caught her interest. By letting attendees dress however they wanted, everyone could have fun regardless of status. She enthusiastically took initiative and made her own costume to spread the word. The one she chose was the uniform of educated women in the outside world symbolizing knowledge and maturity.

842.lore: Orvell's clothes always spoke of the unbroken tradition and dignity of generations, so he was somewhat resistant to wear a costume. This was until his older sister said the festival's tradition was rooted in the homecoming of fishermen and their hauls, who looked forward to the outfits of the royal family. Convinced, he steeled his nerves and shed his regal finery to meet the public's expectations. And that he did, the nautical costume revealing his sculpted physique to all.

843.lore: Modeled after the pumpkin-headed monster that roams around threatening tricks if it does not receive treats. One merchant saw a comical charm in his top-heavy appearance and fashioned these dolls. Since he appears only at harvest time, he has already become a symbol of the season, and he will undoubtedly appear during Reigrad's festival this year too.

845.lore: Weapons used by Tami-nyan, a Beast girl who fought to protect the people during the Ancient War. The gemstones, acknowledging her will to build a peaceful world, granted her the power to create blasts of cold air able to instantly freeze a river. Along with her heart of justice, they let her clear the path to a bright future for many.

847.lore: The root of a divine tree warped beyond recognition by the ravages of war. Hatred tainted its soothing power, and it continues to ooze a poisonous sap even after being removed from the trunk. Anyone who touches it will slowly feel their heart become strangled by the vines of malice.

848.lore: The dark red remains of the guardian spirit of a sanctuary. The tree's hatred could only be soothed by the image of the destroyed forest's restoration. This root is the embodiment of that persisting vision's power. Whoever holds it will be able to glimpse its dream of an endless woodland expanse.

849.lore: A tome of advanced magic theory, mainly covering how to abbreviate incantations while keeping their effectiveness. The text is written in enchanted ink, letting it to not only provide knowledge but act as a potent catalyst for those shortened chants. Its author is the one who devised that groundbreaking technique.

850.lore: The tome has a will of its own which allows it to discern the nature of its holder. It becomes more attuned the more it is used, increasing its efficiency as a catalyst. This means it does not value prodigious talent or purity of heart nearly as much as tireless experimentation and insatiable curiosity.

851.lore: A fancy coat rumored to have belonged to the earl of a distant land who died heirless. It captivated the normally unfashionable Hart the moment he saw it displayed among the wares of a traveling peddler, and he scrounged up his meager savings to make the purchase. One of his few material treasures, he is rarely seen leaving his home without it.

852.lore: Nier's cherished whip, crafted from the remains of vile creatures found in the depths of the underworld. It does little direct damage, but she has coated it in a special poison that numbs in seconds and kills in hours without treatment. Though she insists she only uses it to capture her victims, her sadistic expression as she watches them plead for their lives says otherwise.

854.lore: A doll fashioned after Princess Cestina of Gran Verge for their Christmas celebration. Her servant, the dexterous Radak, created it after much trial and error despite what its incredible craftsmanship might suggest. As a doll enthusiast, his candlelight toil moved her so much that she baked a variety of seasonal treats to encourage him.

855.lore: A doll fashioned after Princess Liza of Gran Verge for their Christmas celebration. Radak made it according to Liza's unreasonable specifications, taking her statement of "Gods are in the details" literally. Its utter perfection -- from the choice of materials to the precise measurements -- was said to have elicited a rare shout of wonder from her lips.

856.lore: A doll fashioned after Prince Orvell of Gran Verge for their Christmas celebration. Orvell gave Radak no specific details about its creation, leaving everything to his own judgment. This unbounded freedom was bewildering at first, but he managed to complete a fantastic product rivaling the work of any craftsman.

857.lore: A doll fashioned after Prince Luahn of Gran Verge for their Christmas celebration. Luahn, aware he had seldom interacted with Radak, its creator, thought to invite him to the dinner table and deepen their bond. This also let Radak observe Luahn's unique features to recreate in the doll, including a rare but nonetheless genuine smile.

858.lore: Angelas, Victoire, and Eagle were also invited to Gran Verge's Christmas celebration. Of the three, Radak chose Eagle as the model for a special doll after learning he donated much of his earnings to a needy orphanage. However, the shield-bearing warrior accepted this commemorative gift without a word.

859.lore: A festive version of the popular Bakoo doll, created by Radak. It served as a base for the dolls modeled after the royal children. The originals were removed from store shelves after the calamity until Liza vouched for their innocence. Glittering decorations also gave their classic look an irresistible charm, reigniting everyone's love for them.

860.lore: A blessed instrument said to be used in the celebration of an otherworld holiday called Christmas. Once a year, people young and old gather around an illuminated tree, enjoy a grand feast, and exchange presents until morning. This event has also started gaining popularity in Raktehelm as the festive decor becomes more elaborate with each passing occasion.

864.lore: Long ago, a sage crafted this unique hourglass after receiving a divine revelation. As the granulated moonlight falls, it releases a portion of its immense magic, on occasion transforming whatever is in the vicinity. Whoever can master that risk will obtain a power rivaling the Gods.

865.lore: Ancient sorcery created this hourglass from fathomless darkness. As the grains fall, they absorb light's innate magic. This accumulated power bends the fabric of space-time, disguising its own constant expansion. None can even begin to predict what would happen if it were ever released.

866.lore: As the name implies, one must make a vow to this shield to receive its magical protection. Many do so before thinking about the consequences, and they later come to curse their haste. It is often said getting rid of this shield is much harder than obtaining it.

867.lore: The ties between shield and holder deepen with time, unlocking its true power. The metal becomes feather-light and harder than diamond. However, when the holder passes their prime, so too does the shield's protection weaken. Indeed, their vow only ends in mutual death. Many such tales exist, all of them stirring and cruel in equal measure.

868.lore: One of the few holy weapons made by Human hand. Along with its legendary craftsmanship, the gems embedded into the blade granted it power over time. Mastery bestows phenomenal speed, enough to cut through a bullet in flight twice. It was once stored in the armory of an imperial nobleman but has since gone missing. The fact that its popularity gave rise to numerous imitations makes finding the genuine article even more difficult.

869.lore: A helmet created from the remains of the evil Villakurz. Defensive sorcery redirects its dark might to disrupt almost all outside magical influence, yet the intricate web of spells still cannot completely block the mental erosion it causes. Therefore, a strong mind is required to wear this without lasting drawbacks.

870.lore: A helmet fashioned from remains steeped in the dark power of Villakurz. The high concentration of magic generates a warp in the space-time fabric to provide matchless defense. However, that warp also drains the wearer's mana, and its grim appearance is trauma-inducing. Anyone who desires this needs bottomless energy reserves and a fearless heart.

872.lore: Serah's favorite maid dress. The fabric repels everything from water to acid, making it suitable for light housework or dangerous experiments. Professor Arcana has praised how her choice to wear an all-purpose outfit reflects a "battle-ready" mindset. However, his tendency to ask her to make dinner while she's busy has come close to actually starting battles.

874.lore: A shield that contains the soul of a legendary water dragon that ruled the ocean. Its heart frozen by interminable solitude survived even after its body wasted away. That frigid spirit then solidified the moisture in the air to build sturdy crystal layers. The supernatural nature of this shield grants phenomenal defense, bringing to mind how its original owner's heart also shut out the entire world.

875.lore: A bracelet found in the depths of a misty ruin. Though seeming to be made of organic materials at first glance, a closer look reveals the dense network of machinery covering the surface. Its jade aura perpetually whirls about the track to create a strange force field. A phrase in the old language meaning "Cycle of Fate" is written on the link that closes the loop, suggesting it can alter the laws of causality.

876.lore: Legendary accessories mentioned in the Bible of the Flaming Knight. Long ago, the leader of the flame spirits agreed to grant an incomprehensible strength to their wearer upon command. The Dara Desert that occupies most of Gramenia is a symbol of that power's immensity, as records imply its creation resulted from one such incident.

877.lore: Sophie of the Firecat's Den restaurant inherited this hunting pan from her father. Thick and tough, it can serve as both a shield and a bludgeon. She wields cookware such as this in battle to show her pride as a chef, hunting not for sport but to nourish herself and others.

879.lore: Rits was given this ancestral weapon to defeat her dream rivals, and she still holds tightly to it even after waking from that dream. She felt a close connection to it from the first time she slid the bow across the strings, as if she had played it all her life. Her technique melds perfectly with her devotion to music, giving rise to numerous masterpieces.

881.lore: A coat made with a special lightweight textile to keep up with Batiste on his secret missions. It looks flimsier than armor, but reinforced threads and hidden plates shield him from slashing swords and piercing arrows. He has been saved on more than a few occasions thanks to this reliable article.

882.lore: A jet-black jacket Batiste has worn for years. Crafted with a fusion of magic and technology, it allows him to completely hide his presence at night, making it essential for the rare assassination mission. People in other nations fear him as "the Black Flash", but he believes that name's very existence is proof of his inexperience as a covert operative.

883.lore: Batiste's preferred weapon, given to him personally by the emperor when he was inducted into the Zero Guard. Their coloring lets them melt into the shadows. The shape gives the impression they are meant to be thrown from a distance, but one of his physical prowess and reflexes can use them in close combat. The deadly glint as he turns them in his hand before striking is the origin of his nickname: "The Black Flash".

884.lore: Though these appear to be standard walking boots at first glance, their lightness and flexibility are anything but, providing perfect support for Batiste's nimble movements. The special material is impervious to the average blade and gives extra lift for superhuman jumps.

885.lore: Knives specially made to suit the top-secret nature of many of the Zero Guard's missions. Designed for functionality and lightness, their keen edges can pierce even thick armor. Months of trial and error by the empire's top blacksmith produced these metallic masterpieces.

886.lore: Gilliam's prized warmallet used to make the finest arms. With considerable girth and tough alloy construction, it obliterates the hardest, hottest foes. A novice solider will see a simple weighted weapon, but a true master will take full advantage of its all-purpose nature. The clear, sharp clang of red-hot steel echoing throughout Reigrad is proof of the pride he puts into his work.

888.lore: The bow used by Priscilla, also known as the Inferno Archer. The beautiful blaze that bursts from each arrowhead shines brighter the more emotional she is. At maximum intensity, their heat even melts steel. The skill and accuracy she demonstrated in subduing the double-headed monster that appeared in the castle garnered much praise from even the Imperial Knights.

889.lore: The bow belonging to Priscilla, an archer from Simon's Hill. The fire spirit that resides in it responds to her feelings, granting each arrow only as much strength as is necessary. She hunted monsters and protected villages on her journey to the capital, and damage was kept to a minimum in each conflict. That could be credited to both her own talent and the spirit's fine tuning.

890.lore: The footgear of Priscilla, famous archer from Simon's Hill. Their mysterious flames create heat shimmers that perplex foes, leading to embarrassing, critical mistakes on their part. She stands on the front lines because of her strong desire to protect, but it is her quick judgment and flexibility which saves her from serious harm.

891.lore: The gun carried by legendary sniper Simon. Based on Swagger & Vecket and Goldoa Corp.'s masterpiece, he tasked the best gunsmith in the empire to further refine its capabilities. It not only takes the original high-precision design concept to the next level, projectile velocity was also greatly increased. This ballistic marvel is the very embodiment of his "one shot, one kill" creed.

892.lore: The gun carried by expert sniper Simon. A joint product between rifle-maker Swagger & Vecket and magic artificers Goldoa Corp., it was designed with a focus on accuracy. It uses standard ammunition guided by runes inscribed into the firing hammer and gun barrel. Manageable recoil also meets his high standards, letting him eliminate targets with the fewest possible shots.

893.lore: The black overcoat worn by Simon, hero of Simon's Hill. The emperor personally bestowed it upon him in recognition of his outstanding service to the empire. In addition to its edgeproof and bulletproof qualities, the magical cloth dampens perception in others. He melts into the darkness at night, rendering him practically invisible to the untrained eye.

896.lore: The sharp claws of a monster born from forbidden experiments. A group of Humans, obeying only their greed for knowledge, sacrificed many lives to create a new form of being. However, the outcome was far removed from their ideal, and they abandoned the hideous thing along with the facility deep underground. When it finally escaped from its metal prison, many punctures were seen in its flesh, evidence of vain attempts to take its own life.

897.lore: The katana used by famed "Divine Swallow Fencer", Airi. She believes it to be her fated companion as it brings out the most of her thrusting techniques. Its tip, sharpened to the limit with Valkian whetstones, fascinates swordsmiths of all skill levels. The reason she always keeps it in prime condition is not because of its historic value, but her own pride as a soldier.

898.lore: One of Valkia's most significant weapons. It passed between many different collectors as a high-valued antique, but few have used it in actual combat. The narrow tip makes it ideal for thrusting, but the sharp edge gives it slashing attacks that are just as strong. Airi especially likes the pattern on its sheath, so she cleans it every night before turning in.

899.lore: Airi's military footwear. Despite their plain appearance, they are the sum product of Valkia's advanced magic, which was necessary to endure her nimble movements. The manner in which the vast resource investment to create them was readily approved speaks volumes about her importance to the nation's forces.

900.lore: The helmet of Palamicia, a God warrior who left her mark on history as a lifelong adherent to the sword. She was dubbed the Silent Divine for her technique as beautiful as a clear lake surface. This headgear stores her purified energy, granting the wearer miraculous powers such as instantaneously healing fatal wounds. Though remarkable, it represents a mere fraction of her strength.

901.lore: The helmet of Palamicia, a God warrior who left her mark on history as a lifelong adherent to the sword. She was dubbed the Silent Divine for her technique as beautiful as a clear lake surface. This headgear stores her purified energy, granting the wearer miraculous powers such as instantaneously healing fatal wounds. Though remarkable, it represents a mere fraction of her strength.

902.lore: There once lived a Bamint-born actress of matchless talent. Sharon idolizes her so much that she went through great lengths to obtain her trademark stole. Whether she is basking in applause or laboring behind the scenes, it can always been seen glimmering around her shoulders. People eventually started believing it is the sign of a top star.

905.lore: The gun Hart uses in his rebellion against the empire. It was once the flagship product of Goldoa Corp., popular all throughout Isliid for its ease of use and high accuracy. The solid barrel, where most of its limited weight is located, ensures precision. Its report is somewhat higher pitched compared to other guns due to the metal's properties, giving it the nickname of "the Singing Gun".

906.lore: A pistol used by the magic gunner Hart. Goldoa Corp. drew upon their experience working with rifle makers Swagger & Vecket to independently manufacture this model. Designed for self-defense, it is much smaller and lighter than the Jaeger. It maintains its high accuracy even in burst-fire mode, added to make up for its reduced stopping power. Women in particular found it an attractive choice.

907.lore: The battle outfit Hart wears as he fights the empire. He received it from Azvan as his 11th Affiliate. Not only resistant to blades and bullets, it is remarkably effective against spells. The lightweight fabric bears not a single seam or tear, giving the impression it was created by magic or some long-forgotten technology.

910.lore: Armor created from the plumage of Freydal, said to leave its shrine and scatter icy feathers over Raktehelm once every few decades. Less than a hundred of them currently exist, making it impossible to craft new coats. The feathers' unbreakable, unmelting properties extend to the wearer's mind as well.

911.lore: Armor made from the freezing magic of Freydal. On rare occasions, it leaves its nest in the otherworldly shrine and sheds indestructible icicle-like feathers across Raktehelm. This particular suit was enchanted to strengthen the Freydal's blessing, repelling any menace or disaster.

912.lore: Vambraces made from the ancient tree limbs that cover Elpneumas. They seek a suitable owner who can contain the mystical power that gushes forth like a bottomless fountain. Any unable to do so will become overwhelmed and perish.

913.lore: Vambraces made with the ancient tree limbs that once wrapped around Elpneumas. A Demon artisan, inspired by how the energy flowing from the wood took on the dragon's power, created these after much experimentation. However, both the positive and negative effects reach beyond their wearer, so whoever joins them must also be prepared.

914.lore: The battle dress of Cestina, second princess of Gran Verge. Unwilling to compromise comfort or protection, she asked her older sister for help in creating a loom that weaves magic directly into the fabric. This is how it can grant extra protection in response to her will while sporting a breezy, sleeveless design.

915.lore: A shining lance containing the power of a legendary beast. It releases enough heat to instantly vaporize any foe, but only those with immense mana reserves can satisfy its energy consumption. Folklore reveals the existence of a counterpart in the form of a dark shield, and whoever obtains both will wield the complete power of that beast.

916.lore: A black shield containing the power of a legendary beast. It creates a dimensional force field that makes it impossible to physically touch the holder. Once kept in a small village as a ritual item, it vanished and the village was destroyed as a result of some unexplained phenomenon. Folklore reveals the existence of a counterpart in the form of a shining lance, and whoever obtains both will wield the complete power of that beast.

917.lore: A pair of swimming trunks with a unique newsprint pattern. Vultee told Hart he needed a more enticing look if he wanted to make some real summer memories. On the other hand, the women in his life praised how it matched his well-read nature. This caused Hart to smile bashfully...and Vultee to seethe ineffectually.

918.lore: This is the year she goes all in. She browsed countless swimsuits, pondered for days, then finally decided to pin her unspoken hopes and dreams on a timeless design that also accentuates the tenderness of the female figure. The season's liberating thrill convinced her to throw restraint to the wind and charge right out of the gate. Whether or not she will cross the finish line first is anyone's guess.

919.lore: Vultee knows catching a big wave needs the right gear. With this stylish shirt, he can undo the buttons to reveal just enough of his sculpted physique to drive the ladies wild, or so he believed. That was until Priscilla gave him a puzzled look and asked why he suddenly couldn't dress himself properly. Ever since, he keeps all of the buttons fastened tight.

920.lore: Simon spent most of his time at the beach reading beneath an umbrella when not training. Underneath the summer sun's glare, he always wore these tinted glasses. He may have been protecting his most important asset as a sharpshooter...or hiding his embarrassment at Miranda's shameless swimwear. No one knew for certain.

921.lore: Among Miranda's quirks was her outlandish taste in swimwear. She had not visited the beach since Simon's passing, and a last-minute search through her wardrobe unearthed nothing but this particularly skimpy bikini. The concern that it no longer fit her, since she had bought it years ago for their first beach date, proved needless. Instead, she felt pride in seeing real proof of her successfully balancing regular training with her busy teaching schedule.

922.lore: Luana's favorite swimsuit worn during her family's yearly trips to the beach. She chose it wanting to show Hart, but that opportunity never came. Although outgrown during his absence, she couldn't bring herself to part with it. In her mind, that would be no different than giving up entirely.

923.lore: The shield belonging to Gaia, loyal knight of the Higher Gods. Imbued with the power of a water Spirit, it creates a wave barrier at the user's will. He charges across the battlefield with it firm in hand to save his allies. The beautiful, crystal-clear flash of his sword followed by the beautiful, flower-shaped splash from his shield earned him the nickname "Water Blossom Knight".

924.lore: Lyla's trusty partner on the battlefield. In her quest for further improvement, she wandered into a used bookstore. There, she discovered a reference about Valkia's ancient "gundancing" custom and became engrossed in the topic. The key concept was managing the weapon's unpredictable movements with lithe motions of the body. In mastering that, she became famous among gunmen around the world.

925.lore: A model of gatling gun once manufactured in Valkia Kingdom. Thorough maintenance has preserved its luster against the ravages of time. The army officers chose this for Lyla after assessing her skills. Although she struggled with its weight at first, the fact she learned to wield it so well in such a short time reflects her untiring efforts to become the best she can be.

926.lore: Lyla's military outfit. The magic sewn into the fabric of Valkia's army uniforms affects each soldier differently. It granted her the power of light which enhances the strength of her shots. However, they all share the sturdiness to withstand the soldiers' daily regimen, so everyone treats their own as a dependable ally.

927.lore: A small red box said to have belonged to the Flame Maiden, the woman who led an adventurer lost in the underworld to safety. Containing the vital force of the phoenix A'patari, it cleansed the traveler's body and mind of those dark mists. She could hold it barehanded, but others must take precautions lest the intense heat leave burns.

928.lore: A pair of daggers with countless miniscule Crests engraved along the blades. The water dragon motif suggests they were crafted by a tribe that worshipped the twin-headed Atlante. If swung fast enough, the Crests call forth its power through the afterimages. This means these weapons only show their true worth when wielded by a skilled warrior.

929.lore: A silver staff with a large green crystal blessed by the Dragon of Life at the top. The fascinating swirls of magic inside the gem fetch a high price. Though most of the time it quickly changes hands and locations, it causes ruinous turmoil if it remains in one place for too long. People believe that its gift is beneficial to the point of harm, hence the name.

930.lore: A jet-black helmet made from the scales of Mavro-halos, a monster that once threatened all of Raktehelm. Discovered in ruins ravaged by his fury, whoever touches it will be consumed by the dark blaze. Records show it was originally beautiful platinum headgear worn by knights who served the Dragon, but hatred inside the scales corroded the metal over time.

931.lore: A jet-black helmet made from the scales of Mavro-halos, a monster that once threatened all of Raktehelm. Discovered in ruins ravaged by his fury, whoever touches it will be consumed by the dark blaze. Records show it was originally beautiful platinum headgear worn by knights who served the Dragon, but hatred inside the scales corroded the metal over time.

932.lore: Cute swimwear belonging to Leone, princess of Granadia. Although she first hid in the shade, the listening sands and beckoning waves had coaxed her onto the beach before she knew it. Tired from playing all day, the swaying of the carriage soon rocked her to sleep beneath the warm smiles of the Templars.

933.lore: A graceful ensemble worn by the queen of Granadia, Juno. As part of summer vacation for her Templars (minus Berwick), she decided to surprise Leone by taking her to the beach in secret. Despite a few unexpected happenings, her plan ended successfully.
