While watching her dear sister and her dependable guardians at play, she renewed her oath to do whatever it took to protect their smiles.

934.lore: Camouflage-patterned swim trunks for Vox, captain of the Templars. His oath to protect Juno remained strong even during the relaxed vacation mood. Not even fun in the sun would keep him from carrying out his duties as a knight, such as rescuing the princess from roving monsters. This display of unwavering commitment also helped close the distance between the two ever so slightly.

935.lore: Swimming briefs that Riviera picked out for Duke. He gave her the chance since he has no strong preference in fashion and realized how much she was looking forward to their beach vacation. However, its gaudy, prismatic design brought instant regret. Positioned imposingly in the waist-high shallows, he reflected upon the importance of proper consideration in all things, on and off the battlefield.

936.lore: The daring bikini of the Juno Templars' vanguard fighter, Riviera. She had secretly worked on her figure all year just so she could wear it without hesitation. The captivating sight of her frolicking on the white sands more than solidified her role as beauty of the group. Also, she was the only one who remembered to bring a souvenir for Berwick, earning his respect.

937.lore: Mikyuon-themed diving gear belonging to shield bearer of the Juno Templars, Thetis. The magical snorkel gives its wearer the power to breathe underwater, and he hoped it would let him gather rare deep-sea delicacies at their freshest. While it performed admirably in that regard, he realized most of what he found would be hard for the others to stomach. His reward was not gasps of admiration at his culinary skills but smiles of content after a satisfying meal.

938.lore: Besides blue waters and white sands underneath the yellow sun, the beach was also home to green monsters. Leone strolled along the shore, enjoying the scent of the breeze with her parasol open wide...utterly unaware a small parade had formed behind her. Though the impish creatures scared her at first, she felt a little sad to say goodbye at day's end. This little parasol is filled with memories of their time together.

939.lore: Juno's personal Diever Boat. From the moment she saw it on display, its hydrodynamic form and cute eyes stole her heart. All of the latest features are installed, allowing for realistic Diever movement that instantly responds to its driver. Those who watched her tear through the waves found her greater-than-usual exuberance charming.

940.lore: A large hooded coat belonging to the founder of Riizism, Elizabeth. Although it in itself has no special powers, pulling the hood over the wearer's face will draw out their full potential through suggestive stimulus. The stretchy fabric makes it one-size-fits-all but offers little in the way of protection.

941.lore: The pendant of Elizabeth, founder of Riizism. Its only notable feature is letting the wearer hypnotize themselves into releasing their full potential. The bumpy surface can massage sore feet, but it is too fragile to support one's whole body weight.

942.lore: The oversized coat belonging to an evil priest's first experiment, Elizabeth. It has no unique qualities besides elasticity, but it uses the power of suggestion to activate the wearer's latent capabilities. Since it was a birthday gift from her mother, she rarely takes it off. The reflective back allows her to be seen even in the dark.

943.lore: Goldoa Corp.'s iconic laser gun. Lightweight, durable, and customizable down to the pulse color, it has fans among gunslingers of all skill levels. There are also "Inspector Collectors" who seek out rare versions, driving up prices on the second-hand market as a result. Some will even travel to far-flung rural shops in hopes of discovering treasure.

944.lore: Vultee's favorite hat, a style popular among ranchers in Selunia. He firmly believes a gunner always needs a hat, so he has dozens in all shapes and sizes. The reason he prefers this particular one is the perfect balance of formal and casual provided by the broken-in fabric, suiting him to a T.

945.lore: The customized weapon of Vultee, imperial soldier from Simon's Hill. Most of the visual adjustments are minor like the perfectly molded grip. Far more important are the magically strengthened gun barrel, able to withstand up to twice the output, and the precision calibration chip tuned to his personal quirks.

946.lore: A necklace inscribed with the text of a lost civilization. It has the power to bind and control the minds of others. A partial decoding of the script led researchers to believe it to be the code of law for an extinct race known as the Ancients. Only a handful still exist, and many are fabricated. Even so, merely imitating the shape gives them some effectiveness.

947.lore: A magical dress with enchanted embroidery. It grants the wearer immense power but places a number of restricting terms on them. Moreover, no record of the consequences should those terms be broken exists. The fabric adapts to the body's contours even if it changes dramatically.

948.lore: Magical boots worn by Tursowa, champion of the Ancients. They were crafted in the distant past using a spell-nullifying material, but the ones worn by Emi are imitations created with her own magic. Since she destroys them whenever she transforms, that is a more reasonable method of replacing such rare articles.

949.lore: A sword kept in the Principality of Bamint to slay the "monsters" that occasionally emerge among the royal lineage. The only one spared from this fate was Celia, instead sentenced to lifelong imprisonment. Despite the severity of her crimes, it was believed a third party ultimately initiated her transformation.

950.lore: Emi's necklace engraved with the script of a lost civilization. It gives her the ability to control the minds of her retainers. Unlike the waning effect found in others, the power of this one is fully intact since it was made recently.

951.lore: Emi's dress inlaid with enchanted embroidery. The pact she formed with it gave her strength in exchange for limiting her actions. There are nine restrictions in all, with each additional one offering a proportional benefit. Since complete commitment makes it impossible to lead a normal life, some other source of stability, such as a firm will or a deep-rooted anger, is necessary.

952.lore: The royal blade of Bamint wielded by Rayas as last resort against the Ancients. Before reaching the principality, it was worshiped in La Riiz for reasons unknown. The will of a knight from a bygone era resides within it, made possible by the Magistones from which it was forged. When Rayas made contact with that spirit, he was taught how to release the sword's full power.

954.lore: A mystical sword with the soul of a rampaging Dragon that once incinerated the world. Its rushing flames can reduce an entire battalion to ashes in one stroke. A royal family kept it as a symbol of their military dominance, unaware each swing loosened its binds on the Dragon's soul and brought them ever closer to their own doom.

955.lore: It is said by raising this ochre crystal skywards, Jack-O-Sherum will appear and grant the holder's wish. That pumpkin-headed armor is assumed to be possessed by Ragsherum Phantom. Although it brings no harm to people directly, the cost of asking for its aid is pranks befitting the spirit of the occasion.

956.lore: The cape of Phantom Ragsherum when it was possessed by a pumpkin ghost. Donning this, he was seen around the land, wandering through the darkness of the autumn nights. The reason as to why he would perform "tricks" on those he would encounter until he was quelled with a "treat" is still unknown. No one could see his face, as it was covered by a pumpkin, but he somehow seemed joyous when he received a treat and disappeared into the night.

957.lore: The town of Simon's Hill held a costume festival to celebrate the harvest each fall. For the school event, Hart's class chose to open a maid café. Hart originally volunteered to cook, but Vultee's remark of "Y'know, I think you'd look good in a dress." was met with unanimous agreement. Despite his grumbling in the changing room, he couldn't deny that thrilling sensation as he looked himself over in the mirror.

958.lore: Priscilla's maid outfit. She fell in love with the frilly design, but it merely occupied space in her wardrobe for months since there was no opportunity to wear it until the costume festival. Encouraged that it still fit her, she hoped to catch Hart's eyes, but the fact that everyone else's were focused him in a skirt left her feeling conflicted...even though she had happily applied his make-up.

959.lore: Vultee's traditional yet classy butler suit. To apologize for inadvertently causing Hart to dress like a maid, he decided to join him on the service side of the class café. However, no amount of guilt could bring him to make the leap into a skirt as well. This was why he was secretly relieved to see Hart enjoying himself regardless of everything.

960.lore: A devastating (on several levels) outfit of Miranda's, said to have been fashionable in a distant country. Although she needed some time to realize the absurdly long socks were meant to be scrunched up, she claimed it made her feel rejuvenated. Indeed, more than a few visitors to the school festival assumed she too was part of the student body from her ebullience.

961.lore: If Simon were still alive, Miranda would choose the garb of a far-eastern warrior for him to wear at the costume festival. He would likely heave a sigh and put it on reluctantly, but he would gradually accustom himself to the unusual blade and even strike a couple of poses... Or so she envisioned the day before the event.

962.lore: Everyone is free to pick their costume for the fall festival, so there are invariably a handful of shocking selections such as Luana's. Still, no one could work up the courage to dissuade her from wearing what was bought with her own hard-earned allowance money. The perfectly innocent reason she chose it further complicated matters: "Hart said he likes bunnies."

963.lore: A magic compound bow once sealed away for its sinister powers. Though no one can tell when it was made, the mechanisms responsible for its tremendous lethality cannot be recreated or analyzed by modern technology. The most fearsome attribute is how anyone who wields it even for a short time, regardless of nature or personality, will grow fiercely attached, their destructive impulses stoked beyond control.

964.lore: A complex magical bow long stored within an imperial armory for its shady past only to suddenly vanish. The strength of its shots is not determined by physical might, but magical aptitude. Additionally, it will use that magic to create shadow projectiles in the absence of tangible arrows.

965.lore: A coat worn by those who shoot or kill for a living. It increases one's ability to conceal their presence by altering the target's mind. Essentially, it causes the brain to selectively ignore visual information. However, the wearer might start to believe they are being rudely disregarded as a result.

966.lore: The weapon used by the assassin Groitz, a member of Shadow. The claw-like shape is suited to his personal fighting style. The rings will form rigid blades on command but maintaining them demands a steady supply of magic. Only those with deep reserves can properly use them.

967.lore: Clothes made by filtering and refining residual magic in the air. The seemingly normal fabric is anything but, its Prima Ether composition letting it to shapeshift with the wearer's body. The technology behind it was not invented by Humans, but primeval deities with a thorough understanding of the arcane.

968.lore: Elongated rings that generate solid edges when fed magical power. They are favored by assassins and others who prefer easily concealed weapons. The blades' quality is proportional to the wielder's magic capacity. Since they drain energy while active, they demand a finesse and timing different from normal weapons.

969.lore: A unique outfit made from pure magic essence by a master of technology lost to history. Despite the resemblance to regular fabric, not a single stitch or seam can be found. The ethereal nature allows it to change shape as required.

970.lore: Groitz's boots. The soles are inlaid with crystal fragments that naturally repulse energies in the ground. This repulsion can be adjusted to do anything from muffle footsteps to leap great distances. The fact it does not expend one's own magic reserves makes them all the more convenient.

971.lore: An armored sword containing the power of Wilkes, half of a pair that represents the opposing forces of life and death. Long ago, she sealed light of every hue in this world inside of it creating an eternal brilliance that grants vitality to all creatures. Its holder too will obtain abundant valor leading them and their allies along the path of glory.

972.lore: An armored sword containing the power of Wilkes, half of a pair that represents the opposing forces of life and death. Long ago, she sealed shadow of every shade in this world inside of it creating an ominous reminder that darkness swallows all life. Whoever holds this will gain the might to ensure victory but also the fate of perpetual solitude.

973.lore: A super-heavyweight turret gun modified for full compatibility with Vultee's prosthetic arm. Unsparing focus on firepower meant anything that resembled a safety device was stripped away. Without his strength-boosting arm, it would pose only slightly less risk to him than the target. The fact he went through so much trouble to properly wield it proves his commitment.

974.lore: The largest class of portable turret gun. Originally developed to installed at a fixed location, it was later miniaturized for quick repositioning. Even so, firing it unmounted is nearly impossible without superhuman strength. Vultee can only handle it due to the enhanced power output of his prosthetic arm.

975.lore: Military boots created in Selunia. They are sturdy enough to give extra anchoring for Vultee's massive weapon while flexible enough for quick movements. Their high performance even shocks expert shoemakers in the capital, and reproducing a fraction of it takes too much effort for most imitators. He has sworn by them ever since he chose to pursue a career as a marksman.

977.lore: A sword gleaming bright enough to overwhelm the power of the divine. A God forged it to subvert the Ancient-established order. After fulfilling that purpose, it was given to the Original Human and thus passed down through the unbroken imperial Isliid lineage. Now, Humans revere it as a symbol of fearlessness against seemingly superior foes.

978.lore: A legendary sword that grants its wielder the ability to read minds, leading them to victory. Despite its fame, the details of its creation and whereabouts are lost to history. Among the few known facts is how it was bestowed to the first emperor of Isliid who decimated the opposing Human faction with its power overnight.

979.lore: A sword brimming with dark energy that contains the soul of a trapped apparition. Long ago, demons used it to fight others of their kind drunk with power with the help of oppressed Humans. This weapon they created together represented their joint effort. Unfortunately, it was not enough to overcome the racial barrier for long, and it ironically came into the hand of a Human emperor who slew countless more Demons.

980.lore: A copy of Sky Light, the Sword of Coruscation. The Emperor of Isliid's three blades must be sealed at all times outside of combat, and even imitations are used during ceremonies. The lone exception is the coronation rite due to a customary belief they decide their bearer and thus the nation's master. As a result, some people joke that the true rulers of Isliid are the swords themselves.

981.lore: A copy of Terra Master, the Sword of Control. While inferior to the original, the edge is still incredibly keen, and it has been enchanted with near-weightlessness. Long symbolizing the Human race's ability to forge the future, it is most synonymous with imperial might among the emperor's three blades.

982.lore: A copy of Dark Bringer, the Sword of Conquest. Although a Human-made imitation, the bafflingly morbid acts of the artificers, driven insane by its beauty, befit the ominous original. Even the master blacksmith who oversaw the forging process crushed both of his eyeballs to make the final touches.

983.lore: A doll modeled after the young magician Hart. During his research of an otherworld holiday called "Christmas", he learned about an old man in bright red clothes who delivered gifts and spread good will all over the land. This inspired him to do the same one day, dressing his doll in the magnanimous figure's outfit as a reminder of that goal.

984.lore: A doll modeled after Priscilla, an innocent archer. One wintery day some years ago, she and Hart built a snowman together. His broad smile at their handiwork still shines bright in her memory. That tender emotion is imbued in the doll she made, giving it a magical warmth.

985.lore: A doll modeled after the suave gunman, Vultee. When Miranda assigned the dollmaking project to her class, he immediately stood up and declared his would be the coolest. All of his schoolmates thought it was another of his usual bluffs, but the glossy red nose and exquisite horns reminded them he can do whatever he puts his mind to (sometimes).

986.lore: A doll based on teacher and Ranger Captain, Miranda. A lover of festivals, she had the class make plushies as room decorations for an otherworld holiday called "Christmas". Although the end-of-the-year rush meant she could not finish hers until the night before, the burning desire to see her students' smiling faces sustained her through the chill of the late hours.

987.lore: A doll modeled after Miranda's late husband, Simon. After finishing her own doll, she thought it would be appropriate to make his as well. The idea of giving him reindeer features was soon discarded in favor of a matching look. She chuckled to imagine how embarrassed he would be as she worked the needle and thread.

988.lore: A doll modeled after the precocious Luana. With surprising dexterity, she crafted something that certainly did not look like the work of a child. Vultee and the others started brainstorming ways to make enough to sell, but she just pouted in the corner, never wanting anything more than Hart's praise.

989.lore: A decoration used in an otherworld festival known as "Christmas". Inside the crystal sphere is a miniaturized scene of Raktehelm, and shaking it recreates gentle snowfall. The small but captivating sight can provide entertainment for hours on end. A member of the Reigrad Adventurers' Guild is known to be particularly vulnerable to its charms.

990.lore: Unique headgear with the power of Emi's Revelation form. Despite the alluring lilac gleam, it chars skin, corrodes bone, and blinds the eyes of its wearer. However, descendants of the Ancients experience no drawbacks whatsoever. The gemstone in the center also amplifies dark magic, making it invaluable to wielders of offensive spells.

991.lore: The magic wand of famous conjurer Selia. The crystal at the top, made up of highly endothermic materials, approaches temperatures close to absolute zero. This increases the strength of ice magic by a magnitude of over 1000%. However, the uninitiated should never touch it as a single mistake could leave them frozen solid.

994.lore: Unique headgear with the power of Emi's Revelation form. Despite the alluring lilac gleam, it chars skin, corrodes bone, and blinds the eyes of its wearer. However, descendants of the Ancients experience no drawbacks whatsoever. The gemstone in the center also amplifies dark magic, making it invaluable to wielders of offensive spells.

997.lore: A dagger crafted especially for Rosetta. The layout of the engraved runes has been customized for sharper reactions to her commands. Though its magic is fairly weak, the improved tracking and speed allows it to strike vital spots with deadly accuracy. The blacksmith who reworked the dagger used his knowledge of Shinobi culture and weaponry as a reference.

998.lore: A dagger with finely engraved runes across the blade. When thrown, rune magic will activate upon striking the target. The rarity of this technique combined with its wide range of effect easily catches opponents unawares. It can also return to the wielder mid-flight for a relentless string of attacks.

999.lore: A cloak made to contain magical power. Spellcasters must concentrate to have energy ready for use, but this also causes inevitable seepage. The inner lining keeps such loss to a minimum by redirecting it back into the body.

1000.lore: Gloves engraved with runes. When charging staves or blades with magic, even masters will experience rare instances of misfiring. These remove that risk by ensuring a perfectly stable flow. As this not only makes producing the spell's intended effect easier but also amplifies it slightly, they are very popular.

1001.lore: Armor made from the skin of the blue Giant, Geo Zagnus. Frequently described as "tough but weighty", evading with it will quickly tire out the wearer. However, those who focus on offense find its heft gives extra momentum to each blow. After effortlessly overpowering their foes, their appraisal changes to "tough and weighty".

1002.lore: Charlotte's trusty weapon. The Scarlet Mana Stone worked into the blade glows brightly in response to its holder's spirit. Both her prestigious bloodline and intense training allows the sword to glow an even brighter red. She was inspired to become a hero from the moment she grasped the hilt, but she knows months and years of committed effort will be needed for her to reach her goal.

1003.lore: A two-handed sword imbued with the power of light and flame. Once stored in the kingdom's treasury, an aged soldier took it with permission and lent it to his granddaughter. Each swing creates a blazing stream for attacks which are difficult to dodge and fatal upon direct contact. Many who witness the girl wrapped in the weapon's fire say she resembles its proper owner, the Hero of Famelle Zeorg, in his younger days.

1004.lore: Rabbit-shaped headgear belonging to Charlotte. It absorbs magic energy in the air to relieve the wearer's fatigue. Many believe this is what lets her wield a sword the size of her body with ease. However, she keeps it on even outside of battle for the simple reason that she likes bunnies.

1005.lore: Created from the Flogassa's tailfeathers. Since that enormous bird lives deep inside a volcano, the source of its heat is underground magma rather than anything artificial. As a result, each swing of this makes an incinerating gust that can dissolve even a flame-resistant behemoth.

1006.lore: Created from the Flogassa's tailfeathers. Since that enormous bird lives deep inside a volcano, the source of its heat is underground magma rather than anything artificial. As a result, each swing of this makes an incinerating gust that can dissolve even a flame-resistant behemoth.

1015.lore: A pair of short swords used by Mizuki the Twelfth. They were formerly owned by an assassin on the mainland, satisfying his desire to break away from conventional shinobi designs. Both produce a high-pitched sound when swung, and the beautiful harmony that results earned them the nickname of "Resonant Blades".

1016.lore: The enormous blade of Imari Village's historic protector, Ginzo. Glowing faintly violet in the darkness, it is rumored to have been made from the larynx of the netherworld's guardian beast. Its magic flows through the holder's nerves, creating a link that gives Ginzo compete control over its movements. This and his phantasmal stealth makes him capable of untold destruction.

1017.lore: A pair of daggers found at an import store in the capital and modified into shinobi weapons by an Imari Village blacksmith. Able to be used separately or combined into a single double-edged sword, they are highly suited to Mizuki's style of rapid, flowing attacks. He is familiar with every kind of shinobi weapon, but these are the only ones he carries at all times.

1018.lore: An outfit created with sewing techniques originating beyond Imari Village. Although they revere tradition, the village youth are also quick to adopt new culture. This style of hooded jacket represents that subtle change. What it lacks in defense is offset by fashion -- fresh enough to blend into modern society while still able to hide standard chain mail underneath.

1019.lore: The cursed blade carried by the legendary shinobi Ginzo. Imari Village houses several weapons forbidden to all but their elite warriors. This is the most heinous, as its cursed might amplifies one's murderous intent. Fighting Ginzo while he holds it is unfathomably dangerous, and only Mizuki dares to face them both.

1020.lore: Ginzo's armor draped in the surcoat of a warrior who died with unfulfilled ambitions. Its mystical energy amplifies his own might in addition to gradually improving the shell underneath, matching pace with advancements in combat technology. Tradition still plays an important role, however, as Imari's dyeing methods mask the metal's sheen to let it blend into shadow.

1021.lore: Armor crafted from the hide of Geo Zagnus, Giant master of the Gobls. It contains his innate might, granting the wearer dramatically increased brawn but reportedly making them prone to attacks by his vengeful servants. Despite these curse-like consequences, the power-hungry still desire its strength.

1022.lore: Gauntlets that show outstanding mastery in one of Demonkind's oldest martial arts, Kongou Tenchi-Ryu. Influenced by strength of spirit rather than body, they become heavier the more Thetis relies upon brute force. On the other hand, he gains the speed to unleash twenty ground-splitting punches in one second with a clear, selfless mind.

1023.lore: A scythe created from Riviera's blood. Because of her connection to Juno and Leone, it also contains their Crimson Blood. It changes shape according to her will, allowing for tricky attack patterns. The sound of it slicing through the air resembles a melancholic howl, perhaps giving voice to Riviera's agony as she searches for the royal sisters.

1024.lore: Special gauntlets bestowed upon experts of Kongou Tenchi-Ryu. Very few can make them since the method is only passed down along the craftsmen living near the style's original dojo. It is believed the process harkens all the way back to the age of Ancients, the original form unmistakable beneath the changes brought about by time's passage.

1025.lore: Greaves used among practitioners of Kongou Tenchi-Ryu. Whoever can overcome the weight will gain immense strength. Their hardness not only repels blades, it shatters them. Those worn by Thetis are relatively light, but when Rayas picked one up, he was so surprised he dropped it. The impact left a hole in the floor.

1026.lore: A scythe created from the blood of Demons. Although it has a soul, it is more of a monster than a living creature. It absorbs the blood of each holder to reform itself and become stronger, thus attracting more powerful warriors. Moreover, it directs the wielder into battle for the purpose of protecting them just enough that they realize their own weakness, making them more dependent on the sinister weapon.

1027.lore: An exceptionally resistant dress containing dense magic power. Its defense against blades and sorcery is due to the great amount of Demon blood dyeing the threads. This method was widely forbidden, including in Granadia. The blood's thickness and royal status increases effectiveness, so only a truly dire tragedy could have made this outfit's creation possible.

1028.lore: Legendary kunai knives, their full potential awakened by Sakuya's mastery. Each and every one is imbued with Imari's unique magic, offering a variety of deadly effects to match her needs in battle. The number of kunai a shinobi can fling at once is said to represent their ability, and she releases dozens in a single throw.

1029.lore: Kunai knives favored by Sakuya the Kasumi of Imari Village. The shinobi's astounding physical capabilities let them leap freely through the air, throwing these to disorient the enemy. The hapless victims' bloodspray resembles petals, granting these weapons their name. Sakuya wields them with the most expertise of everyone in the village.

1030.lore: Imari Village's recreation of an imported article. It grants resistance against mind-altering spells, making it useful on secret missions to lower the risk of hypnosis, brainwashing, and charms. Regardless of that, the design is extremely popular among young people, and traders outside the village will pay handsomely for it.

1032.lore: Regulation-size equipment for beach battleball, a combination of volleyball and martial arts. The maker claims it can withstand the weight of a dragon. Some joke about building castle walls with them, but the same super-tough ore used in barriers and ramparts is mixed into the flexible coating. Getting hit by one seriously hurts.

1033.lore: A swimsuit with a design inspired by tropical flowers. Cestina purchased it on impulse only to realize how skimpy it was after returning home. She hid it deep inside her wardrobe, but a sudden change of heart struck her moments before departure. That delay while she ran back to the castle gave her siblings reason enough for teasing along the journey.

1034.lore: A pump-action water gun popular among the young and the young-at-heart. This year's model boasts more capacity and faster pressurization for longer, wetter battles. *Mikyuons not included.

1035.lore: This bikini is a popular choice for young women who have never worn one before. Besides the classic design, comfortable fit, and cute ribbons, the top is enchanted with a back-stretching spell to make the wearer look ever-so-slightly taller. Liza, after nearly an hour's deliberation, became its latest customer.

1036.lore: Fireworks invented by Orvell with the simple intent of making huge explosions in the night sky. The launcher is small enough to carry one-handed, but it releases a massive fireball once ignited. Still under development when summer vacation began, the results were satisfactory enough to move on to the production stage. The name, however, is being kept intact.

1037.lore: A new fashion label started with the concept of making trendy yet traditional designs for young men, such as these shorts. Though it has considerable resiliency, it does not quite hold up to the rigors of beach battleball -- something Luahn discovered first-hand. When interviewed after the tournament, he said, "I never expected it would split open in the back like that..."

1038.lore: An exotic swimsuit Angelas obtained from a shady, high-pressure market peddler. She regretted the purchase for a few days until finally working up the courage to wear it. Not only did she think it looked cute on her, so did everyone she showed it to. More than improving her mood, that attention went straight to her head.

1039.lore: A bold and aggressive bikini that accentuates the wearer's natural physique. Simply putting it on gives one the poise and manner of a top model. In Victoire's case, who already had a figure sculpted by proper posture and breathing methods, there is no more fitting swimwear.

1040.lore: An inflatable raft for two. The stability and comfort its large size offers makes it perfect for floating on the waves, but it needs a lot of time and air to fill. Eagle was silently flattered they borrowed the shape of his shield for the design, but he was unamused by the turtle-like caricature.

1041.lore: Hart's favorite pair of boots. Their standard appearance belies a special composition designed for mages. Its magically charged laces feed the gravity-control spell in the soles for extra agility, or they can be wrapped around the wearer's arms for a boost of energy. However, his first attempt at the latter saw him immediately trip over the loosened flaps, so he never did it again.

1042.lore: Once worn over the shoulders of Ragsherum, first general of the Demon forces. They create a sound like howling wind in response to the wearer's fury, striking fear into their enemies. The exact source of this noise is unclear. Some believe it is Ragsherum's ghost who died in anger, lamenting his own foolishness.

1043.lore: Juno's vivid pareo-style bikini, only slightly altered. She tried it on one year later, and the strange snugness sent a chill down her spine. It was impossible she gained weight; her daily routine included an hour of rigorous exercise. Then, she remembered Riviera would be a reliable source of information on the matter. That struggle to regain composure made it clear she forgot some Demons were exceptionally late bloomers.

1044.lore: Leone's cute leotard-style swimsuit, unaltered in any way. She tried it on one year later, and the comfortable fit sent a chill down her spine. It was impossible she had not grown; her daily snack included a glass of nutritious milk. Then, she remembered her sister would be a reliable source of information on the matter. That glimmer of hope in her eyes made it clear she was unaware of what disappointment the future held.

1045.lore: A legendary sword made of super-lightweight meteoric iron. Zeorg chose it for Valerie after taking note of her amazing agility. Since she is already able to swing it three times in a single breath, he believes she can eventually attack ten times in the blink of an eye.

1046.lore: A historic blade of Famelle, kept in Zeorg's collection. Despite its incredible firmness, it can float on water due to the lightweight meteoric iron used to make it. It is possible to swing this blade thrice in the same time needed to swing a regular blade once. Simply following such speed with the eyes is a superhuman feat, so whoever fights its wielder can expect a swift death.

1047.lore: Valerie's favorite choker. Its look is both fashionable and slightly rebellious, pairing well with her usual outfit. The designer has become popular as of late, so even older articles like this fetch a high price among fans. That she managed to get a jump on the trend shows attention to surroundings in contrast to her apparent indifference.

1048.lore: A bright pink swimsuit Charlotte chose for the summer. Though she did like the balance between the cute frills and mature shaping, Valerie's alarming enthusiasm was the main factor. It caused her to reflect on how Valerie influenced most of her wardrobe, but as long as her best friend was happy, she didn't mind.

1049.lore: A white dress Valerie chose for the summer. She tended towards the casual style of shirts and pants, but Charlotte pressured her into a more feminine look. Its breeziness was a bit uncomfortable, but as she watched the long hem twirl around her legs in the mirror, she began to understand the appeal.

1050.lore: Forte's one-piece swimsuit with a starkly somber design. Her soldiers, assuming the boutique clerk forced the purchase, were flabbergasted when she said it was her own decision. That contrast between the adornments and her stoic nature further enhanced the appeal. Everyone even started imagining what the rest of her private attire might look like.

1051.lore: Literal no-frills swimwear belonging to Emi. In her home village, all children were given swim lessons along with simple, practical equipment. She boasted about its superiority over the "garish Human eyesores", but her mind seemed to change moments after stepping onto the beach. Surrounded by women in a variety of colorful styles, she muttered something about being cold and wrapped a jacket around her drooped shoulders.

1052.lore: Groitz's repulsive beach shorts. Although he clearly liked the sickly shade of green and creepy skull-and-thorn pattern, everyone else on the beach gave him a wide berth. Emi observed he would be useful in opening a path through the homeward-bound crowds, but that benefit did not outweigh the humiliation of being seen in his company.

1054.lore: Outerwear belonging to the Ranger Captain of Simon's Hill, Miranda. The threads are spun from blessed Oracle Flowers, granting it resistance to magic. It was a birthday present from her husband Simon. Since the Oracle Flower symbolizes trust, it made an ironic choice in light of how he would later murder her...or perhaps he hoped to avoid needing to do so.

1055.lore: The ever-reliable partner of Cosmo, Bamint officer and rising star. It transforms her outflowing emotions into killer riffs. Although Kane insists he would never give away such an expensive article, he does not seem too concerned about her borrowing it for so long. This might be because he knows she has become good enough to form a true bond.

1056.lore: The electric guitar used by Bamint officer and novice musician Cosmo. It was part of Kane's collection, but fate brought it into her hands. According to him, it requires more than technique to play well. When she asked what else was needed, he said the answer would come if she let emotion guide her playing.

1058.lore: A famous weapon said to awakens one's inner animal, dramatically increasing their capabilities. Although that effect as well as its edge is inferior to the original, it is far from cheap. Its production was as faithfully recreated as possible by a living legend of metallurgy. This resulted in an unmistakable masterpiece, replication or not.

1059.lore: A famous weapon said to awakens one's inner animal, dramatically increasing their capabilities. To be precise, it is a reproduction crafted by a living legend among smiths. After developing a new technique, he used it to reforge his greatest works including this blade. Rumors claim the improvements have made it even sharper than the original.

1060.lore: Throwing blades favored by the secretary-general of Gramenia, Fen. His outstanding technique and myriad accomplishments have made everyone all but forget these are borrowed from the national treasury. The amount of blades increases in proportion to the user's magic power, and in his hands, they number over a thousand.

1061.lore: The battle outfit of Gramenia's chief strategist, Fen. Military personnel don a uniform according to their position, and a secretary-general normally wears light gear similar to a civil officer as they do not see much combat. However, since he designed the nation's strategical maneuvers around leaders directly participating in battle, he made major customizations with tear-resistant fabric and shock-absorbing material.

1062.lore: Kirisame's blade possessed by a fire oni. One of Imari Village's historic weapons, a prospective user must undergo a deadly trial to hold it. The first success was attributed to the challenger somehow forming a pact with the oni. Further evidence was provided by others claiming to have witnessed the oni's figure in the flickering flame after a fierce battle.

1063.lore: Kirisame's weapon, containing the power of a legendary flame oni. Its internal heat repels all chill, earning the alias of "the Melting Sword", but that requires the holder to provide it with magic energy, otherwise it appears like an ordinary blade. Once ignited, each swing leaves streaks of fire, and it can evaporate weaker monsters without making contact.

1064.lore: Shoes from the outside world recreated with traditional Imari Village techniques. Their incredible heat resistance allows the wearer to walk over lava without feeling a thing, but the comfortable fit and firm grip are decidedly more appealing features. As their popularity took hold of the village, a wide variety of colors also sprung up.

1065.lore: One of the treasures of Imari Village. It is not a shinobi invention, but a gift from an ancient emperor. Although the edge is so keen that it can purportedly slice falling raindrops, such a feat requires decades of training. Its wielders already stepped away from active combat by the time they reached that level, and Hakuro is no exception.

1066.lore: A sickle and weighed chain crafted in the age of myth by a conjurer using body parts from Ugetsu. Its powerful hex brought about an entire nation's downfall, causing the creator to throw it into an active volcano out of repentance. Many historians question how that series of events occurred before Ugetsu's defeat, but this imitation certainly exists and is dangerous enough even without the original's curse.

1067.lore: A sickle-and-chain modeled after the one made from the body of Ugetsu. Although the original article is presumed lost, a descendant of its creator attempted to replicate it from the scant surviving records. Millenia of industrial advancements and experience resulted in a technically superior product, but there was no substitution for the hex of yore.

1068.lore: A protector built for extreme lightness. Most of its scant weight is centered around vital points. This suits a shinobi's focus on evasion and swift strikes, but those who try to use it like normal armor will be painfully disappointed. When worn by Hakuro, the elder of Imari, he can react to any incoming blow with ease.

1069.lore: The most prestigious weapon in Imari's history. Age has given it pseudo-divine qualities which generate an oppressive aura in battle. Only the proven are allowed to wield it, so Hakuro still does even in his retirement. However, it is a matter of time until someone takes it off his hands, and whoever does will assuredly become a legend in their own right.

1070.lore: The outfit Marika wore while helping out at the festival's costume cafe. It combined exotic patterns with familiar frills. Unaccustomed to taking orders, brewing tea, setting tables, and even dealing with a skirt, she was as out of her element as one could be. Regardless, the sight of timid eyes peeking over her frames captured the hearts of more than a few customers.

1071.lore: The outfit Forte wore while tending to overenthusiastic revelers at the costume festival. Fresh from her debut in a fashionable swimsuit, she gained the courage to step further away from the norm. The classic nurse's cap and lace-strewn dress may have seemed excessive, but fantasy was the order of the day. This applied to many of the so-called victims as well, who faked injuries as an excuse to catch a glimpse of her.

1072.lore: The outfit Fen wore the night of the costume festival. His friend, boss, and general pain-in-the-rear President Kane ordered him to choose one out of a predetermined lineup. The irritation faded when he put on this stylish suit, agreeing with Kane's fashion sense. It certainly paired well with his trademark smirk, as everyone who saw him could attest.

1073.lore: Charlotte's werewolf outfit for the costume festival. She thought the beastly cap and long, fluffy tail made for a perfect balace of tough and cute. However, her innate childishness tipped the result far towards the cute side, and Valerie wasn't going to ruin the magic by telling her.

1074.lore: A witch-like outfit Valerie wore for the costume festival. It is based on the main character of a famous puppet show in Famelle. Although targeted at young children, plenty of people outside that age range appreciate its rich lore and complex characters. Since Valerie was secretly a fan, she needed less convincing from Charlotte than usual.

1075.lore: A dignified outfit Emperor Isliid wore for the costume festival. Though resembling a cleric's vestiments, it is actually a special uniform for communicating with his ancestors. This means it is rarely used, but the night he watched over the festival from his castle was one such occasion. Whether impressed by the people's passion, harboring some secret purpose, or merely acting on a whim, no one else knows.

1080.lore: A legendary weapon of the shinobi that rent the flesh of a lightning beast and once laid guarded for generations. Decades ago, Imari was beset by disastrous lightning strikes, feared to be brought about by the vengeful beast's spirit. However, a certain young girl's mastery of it brought the destruction to a halt. It allowed her to achieve great feats, earning her praise as the "Shinigami of Imari".

1081.lore: A legendary shinobi weapon said to have pierced a holy creature of lightning. One tale holds that the electrical power within the blades lets it reach blinding speeds. Properly wielding it requires exceptional stamina, sharp perception, and most importantly, superb cleverness. As such, it laid unused in Imari for generations until the prodigy Hazuki mastered it at the tender age of six.

1082.lore: A coat based on an imported design woven with original Imari techniques. Strong and durable despite its light weight and softness. Furthermore, its resistance to the elements and ease of customization make it popular amongst younger shinobi.

1089.lore: One of three masterpieces by a famous carver. There was once a fire maiden who used her power for the benefit of mankind. So she would always remain with them, she poured the last of her strength into a scarlet crystal, which he later crafted into her shape. Whoever holds this statue will gain unshakable courage that burns bright even in the face of death.

1090.lore: One of three masterpieces by a famous carver. When a beloved priestess sacrificed herself to appease a water dragon's wrath, the tears of her admirers were gathered and crystallized. The carver, captivated by the priestess' pure heart, fashioned the crystal in her image as a memento. Whoever holds it will be wrapped in her affection, deeper than the ocean, and defended from all hardship.

1091.lore: One of three masterpieces by a famous carver. It is modeled after a mysterious fairy who would scatter faintly shining dust to guide lost wanderers out of her forest. He visited it in hopes of catching a glimpse of her, but the most he was able to find was a petrified chunk of her dust, used to make this statue. Enchanted by his strong admiration for the fairy, anyone who holds it will do so with similar tenacity.

1092.lore: A present from Valerie to apologize for their argument over the existence of Santa Claus. Although Valerie is skilled at embroidery, dollmaking is a different story. It took her six attempts to finish something good enough to give away. During the process of trial-and-error, she became so attached to the design that she created a seventh for herself in secret.

1093.lore: A present from Charlotte to apologize for their argument over the existence of Santa Claus. Knowing Charlotte's lack of sewing talent, she fearfully unwrapped the package only to be stunned by its high quality. Seeing how much heart and soul her friend put into it, she was motivated to improve herself.

1094.lore: A doll Serah created for her. Sensitive to extreme temperatures, she rarely strays from the warmth of the heater during winter. Serah consequently imagined her as a snowman in jest, but the rotund design was taken as a suggestion to exercise more. After seeing her displeasure, Serah bluntly remarked, "I'm surprised you care that much about your appearance."

1095.lore: A product of her recent dollmaking fixation. She originally planned to create ones for Marika, Serkro, and herself, but the sudden need to add Arcana left her with a shortage of material. This was resolved by designing Serkro to scale. However, he was so shocked at his miniscule size that he refused to open his mouth(?) for a while.

1096.lore: After learning about the otherworld saint Santa Claus, he became obnoxiously excitable. Every evening, he would share his vast knowledge of him to anyone who would (or wouldn't) listen. Every morning, he wailed that there was no present waiting for him. Unsure about the size and position for his stocking, he called emergency meetings with Serah. Her frustration at these and other annoyances convinced her to make this doll for him and restore peace, hence the strangely ominous aura.

1097.lore: Cestina, knowledgeable in otherworld festivals, decorated Mercurius with bright colors and gave it a matching name. Though Orvell made a face like she committed sacrilege, and Liza was dumbfounded that she'd mess with her weapon, Cestina felt justified. Not only did it show how much she treasured their reunion, she also noticed Liza sometimes mispronounced "Mercurius" in the very same way.

1098.lore: Bracers made from Giaveil the Grand Prince of Sin's body that dramatically increase the wearer's magic. As imitations containing only 3% of his body tissue, their effect is weaker than the originals, but raising that percentage with current techniques would render them uncontrollable. Regardless, these are considered among the strongest sorcery-enhancing gear available, demonstrating the Great Six Demons' absurd might.

1099.lore: Bracers made from Giaveil the Grand Prince of Sin's body that dramatically increase the wearer's magic. The standard 3% body tissue concentration in other replicas was increased to 10% by crafting them within an enchanted force field. Though some hold great expectations for this new technology, others worry placing such power in the hands of individuals may have severe consequences.

1103.lore: The shoulder portions of Ragsherum Phantom. After the death of Demon general Ragsherum, the armor he wore was possessed by his combat techniques and obsession for conquest. Should it find a new owner, they would obtain the power and love within those metal fittings -- a detestable wicked power and a love akin to malediction.

1104.lore: A pair of claws wielded lovingly by the wandering Demon Long. Once holy weapons, he modified them with cursed scarlet gems born from the belly of a Dragon. Even one of those is enough to potentially corrupt the heart, so only the most resilient minds can bear their immense strength.

1105.lore: A pair of claws that responds to the negative emotions of its bearer. Such weapons normally rely upon weight driven by physical strength, yet these were crafted with featherlight metal to facilitate magical flow for appalling deadliness. The user's grudges, envy, and hatred further sharpen the edges, allowing them to induce even more pain and suffering.

1106.lore: A fine coat of armor produced by combining proven western smithing techniques with eastern cultural influences. Its origins may trace back to a skilled Demon blacksmith from a powerful trading kingdom of old. Once lost behind the Great Seal at the end of the Ancient War, a certain adventurer's actions led to the return of this splendid article, offering key historical insight.

1107.lore: An imitation of the legendary mace which held Stiria's power. So that she is still present in some fashion, the sphere is wrapped in her never-melting ice. This both grants it exceptional hardness and the ability to freeze wounds, thereby slowing the healing process. Replica or not, it is no less a masterpiece.

1108.lore: Modeled after a legendary mace that contained the power of Stiria. Unlike other imitations, the frigid mass contains a sheet of ice shorn from the floating glacier she rides. As a result, it boasts incomparable toughness and destructive force, but mastering the weight requires extraordinary stamina.

1109.lore: A satchel Miranda once carried as a student. Although she is now more accustomed to a sword and shield, the fact she still owns this weathered bag proves its sentimental value. The heavy steel plate hidden inside for self-defense corrected more than a few delinquents back in the day. Perhaps that is why she is so attached to it.

1110.lore: A cloak that Miranda wore as a student. Now considered vintage, back then it was the latest style. Her tendency to describe it with painfully passé lingo puts to rest any concerns about making students think she is starting a new trend.

1111.lore: The charm carved into the bow keeps the target from moving. The enchantment cast upon the arrows sets the target's heart alight with passion. Nothing is required to use them except a pure heart, and they will link two souls forever. At least, that is the backstory Priscilla invented.

1112.lore: The apron worn by the servers at a popular restaurant. Fashioned by world-renowned designer "Knight of Isliid", it was made to catch the eye rather than food, obvious to anyone who has ever handled a sizzling pan. For that reason, Priscilla dons this when presenting -- not preparing -- her handiwork.

1113.lore: A reproduction of a legendary helmet that contains the power of the double-headed Beast Garm. Although inferior to the original, it still offers better protection than anything on the market since it was made with the creature's hide. The material's rarity combined with how it neutralizes common fire magic means it's already the stuff of epics to the average adventurer.

1114.lore: A reproduction of a legendary helmet that contains the power of the double-headed Beast Garm. Unlike other imitations, this uses even rarer, magic-rich body parts for flame resistance on an entirely different level. All of a country's court magicians could cast their strongest fire spells and leave not a wisp of smoke. Some believe it possibly surpasses the original.

1115.lore: A reproduction of a frigid shield made from tempered scales of Aerugraxes. Freezing halts molecular motion. Destruction alters molecular positions. These two concepts provide the theoretical basis that a mass at absolute zero will give flawless defense. Unfortunately, this imitation is crafted with fragments which compromise its sturdiness, but the super-low temperature still ensures a remarkable effect.

1116.lore: A reproduction of a frigid shield made from tempered scales of Aerugraxes. If destruction is the movement of molecules, then absolute zero, at which all movement is stopped, should theoretically provide perfect defense. A team of crafters used complete scales for a barrier as close to that temperature as possible. In this way, a Dragon that once threatened to wipe out civilization helped protect it.

1117.lore: Reproductions of wrist guards made from the scales and claws of Elpneumas. They contain the same life force that fills natural vegetation, providing the wearer with vitality and hardiness. This ability to withstand any tribulation is invaluable on the battlefield. Though inferior to the originals, they are more than capable to nurturing the next generation of warriors.

1118.lore: Reproductions of wrist guards made from the scales and claws of Elpneumas. The inclusion of special seeds discovered in its body grants them immense power despite being replicas. Like tree roots burrowing through stony layers, the talons can pierce soil and rock with ease. Energy that normally cultivates life is thus diverted into strength for battle.

1123.lore: The unusually large syringe of the Witch of Annihilation, Aristela. She filled it with a strength-enhancing elixir so the Giants could better fight against the World-Devouring Beast. According to her, it was potent enough to kill a normal person, but a normal person could not withstand being pricked by such a large needle in the first place.

1124.lore: A syringe used by Aristela. Its size is adjustable, but she often keeps it large enough to frighten the Giant brothers for her amusement. However, whenever they enter a village, she shrinks it for storing in a pouch to avoid traumatizing children. This convinced the Giants that even she can show consideration at times.

1125.lore: The garb of magical medicine expert, Aristela. Its design more closely resembles a nurse's uniform than a sorcerer's or apothecary's robes. With a divine smile, she will easily break down the most stubborn heart. Even Giants cannot hide anything in her presence, as one will unwittingly admit after a few drinks. "If only I knew what she was up to from the start..."

1130.lore: A set of pearls owned by the Demon Kokuri that operate semi-autonomously based on her will. Their power depends on the magical energy of the user, with near limitless potential based on their strength. Despite this, they will react to the slightest weakness in one's thoughts, requiring a high degree of mastery to utilize well. Currently bound to Kokuri, no one else can draw out their power.

1131.lore: A set of nine semi-autonomous pearls that draw their power from the user's thoughts and magical energy. Each is engraved with a different seal, bestowing various traits for attack, defence, binding, and more. Cut from extremely rare magical crystals, very few exist in circulation.

1132.lore: Favorite outfit of the Demon girl Kokuri with a trendy design from a certain Demon nation. Using stretchy fibers that provide a great fit, and firmer fibers that hold the ribbon's shape, one can truly appreciate the level of craftsmanship. However, not much is left to the imagination, leading to criticism from elders.

1136.lore: The weapon wielded by Vox in defense of Granadia. Auge's influence sparked a fearsome transformation in his blade, but the hilt remains the same. This is the result of Juno's blood keeping that dark power in check. Even after her departure, she continues to protect her beloved nation and its people.

1137.lore: Vox's blade after he obtained the Demon Lord's power. Its appearance was greatly altered, now truly befitting a merciless master of combat. The only trace of its former dignity can be seen in its hilt.

1138.lore: Armor worn by Vox after becoming the Demon Lord. Despite its bulk, it is actually formed of his own magic and does not make contact with his body to weigh it down. As long as his power remains and enemies threaten Granadia, it will repel any and all attacks, giving him the name "the Indomitable Demon Lord".

1139.lore: Jay tinkered with his model to remove the energy limiter, greatly amplifying its output. Although the recoil would blow most people off their feet, he takes advantage of the momentum with clever agility. In his hands, it is the perfect combination of maneuverability and power.

1140.lore: A weapon developed by the Machine Norn upon request of Isliid's military. It both forms sabers and fires projectiles with super-condensed optical energy. However, the advantages of mixing close- and long-range attacks come at the cost of absurd complexity. Even one with natural combat expertise like Jay has yet to draw out half of its potential.

1141.lore: Light armor worn by Fenrir Corps soldiers. Based on the design of Captain Roy's coat, it boasts ease of movement, durability, and trendy styling. That look also found great popularity among the public, and a number of imitations cropped up. The official serial number "ISB-E6" was even supplanted by the colloquial name "Blue Jacket".

1142.lore: The pendant of Clyde, one of the Three Blades Masters of the Ancient War. It was awarded to him by the emperor of Isliid at the time, recognizing his status. He normally had little interest in trinkets of the like, but he wore it at every official function and ceremony. That may have been how he showed gratitude to Mashereed, who selected him as knight captain regardless of his commoner status.

1143.lore: The medal of Corsair, one of the Three Blades Masters of the Ancient War. It was awarded by to her by the princess of Bamint at the time. Due to her father's constant admonishment to give up the sword and find a spouse, she felt this provided her with long-desired justification to live as a warrior. However, an ever greater source of joy was the genuine praise from that very same father.

1144.lore: The earrings of Arth, one of the Three Blades Masters of the Ancient War. They were awarded to him by the Gramenian president of the time. He actually declined them at first since the old memory of a fellow Zairyudo pupil weighed on his mind. Quarrels over the nature of their purpose resulted in him abandoning the school. Arth requested a furlough to visit his hometown and settle things between them, since his pride as a swordsman told him he could not be a true master until he did.

1145.lore: Boots carved from the never-melting ice of Stiria. Lighter than standard materials such as steel, they provide superior mobility as well as superior protection. However, this comes with the ever-present threat of frostbite. It is usually mitigated by multiple layers of insulating socks, so most people choose a size two or three increments larger than the proper fit.

1146.lore: The tiara of Feena, one of the Twin Knights of the Morning Star, received in recognition of her feats during the Ancient War. Blessed by a higher God, its overpowering aura repulsed minor Demons. This let it serve as both a symbol of gratitude for her devotion as a former Human and a safeguard against her aiding the enemy.

1147.lore: The helmet of Regulus, one of the Twin Knights of the Morning Star, and standard issue for the Raven's Aegis during the Ancient War. As their mission was to defend the sorcerers, his refusal to carry a shield was akin to heresy. However, his prowess with the blade saved his allies on many occasions, earning their trust enough for them to return the favor. Even after they disbanded with the war's end, he continued to wear this as a keepsake of their bonds.

1154.lore: A bikini Mira secretly prepared for the trip to a beach famous for its picturesque sunsets. Borrowing design trends from Bamint's traditional priestess garb, her bravado to wear such a pared-down look wowed Rayas and the others. Whether or not it had the same evil-warding effect was entirely unrelated to rumors of recent phantom sightings at their destination. Someone as smart and strong and skilled and sexy as her would never be afraid of ghosts.

1155.lore: Trunks worn by Kane for the express purpose of enjoying his vacation. Since becoming president, he was rarely allowed to go anywhere without heavy security detail. He imagined while standing on the coastline wearing nothing but these how his bodyguards would likely faint dead away to see him so vulnerable. Regardless, he was ready to free both body and spirit in a brief return to civilian life.

1156.lore: A swimsuit with a chic design Serah selected for this summer. The hidden pockets and black-and-white coloring suited her occupation...until she remembered that she was originally a research assistant rather than a servant. She decided to put aside her usual habits and have fun on the beach...then started preparing for the BBQ.

1157.lore: A one-piece swimsuit Serah chose for Marika. The scarlet color scheme matches her hair, and the design, used in far-east festivities, draws out her simple appeal. Marika always knew Serah had an eye for fashion, but this particular selection made her think she also liked wordplay.

1158.lore: A swimsuit Zeorg bought for his beloved granddaughter. The wide frills around the shoulders brings to mind a ballerina's outfit. He actually got one in the same design with a different color which completely slipped his mind. Charlotte thought to give that to Valerie since it would go unused otherwise. In contrast to her nonchalant attitude, her friend's eyes were wider than the plates at their favorite buffet.

1159.lore: A swimsuit that Charlotte gave to Valerie after her grandfather accidentally bought another one in a different color. When inside the beach changing room, she could be overheard muttering: "I'm only wearing it to make Lotte happy, not because I think it looks cute or anything like that." Yet despite the stern expression, she gave a slight but unmistakable smile.

1160.lore: A jumbo-sized firework packed with vivid colors. Iris specially ordered it to spread a sparkling garden across summer's clear night sky. Like other fireworks, it was not meant to shoot at living things; Rolly simply knocked it in the general direction of Rayas by accident. Always remember to handle real fireworks with care.

1161.lore: A specially made longboard for Fen. Careful upkeep has staved off wear and tear over the years, allowing for tight turns like no other. His boasts that it lets him overcome any wave are backed up by his total trust in it. Along with Ru as a lure, he needs nothing else to enjoy the summer season.

1162.lore: A reproduction of Marzex's necklace, the source of his healing power. Although inferior to the original, it was made with ore imbued with his residual energy from the site of advent to suitably mimic that effect. It also operates in the same way as his heart of compassion, showing the greatest blessing to the gentle, the benevolent, and the burdened.

1163.lore: A reproduction of Marzex's necklace, the source of his healing power. This particular one contains even more material bathed in the God's aura. This both brings it closer in line to the original's strength and casts a barrier around the holder. As such, it can be said to be the physical manifestation of his protective embrace.

1164.lore: A weapon carried by the attackers of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Strong by nature, Kilmons become even more powerful in the presence of Tufmons and Defmons. Among Spirits, the phrase "Tasmon sword" extols the benefit of fighting in a group rather than by oneself. Yet as Defmons carry shields and Tufmons carry scepters, there is no question that it is a direct reference to Kilmons, those that engage in actual combat.

1165.lore: A shield carried by the defenders of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Sturdy by nature, Defmons become even more resilient in the presence of Kilmons and Tufmons. They wanted to be the focus of a popular phrase like the other two and attempted coining "Tasmon shield" to describe the phenomenon of stability in numbers. However, since it heavily cribbed from an existing idiom, it failed to gain much traction.

1166.lore: A scepter carried by the tacticians of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Clever by nature, Tufmons become even more intelligent in the presence of Kilmons and Defmons. There is a saying among Spirits claiming "Three Tasmons can rival the Ten Divine Forces." It means that it is possible to outwit even the Gods by pooling thoughts together instead of worrying alone. Tufmons are so thrilled by the recognition that they completely disregard its sarcastic undertone.

1167.lore: Boots crafted from the never-melting ice of Stiria. Through endothermic reactions, they absorb almost all heat for perpetuity. This lets them maintain solidity in the hottest environments. The wearer can even walk through a river of lava comfortably, provided it is no deeper than the boots' height.

1168.lore: The overcoat of Captain Riviera. Despite its bulk, the coloring matches her bathing suit and the tough look matches her personality. Although some of her crew found the styling a touch too ostentatious, none were boorish enough to mention it. The ability to switch from mature to childish at the drop of a hat was yet another part of her charm.

1169.lore: A outfit developed to be worn beneath energized armor. The tight fit ensures fabric does not get caught in the machinery, meaning any resemblance to a swimsuit is purely coincidental. Although fairly exact specifications of her physical proportions were needed, the researchers hesitated to ask. They ended up making two variants, and the smaller one was accepted.

1170.lore: Energized armor for Rosetta. It receives power remotely from the Great Granadia, allowing it to operate indefinitely while within range. However, the internal storage capacity is low, so it only takes a few minutes before becoming an unconventional metal cage. Should she get carried away and leave the ship's energy field, it is inevitably up to Berwick to retrieve her from the seafloor.

1171.lore: A swimsuit for Leone in a pretty green hue. As much as she enjoyed previous beach outings, she felt uncomfortably out of place. This year would be different -- she had made plans with Rosetta to wear matching outfits. However, her friend's choice ended up being a little on the cumbersome side, so she decided to instead go with a color matching the shade of her hair for a more sentimental pairing.

1172.lore: Beach footwear for Leone. She slept with them in her arms the night before leaving on vacation, dreaming about strolling across the sandy shores. They fell behind her bed while she slept and were forgotten until arriving at the tropical resort. The fine sand made walking barefoot easy enough, but she felt sorry for her carelessness denying them a chance to shine. In her heart, she promised they would come along next year.

1173.lore: The anchor of her ship, the Granadia, repurposed as a weapon. Although it took several men to raise something of this size, she swung it around with ease like one of her usual battleaxes. "She knows how to handle big, dense things," her shield-bearing colleague remarked while giving a strangely pleasant grin. Having been acquainted with her for years, his tone carried resigned confidence.

1174.lore: Loosely pirate-themed swimwear belonging to Riviera. It was surprisingly chosen by Thetis, although not as a display of thoughtfulness like a surprise gift. Rather, she narrowed down the options to two and gave him the final call. He shut his eyes and pointed randomly at this bombastic burgundy bikini, a perfect fit for someone explosive in several meanings.

1175.lore: A high-tech aerial warship developed by Rosetta. Its speed outclassed every other craft in the Pirate Kingdom. Although many questioned if entering a flying vessel in a nautical competition was fair, she argued there was no rule forbidding it. When it dominated the competition, her response to those grousing that it should have been banned was, "Why not make all the ships fly?" Her gaze was ever fixed on the future, as demonstrated by her next goal to develop a time-travel system.

1176.lore: A swimsuit with a tropical flower motif. She was afraid to wear it last year due to how it left little to the imagination, but the only other people on the private beach were her siblings. Realizing it would be a waste to not enjoy the vacation, she cheerfully cast aside worry and frolicked in the waves. Her mind, free from the concern of prying eyes, could indulge in the skin-caressing breeze...and the habit-forming liberation.

1177.lore: Her ever-reliable swimsuit. Luahn innocently said how jealous he was of her never needing to shop for a new one. After delivering a drop kick to the back of his head, she reconsidered why insinuations of being "small" offended her so much. Petite figures were few and far between, a charming distinction to be carried with pride. Even so, she was frustrated at being unable to land a drop kick on the back of Orvell's head, who was still laughing.

1180.lore: Canaria's lack of expertise caused the edge of this dagger to chip and break. After numerous repairs, sharpness was replaced with durability to make it a dependable ally that takes advantage of her speed. Swift blows can dent steel armor, and flashes of its past cutting ability emerge on fluky occasions.

1181.lore: A dagger with an edge supposedly sharp enough to slice through shadows. It does not work as advertised, but the blade was honed to its limit. This also left it with a complete lack of toughness. A novice would soon chip and break it, yet an expert can rend steel like cloth. Canaria, presently, is the former.

1182.lore: A Fenrir Corps outfit for women, customized with her favorite muffler. Unlike the men's version, it is lighter and simpler in design. This came as a great disappointment to her when she first received it since she hoped to match with Jay. The other members still rib her for that rare display of immaturity.

1183.lore: Golcats will resort to all kinds of trickery to steal from adventurers. This is because obsession with money is a point of pride in their eyes. For this reason, a firm backbone is required in making deals with them. Any offer they feel is unfavorable will be flatly refused, but they pounce at every chance to bilk even one more Gren. "Golcat's got your tongue," is a phrase commonly used to criticize someone driving an unfair trade.

1184.lore: Metal Chickens aspire to learn everything about the world. They travel from country to country, accumulating information in their sturdy bodies. As their stores of knowledge grow, so does their size and weight. Although this causes them to move ever more ponderously, they flap their wings all the same. "Curiosity makes the Metal Chicken fly," is a common adage describing those who ardently work for their goals no matter how heavy their burdens.

1187.lore: A shining blade held by the ultimate ruler, Celia. Having fed upon her ghostly servants, its attacks are greatly strengthened. She can compel them to become sacrifices using her Ancient blood's power, but they do so of their own will. Either it indeed leads the lost to paradise, or they are inspired by her ceaseless efforts to forge an ideal world -- the truth is only known to them.

1188.lore: The treasured weapon wielded by the first princess of Bamint, Celia. Like Grand Scale, it was sealed away underneath the castle. The Ancient script engraved on the blade says, "Rest in peace", letting it become stronger by converting souls into magic. Bamint traditional belief claims the dead move on to a paradise at the edge of the world. This cuts their lingering attachments and guides them there.

1189.lore: Armor worn by the first princess of Bamint, Celia. The shining emeralds give it an elegant air that suits one of her regality. Each gemstone is engraved with advanced defensive symbols from old Bamint, reflecting all attacks when fitted around a bearer of royal blood.

1190.lore: Cute wolf-like gloves begging to be ruffled. Constant requests to pet them annoyed her enough, but it was people who did so without permission that crossed the line. To teach them a lesson, she replaced the most inviting spots of fur with hedgehog spikes.

1191.lore: Long boots modeled after a wolf's legs. Shock-absorbent cushions under the sole in the shape of squishy paw pads allow for sneaking, and the spikes along the toes produce rather painful impacts. However, she was unsettled by the number of people who pleaded to be stomped or kicked.

1192.lore: A handmade staff modeled after Lizalee's. Accurate to the fine details, any fan of the series would give up an arm and a leg for it. Charlotte, after learning it was in fact not official merchandise, was awestruck anew by her friend's obsessi-- enthusiasm.

1193.lore: Tricklock, a royal magician from long ago, sealed his soul inside of this lantern after death. On Halloween nights, he will emerge to play potentially pernicious pranks. Regardless, he is friendly and hard to dislike, and his curses leave smiles on the faces of everyone involved once they are dispelled.

1194.lore: A jet-black dress apparently included with Trick's curse. It was not chosen to suit the tastes of anyone in particular; she simply needed to wear something that fit her smaller body. Although it disappeared along with the spell, its elegance stuck in the mind of a local tailor, who recreated the design while the memory was still fresh.

1195.lore: An incredibly adorable hat. That fact that it is far too small to serve its intended purpose simply adds charm. Combined with her frilly dress, it creates an angel of flawless ebony brilliance. Many who saw her became style-obsessed, making it a cursed item in a sense.

1196.lore: Modeled after the pumpkin-headed monster that roams around threatening tricks if it does not receive treats. One merchant saw a comical charm in his top-heavy appearance and fashioned these dolls. Since he appears only at harvest time, he has already become a symbol of the season, and he will undoubtedly appear during Reigrad's festival this year too.

1197.lore: Wielded by Emperor Isliid, capable of cutting through matter, space, time, events, and consequence. The Crests engraved into its blade read "Build a righteous path" in Ancient language. He said he would use it to open the Fourth Door which leads to the World Tree. His goals are still unknown, but the fact it heeds him proves they have some merit.

1198.lore: Sky Light, made by the Gods, Terra Master, made by the Humans, and Dark Bringer, made by the Demons. Each weapon was specialized in killing the race that crafted them, adding the weight of karma. He took advantage of that as well in order to carry out his grand purpose which turned every living creature into an enemy.

1199.lore: The three Imperial Blades of Emperor Isliid. Only Terra Master originally belonged to Humans; Sky Light and Dark Bringer were stolen from the Gods and Demons respectively. This caused the Ancients who created them all to derisively call him the Usurper. That derision turned into hatred when he stole a treasure of their own, Nirshanal's Orb.

1200.lore: Although presumed to be the oldest of the Ancients' Crest Blades, no specific mention of that could be found in their records. They were powerful enough to destroy matter effortlessly, but it possesses sheer cutting ability unseen among their other artifacts. Its very existence, to say nothing of its purpose, is yet steeped in mystery.

1201.lore: Greatsword of the transforming Demon Pola. Its weight and power grows with the strength of her emotions. She believes that feature is inherent to the weapon, but it is actually a manifestation of her own ability. Altering reality via thought is considered more akin to psychic powers than magic. This is one of several reasons why she is treated differently even among the Great Six Witches.

1202.lore: The greatsword of the cutest, strongest Demon swordswoman Pola. Its weight is tied to the weight of her emotion, and every strike deals huge damage. She becomes frustrated when enemies dodge it since she assumes her thoughts are not getting through, thus making it even heavier. Survival hinges upon carefully measuring the risk of when to accept her feelings.

1203.lore: The dress of Demon swordswoman Pola. She always thoroughly checks herself in the mirror after putting it on. The self-made design, created with much research, hides the seams for a flawless look from every angle. Although her transformation magic should preclude the need to go to such lengths, she feels that handmade clothes bring out the greatest feminine charm.

1204.lore: A Nanoarc shield attached to Zwiber Z. Consuming magic energy lets it alter hardness and shape to repel impacts of any nature. However, that functionality is lost without a power supply, and it has poor fuel efficiency. Such drawbacks did not hinder Zwiber Z by design, but adventurers found trouble in repurposing it.

1205.lore: Carried by Roy along with the Sainted Garb. Symbol of honor in the knighthood, it was ironically granted to him by his assassination target, Emperor Isliid. Roy added the ability to shoot projectiles for that exact purpose. Even after the depth of the emperor's deeds came to light and justified his crime, the fact he used the same method as infamous traitor Hart led many to call him "the Apostate Paladin".

1206.lore: The weapon used by Roy of the Isliid knights. Originally a ritual piece, the sanctification process performed by the emperor imbued it with great magic and the unique imperial property of isolation. This clear divide of the outside from its interior grants a supremely keen edge. In fact, it is superior to all but Rune Sovereign in terms of sheer strength among the national treasures.
