1207.lore: The core of the Sainted Garb worn by Roy. Like Gladius, it contains the magic of the imperial bloodline and its unique isolating properties. That nullifies over 99% of dark energy, letting him carry the Phantom Bullets without falling victim to their soul-warping effect.

1208.lore: One of the Imperial Blades personally decorated by Emperor Isliid for the Christmas festival at the temple. The slogan for this year's event was "Smiles for the people", yet among the reverent congregation, only Noel cracked a grin at the usually majestic sword wreathed in frippery. He hastily apologized for his disrespect, but the emperor gave his own satisfied smile. "I suppose we can call this a success."

1209.lore: A doll that he created himself for Christmas. Using leftover material after finishing Emperor Isliid's, this one unintentionally turned out better. That could not stand even if it was simply the benefit of experience. Challenging himself, he swore to make the next doll for the emperor even more perfect.

1210.lore: A doll made by Noel as a gift for the Christmas festival. It is designed after the otherworld saint Santa Claus, known for spreading joy and cheer to all, and Noel believed there was no one in this world more deserving. Although he knew he could not completely repay his liege for all he had been given, he hoped the show of appreciation would bring a smile to that honorable face.

1211.lore: A doll Mira made for Bamint's royal Christmas party. She still envies her older sister -- how her hair remains like silk even during battle, how her eyes are so piercingly blue, how her smile is warm like the sun...and how she does not let herself be weighed down by such shameful feelings. All of that was poured into Mira's handiwork, enhancing its charm.

1212.lore: A doll made by Canaria for the Fenrir Corps' Christmas party. It was meant to be a decoration for the party venue instead of a present. She also made versions of the other Corps members, so this is in no way, shape, or form a present for that spoony jerk. As a result, she did not expect a word of thanks from him...but skipping the party to cavort in town was an unforgivable infraction. Her fist of justice struck this effigy square in the face.

1213.lore: A doll she made for the Christmas party. She also created one based on every member of the Fenrir Corps as decorations. Despite the careful consideration she put in their arrangement, someone moved hers next to Jay's, her partner, during the night. She wanted to put it back, but that seemed like it would arouse suspicions in her mind. Overtaken by uncertainty, she irrationally punched the effigy of her partner square in the face.

1214.lore: A massive sickle with Saint Groitz's aesthetic sensibilities, reflecting his noble Ancient lineage. It emerges from the coccyx during Revelation. Having absorbed Ego Lu Ville of the Ten Divine Forces, he wields that God's power of judgment. Therefore, would it not be appropriate to call him judge of the modern age? Each strike, laden with justice, landing on the crown of the head probably causes quite a bit of pain. It hurts, doesn't it? Say it hurts!

1215.lore: A Nanoarc shield attached by Zwiber Ω. The shape and nature are adjustable with magic. Although boasting superior heat, shock, and biohazard resistance, it can only handle one of these threats at a time. Defensive shifts also happen according to its own artificial intelligence, spending power against the user's wishes. Research into the Ancients' Nanoarc technology has hardly begun, so details about its workings are unclear.

1217.lore: A musket developed to amplify the senses for flawless accuracy. Whoever holds this can detect hidden enemies and perforate them where they lurk. For all its benefits, protracted battles are dangerous due to the mental burden of maintaining that spell. Merlette, with grace, intelligence, pride, willpower, and elegance, can do so for nearly five times the average timespan.

1218.lore: A musket once used by Merlette's father. It has an enchantment that heightens all five of the holder's senses to their limits. While granting perfect accuracy on visible targets, activating the spell itself demands great concentration. This means not even she has fully mastered it, as shown by an imperfect success rate.

1219.lore: The standard issue outfit of the Fenrir Corps drastically modified by Merlette. Although Canaria doubts it falls within regulations, the superb design and prime Gramenian silk reflects the dignity of an imperial knight. This came at the cost of five months' salary, but she does not mind if it gets too dirty or damaged; there are another nine of equal quality in reserve.

1220.lore: Designated a super-first class artifact of Old Bamint magic, the Ancients created it to store mana. Its noteworthy capacity can purportedly power a freighter for an entire year. However, this is an estimate formed by knowledge gleaned from historic records, as current technology lacks the ability to utilize it to that extent. Hart took it from Azvan's room for a specific purpose.

1221.lore: An unassuming necklace with a simple design. It was believed to provide no benefit to its wearer, only absorbing any mana provided until Hart recognized the pattern from the archives. This led him to discover it was an apparatus of Old Bamint magic created by the Ancients. It can store energy in perpetuity without leakage or decay -- an all-purpose battery.

1222.lore: Battle footgear Hart received from Azvan. His repeated use of speed-boosting magic wore away the soles in less than a month, so he combined physical hardening with friction-increasing spells to add both durability and traction. He applied the same improvements to Emi's shoes, although it was to prevent tripping due to her unrefined gait rather than quick movements.

1223.lore: The weapon that gained the Fire Dragon deity's might after stabbing its heart. That perpetually fervid edge can reduce anything to ash. A great hero once wielded it against a entire army at the cost of his own life. The fearsome display was seared into the minds of all who witnessed it, and the battleground became known as the Hill of Hell.

1224.lore: Grants the blessing of the Water Dragon deity. Previously worn by a mermaid, it was bought by a rich mogul at an auction for a high price under the assumption it was simply a beautiful piece of jewelry. That changed when the town where he lived was struck by a huge flood, starting a rumor that it was cursed by the original owner. It stood to reason since said auction was illegal by nature, dealing in dangerous articles forbidden from sale.

1225.lore: Harnesses the Earth Dragon's power to freely manipulate nature. The holder is granted the fury of a gale and the stoutness of a tree, but their soul withers in return. Most eventually end up as invalids, and the only way to stave off such a fate is to be firm in both heart and body from the start.

1226.lore: Liza's favorite broom transformed by the Shiny Sphere's power. The mint-green ribbon is reminiscent of a perfectly wrapped candy box. It has the baffling ability to produce sweets from the handle when charged with mana, a dream come true for any sugar junkie. However, as it manifested from Liza's mind, their quality is equivalent to whatever she imagines.

1228.lore: A spear that symbolizes a hero of valor. Long ago, a Human warrior dared to challenge the light Dragon deity. When all hope seemed lost, he turned the tables in a desperate attempt and returned with the broken horn as proof of his feat. It was then honed sharp enough to pierce even scales. This weapon's holder is also blessed with a chance at victory no matter how dire the situation, worthy for any spirit that does not quail in the face of distress or adversity.

1229.lore: An axe that symbolizes a lord of villainy. Hewn from a dark Dragon deity's scale, it spills a never-ending stream of miasma. Any living thing it grazes will be seized by panic, leaving them defenseless. This powerful effect comes at the cost of gradually eroding the holder's heart. Unless they are as diabolic and ruthless as a despot, they will not retain their sanity.

1232.lore: Lark's katana transformed after feeding on vast amounts of blood. While a normal sword would become rusted and unusable, the oil in the blood let its flames burn hotter and deadlier in addition to preserving its edge. This weapon, created for Entei-Ryu, was brought to completion by his tenacity.

1233.lore: A long katana handed down to the master of Entei-Ryu. Its characteristic crimson makes the blur from each swing look like a burning flame. Long ago, an otherworld blacksmith who was enchanted by this school of swordplay used ore from his homeland he happened to bring with him to craft it.

1234.lore: Bracers partially made from the somatic cells of Marzex. The wearer will obtain his merciful healing power. No one understands the actual workings behind their restorative properties, but researchers have managed to cultivate his cells from them to conduct further study. It may very well become possible for sinners who do not fear the Gods' judgment to nonetheless receive their grace.

1235.lore: The magical scepter of the Witch of Peace, Elenore, when its true abilities are unleashed. The antique design of its machinery hides a mana control function. Normally, it amplifies or converts its user's power, but by rotating the secret third hand, it can also *REDACTED* space-time itself.

1236.lore: The magic scepter of Elenore, Witch of Peace from the "Six Witches of Grimm Stella". The top is an old clockwork contraption, belying its magical power. It was said her students were reminded of its simple chime whenever they heard a clock tower's bells. She always wore an expression of deep fondness while winding it.

1238.lore: An anti-Stardeity weapon Emi gave to Valerie on a whim. It can assume the shape most suitable for its user -- merely the tip of its unfathomable capabilities. Humans like her can only unlock enough of that potential to fight standard opponents, but while she is in Overflow mode, it can destroy far larger targets.

1239.lore: A weapon that reads the biological information of its user and changes shape to suit them. In Valerie's hands, it turned into a sword as a result of the Hero of Famelle's tutoring. Emi, an Ancient who settled into Reigrad, gave it to her without mentioning its original purpose of fighting Stardeities. It will bring out its true power upon mastery, but as far as Valerie is presently concerned, it is only an "extremely sharp sword".

1240.lore: The weapon of the Demon intent on taking back the Moonchild. Made of blood, it has the ability to transform at will. Besides the length of the blade posing a threat, it can sling small projectiles. He also uses it as the origin point of his Realm of Red in which he holds complete control. Entering it ensures death as the victim's vision is filled with blood, both that of his blades and their own.

1241.lore: The weapon of the Demon who attacked Rayas' party. Ultra-condensed blood is fashioned into a blade of fearsome sharpness. It can also be instantly reformed should it break. One must never let down their guard against him, particularly since he can create another edge at any time.

1242.lore: A cutlass-and-pistol pairing owned by Azel. As adherent to the creed of "the best defense is a good offense" (in his words, "only idiots get hit"), he opted for weapons of pure aggression, covering close and long ranges. These specific models are relatively common, but he proves that sufficient talent can work with tools of any quality.

1243.lore: Bracers made from the cells of Marzex after he was defeated by a heroic warrior. Their incredible healing abilities prompted trials as all-purpose military gear, but a problem soon presented itself: they would bond to the skin if worn for too long. Although this demonstrated their power is based on promoting cell regeneration, the underlying principles are still unclear. That is the researchers' greatest concern at present.

1244.lore: The blade of the God swordsman Luahn, the might of the Ama-no-Yuraragi's spirit living in him made manifest. It heavily favors sharpness over resilience. The extremely thin metal is vulnerable to strikes from the side and demands exact accuracy from its holder. Having gained mastery in the Gran Verge school from his father and his brother, he can wield it without difficulty.

1245.lore: The weapon held by the God swordsman, Luahn. A physical manifestation of the Dragon Ama-no-Yuraragi's power, its extreme sharpness is comparable to Sky Light's. Although this leaves it with low durability, the Dragon's spirit residing in Luahn can instantly regenerate wear and tear along the edge, but not without a stream of complaints regarding "ungraceful swordsmanship".

1246.lore: Battle garb of the God swordsman Luahn. Like his weapon, it is formed by the power of Ama-no-Yuraragi spirit's living inside of him. It offers little in the way of defense, and its billowing fabric does not allow for quick movements. Instead, the Dragon, seeking elegance even in combat, created every last detail to turn the wearer into a spectacle, including the enhancement of their physical capabilities.

1247.lore: A spear transformed by the treasure of the merfolk into a supremely powerful trident. Although originally meant for recreation, it gained the sea deity's power over currents. It also forms a layer of air around the holder to permit underwater breathing. She relished in the mermaid-like experience, cavorting through the seas, but soon remembered her lungs still had Human limitations.

1248.lore: An umbrella with extra UV blocking by her demand. Sunlight is the archenemy of a fair complexion, but she places absolute faith in this defensive shade, calling it the "sacred protection field". However, some of her servants are concerned its complete coverage precludes the need for applying suntan lotion.

1249.lore: The harpoon she purchased on the Beasts' island to catch fish. She painted the handle to add an eye-catching gradation, but it caught the eyes of potential prey as well, driving them away. She then switched to a regular rod and reel out of disappointment and found instant success.

1250.lore: A light blue bikini with a frilly skirt as sparky as the southern seas. Its design balances adult allure and youthful charm. She bought it from a shop then added a ribbon to the top and the belt to the bottom. Her intent was to give a touch of coolness for a thorough representation of herself, but everyone's impression was more "hot".

1251.lore: Unsparingly cute sunglasses with heart-shaped frames and pink-tinted lenses that never fail to draw attention. Although they can come off as awkward on the wrong person, they bring out her adorable side despite her tough demeanor. That being said, their unusual shape and color make normal use awkward, so she leaves them on her head.

1252.lore: A sun umbrella wide enough to cover even her imposing stature. She naturally prepared it for protection from the sun, but she had a blacksmith modify it for self-defense as well, giving it a solid steel shaft to drive into enemies. Although she expected this vacation to be full of contingences, it was touch-and-go from the moment she landed on the island. As a result, her acquaintances only saw it as a weapon.

1253.lore: A luxurious dark purple swimsuit received from a boutique with ties to the royal family. Her servants examined each option before deciding on it. The unique design, the lace around the top, and the golden embroidery required days of work from Bamint's finest tailor. The sight of her wearing this, the veil flapping around her curvaceous figure, did not just sway the hearts of her servants but anyone who witnessed it.

1254.lore: Glasses with photochromatic lenses for adjustable UV protection. They darken like sunglasses under outdoor light but return to full clarity in shelter. Although she looks stylish when wearing them either normally or atop her head, there is a fierce debate among her servants as to which placement suits her best.

1255.lore: An explosive in the shape of a missile. Iris wanted something that would blossom brilliantly among the stars, giving her friends a spectacle to vividly remember for the rest of their lives. Answering her request, the pyrotechnician filled this with extra magic (gunpowder). The finished product made not just flowers bloom in the sky but smiles bloom on the ground.

1256.lore: The surfboard Fen uses to shoot the curl on his rare getaways. His picture-perfect form is comprised of three pieces. First is his technique that neither fights nor surrenders to the flow. Second is his long-time companion that acts like an extension of his body. Last but not least is his patience that lets him wait until the biggest wave of the year arrives...all while the furry self-proclaimed fourth piece clings tight.

1257.lore: The interior part of her Rosetta Arm. Since the researches could only take visual estimate of her measurements, they created two sizes. The smaller one was a near-exact fit, but she insisted to hold the other in reserve "to account for future developments". The researchers silently relented, hoping her expectations were misplaced.

1258.lore: The swimsuit Riviera wears as a pirate captain. Its design fully employs her generous proportions, but the scant coverage does not give much protection. Regardless, she wore it in the thick of every cannonball-laden naval battle. Most of her crew, including her shield-bearing first mate and defensive expert, wondered why she did not choose something with anti-ballistic properties, yet they felt unable to speak their mind.

1260.lore: "My name is Eska Chroma the Sentient Blade, a weapon forged for the Ancient hero Prometheus to slay the Tellurian Deity. My shape and function change according to the will of my holder for optimal performance. Only those who carry the genes of Prometheus can wield my power. To anyone else, I am no more than an iron lump."

1261.lore: The original form of Exceed Zechs after shedding its evil appearance in response to Charlotte's will. A furious blaze courses through the metal and leaps out with each swing. However, this deadly effect requires being held by a True Master, meaning her. It also consumes a great amount of mana in a short time, demanding focus to prevent overexertion even with her ample reserves.

1262.lore: Wolf-like gloves Charlotte wore on Halloween night. She became so caught up in the excitement of the holiday that she even spoke in nothing but barks and howls. However, this started to get on her friend's nerves. "You're starting to get on my nerves." This direct remark finally elicited something else from her mouth: a mournful whine.

1263.lore: A witch-like outfit Valerie wore on Halloween night. The girly frills and ribbon clashed with her cool attitude in a positive way. Despite insisting up and down that she looked awkward in it, her friend's deluge of compliments was enough to convince her of the very slight possibility she might be a tiny bit cute. The reality of her profound charm was yet unimaginable.

1264.lore: The ink-black dress Forte wore on Halloween night. Its intricate design gave this pint-sized commander the appearance of an actual doll. She owns clothes of a similar fashion, so it was not the look itself that she found objectionable rather than how Charlotte and Valerie fawned over everything she did. She seemingly disliked being treated as a child...except for the hoard of free candy she received.

1265.lore: The weapon held by the Divine Knight commander Platina. Also known as the Dream Eater, it consumes the memories of its wielder. Continued use causes them to forget more and more of their past. She has yet to show any significant change, yet that remains to be seen if this is because of her staunch will resisting its effects or if they are still in their initial stages.

1266.lore: The sacred sword of Divine Knight leader Platina, granted to her by Uther. Crafted from high-purity Prima Ether, it contains the memories and thoughts of its previous holders. She draws upon that battle experience, applying it to her own technique. Whoever clashes against her may feel as if they are fighting several warriors at the same time.

1267.lore: Blessed armor supplied to the leader of the Divine Knights. It has high magic defense since the main function is protecting against Demon attacks. Being the first female commander, this was custom-made for her body. Aesthetic additions like the apron-like cloth give it a beauty not seen in the male version. Naturally, she was too stoic for such demands; they came from her closest comrade, the shield-carrying Human, who wished for her to look breathtaking on the battlefield.

1268.lore: The huge bludgeon of the Rabbit Squad's vice-captain. The construction ship Arceos manufactured it based on her specified design along with the large reserve supply in its storeroom. Whenever one breaks, a gate is immediately opened to provide her with a replacement. It has undergone a number of upgrades over time, and this is the third iteration.

1269.lore: A ponderous battle club carried by Spirit soldier Natasha. The violet gem inside the head aids and enhances her spatial manipulation abilities along with releasing gravity waves to pull enemies after being thrown. The weapon's name comes from the burst of purple-tinged electricity when she activates that ability.

1271.lore: The paired swords of King Gran Verge. Grand Destin's power of light contains the wills of previous monarchs to bestow inexhaustible determination. Gramlude's power of shade changes anger into strength to overcome the greatest adversities. As both their weights and natures are mirror opposites, simultaneous wielders were rare in the country's history. Thus, Orvell may be the greatest warrior-lord Gran Verge has ever seen.

1272.lore: Grand Destin and Gramlude wielded by Orvell. Both made of pure Prima Ether, they respond to the holder's will to create miracles. Long ago, the Ancients bestowed arms to their protectors, the Twelve Knights. Gran Verge of the Light received Grand Destin, and Zainzald of the Dark Flame took Gramlude. Gran Verge would later establish a kingdom bearing his name, meaning he is Orvell's forebear.

1273.lore: The garb of Gran Verge of the Light, a member of the Twelve Knights who protected the Ancients. Its brilliance drives away evil, preventing lesser monsters from approaching the wearer. Although most of the Knights' equipment was provided by the Ancients, he secretly asked a God blacksmith to craft this. Clues to his reasoning can be found in the history between the Ancients and his kingdom.

1274.lore: A unique spear-like weapon wielded by the audacious transfer student Menas. It slices, dices, pierces, shatters, burns, and melts, hence its "all-purpose" label. With such versatility, digging to the other side of the world is possible in theory. Curiously, the fragmentary data inside of Yuzukichi's memory bank claims its purpose is to build rather than destroy.

1275.lore: The polearm-shaped weapon used by the amnesiac girl Menas. Essentially a spear, it is stored inside of her support mecha Yuzukichi until necessary. How this is possible despite the obvious size discrepancy is unclear. Yuzukichi claims it has legendary status but provides no details to elucidate. Regardless, the edge is keen enough to easily slice boulders.

1276.lore: A stuffed doll crafted by Venna. When Firyl asked about the reindeer theming, she explained the animal's sharp antlers suited his no-nonsense nature, along with it representing her wish for him to acquire the same iron will that let it survive the inhospitable tundra. Naturally, that was an off-the-cuff answer to hide the true meaning: "We're gonna work you so hard, you'll be begging to pull sleighs, newbie."

1277.lore: A stuffed doll crafted by Venna. Although resembling a legendary philanthropist from another world, Azel thought reindeer looked cooler. However, she always saw him as having the same generosity. It was something she would never put in words, but she was forever grateful he welcomed her aboard his ship.

1278.lore: A stuffed doll crafted by Venna. "Why'd you make yourself so cute? It looks too weird without that feral side of yours." She would take mercy on Azel's unsparing criticism at her self-rendering as the kind-hearted patron of another world and clobber him using a piece of lumber without a nail driven through the end. Amid Firyl's awkward attempts to stop her and Yuna and Claire's hearty laughter, they would spend the festive night with the usual jollity.

1279.lore: A festive version of her bunny suit devised in a stroke of inspiration. She enthusiastically revealed its charming design to Hart only to receive another subdued reaction: "Cute." Noticing how he hastily averted his gaze, she realized her appeal was still lacking. Regardless, her innocent affection encouraged her to try harder next year.

1280.lore: A version of Rune Sovereign with unique light trails for the holidays. As the genuine article is kept under maximum security deep below the surface, this is a replica Noel forged from memory. Although barely usable as a weapon, the shape is authentic, with added details of holly leaves around the hilt and snowflake patterns for magic circles. Imagining his emperor holding the original brought a smile to his face, and he could only hope he was watching over him now with the same smile.

1281.lore: Noel's interlocking swords festooned for the winter season. The custom of holiday celebrations have permeated into even the small town giving him refuge, and the shops are filled with bright trinkets. He places these next to a decorated replica of the emperor's sword. Despite knowing it is a brazen gesture, he believes the emperor would permit it. His only regret is being unable to share such a moment sooner, as snow falls for the first time on a Raktehelm without an Emperor Isliid.

1284.lore: A jeweled scepter described within the chronicles of the Isliid Library Ruins. It earned its name from the water-blue gem clutched by the shaft in the shape of a sorcerer's arm. Few theorize it is an actual limb severed by someone intent on seizing his magical talent. As ludicrous as this notion is, the depravity of Human greed across history lends it believability.

1285.lore: Found upon the shelves of the Isliid Library Ruins. It contains the records of an unspecified Human nation that differs from the known customs and cultures of Isliid, Bamint, Gramenia, Famelle, and La Riiz. Scholars debate over two possibilities: there was a sixth country that no longer exists, or the text is pure fiction.

1286.lore: A mechanized blade described within the chronicles of the Isliid Library Ruins. Vibrations induced by the network of spinning cogs enhances its cutting ability. Humans presumably invented this during the Ancient War. Being physically inferior to the other Races, they were forced to maximize efficiency in their killing implements.

1287.lore: Glass tubes described within the chronicles of the Isliid Library Ruins. They can convert even well water into a miraculous elixir overnight. The labels themselves contain no magic power, so the effect apparently comes from the inscriptions, since they were also used for sorcery in the Isliid region long ago.

1288.lore: A full helmet described within the chronicles of the Isliid Library Ruins. It is enchanted to block all outside interference, allowing the wearer to focus even against a throng of foes. Although this also means voices cannot be heard, those who believe words have no meaning in battle do not see it as a drawback. Rather, the argument over who will serve as the lone distraction will happen before it is donned.

1290.lore: The beloved weapon of Leone Templar and member of the Adventurers' Guild Reigrad branch Rosetta. It is also called the Star Crest Blade for the countless Crests engraved into the metal. As each one contains great power, most swords can only withstand a handful before shattering under the burden. The fact this holds far beyond the norm is thanks to the Prima Ether reinforcement technique of God sorceress Liza.

1291.lore: The enchanted sword of Leone Templar and member of the Adventurers' Guild Reigrad branch Rosetta. Crests, letters imbued with the Ancients' power, are engraved into the metal. Invented by her after exhaustive research, she dramatically named it the "Star Crest Blade" due to how those Crests sparkled with each swing.

1292.lore: The silver armor of Leone Templar and member of the Adventurers' Guild Reigrad branch Rosetta. She received it from the second princess of a certain principality as thanks for keeping her company. The elegant, novel design reflects its origin from a country of the arts. Although it has only adequate durability and resilience, she adores how light and stylish it is.

1293.lore: A staff with a golden jewel discovered in the skyward ruins of Famelle. The "stillness" in its name does not imply the importance of silence but how miracles are powered by unspoken will and not chanted words. It reads the wielder's mind and activates the spell as desired, creating a similar effect as limit casting mastered by a genius magician from Isliid. The difference is this does not demand his high-speed calculations.

1294.lore: An aged book discovered in the skyward ruins of Famelle. It holds the chronicles of Godkind, largely focusing on battles against the Demons. As such, they are portrayed as virtuous while all who oppose them are painted as evil. Although less accurate in comparison to other historic records, some scholars find value in how it establishes their self-image as flawless beings.

1295.lore: A silver weapon discovered in the skyward ruins of Famelle. The blade, shaped like layered feathers, is imbued with flying magic. It was originally made to allow aerial movement, but the speed required for that function also resulted in unavoidable attacks. A lack of caution -- or grip strength -- will cause what is called an Angel's Trick where it escapes the holder's hand mid-stroke.

1296.lore: Glass bottles discovered in the skyward ruins of Famelle. These were actually brought into the ruins by a team of intrepid adventurers. Among them are a salve for deep wounds, a panacea for any condition, a solution to fill an empty stomach, and other potions suitable for a lengthy journey. However, preparation alone was not enough, as the corpses around this pouch attested.

1297.lore: A blessed kettle hat discovered in the skyward ruins of Famelle. It enhances one's sight to the degree of clairvoyance. When presented with world-encompassing vision, some wearers are overcome by the illusion of omnipotence. However, this is eventually shattered by the sheer volume of information inducing a motion sickness-like condition commonly seen among the uninitiated.

1300.lore: The mask of Misette, princess of the oldest life forms on Raktehelm, the Ancients. Its purpose is not defensive but restrictive, hampering her golden power that produced the Eight Great Races. Although its output is lowered to 0.0002%, she is still able to instantly create a huge arsenal, cross vast distances, and obliterate an army of thousands. Possessing might that exceeds even the Gods' comprehension, her epithet of "The Supreme Witch" is all too appropriate.

1301.lore: The mask worn by princess of the Ancients Misette. She is unable to remove it herself. It has three effects: restraining power, obstructing vision, and sealing memories. The memory seal is in tandem with the procedure carried out by the God sleeping inside of her. That doubled weight makes it easy to imagine the weight of truth hidden beneath should it come undone.

1302.lore: A staff with a dark jewel discovered inside the temple ruins of Gormarey. It gradually alters the holder's internal mana with every spell cast. When the conversion is complete, increased mana affinity allows it to use powerful arcana. This seems like a benefit, but the tampered mana is incompatible with other staves. Since this makes even simple magic impossible without it, those who rely upon it must be prepared to become totally reliant.

1303.lore: A weathered book discovered inside the temple ruins of Gormarey. It contains records of the Demons' wars. Of special note is the in-depth accounts of fallen fighters: their personalities, their final actions, and so on in minute detail. Those who sought power to stave off death eventually came to understand death's meaning. The focus on accomplishment and passing resembles the philosophy of Human warriors from the far east.

1304.lore: A gnarled weapon discovered inside the temple ruins of Gormarey. It is fashioned from the strongest bone among thousands of cadavers. Rather than its sharpness, its weight and hardness are far more lethal. However, that very weight makes it difficult to handle. The name comes from the shout of exertion which usually accompanies hefting its mass.

1305.lore: A set of glass containers discovered inside the temple ruins of Gormarey. They have a curious property when filled: three transform the contents into a lethal poison while the fourth transforms liquid into a miraculous medicine. As determining which is which can be nearly impossible, physicians cynically call it the Death Roulette.

1306.lore: A silver helmet discovered inside the temple ruins of Gormarey. The interior is isolated from the world outside, practically creating an entire world. This means attacks to the head, especially mind-control spells, are completely ineffective. In return, the wearer perceives time as running slower than normal, and this disparity with their physical actions frays at the nerves until insanity takes hold.

1307.lore: The superheavyweight weapon of Lazuli's military commander, Erens. When he swings it with his full might, it can alter the very landscape. Being manufactured by the company, it received no official name. However, its resultant tremors sounded as the very land groaning in the ears of his opponents, who gave it this informal appellation.

1308.lore: A storybook overflowing with Selia's imagination. The forbidden "Literary Fragment" technique lets her freely materialize the fictional elements described in its pages, including mythological beings. The white bird that flies above the land of the dead, Ryougen Hakuhou, is one such monster. This ability to create matter from nothing resembles Misette's Golden Power.

1309.lore: A storybook written by the Witch Selia. It contains a wealth of her tales, and she is able to bring the entities mentioned inside into reality. However, this technique requires the power of imagination, so she can only create what she can imagine. For example. since she dislikes celery, she cannot produce celery that would satisfy celery lovers.

1310.lore: The sword given to the King Jayn Royal Memorial Academy Higher Education Division's student council secretary and disciplinary head. Its sharpness is incomparable to the other students' weapons. Being conscious of his position, he feels carrying a blade much stronger than the norm is unfair. However, the members are unanimous in their support, claiming that very notion makes him worthy of it.

1311.lore: The blade of Huma, one of Princess Echika's Four Schoolmates. It has a far sharper edge than the swords carried by other students. Combined with his outstanding technique, he is a match for a hundred opponents. This is not a metaphor; he actually triumphed over that exact number during a sparring session (cutting off one's armor counts as their loss). The feat also gave him his nickname of the Sword.

1313.lore: An exquisite sword from the far east wielded by Sumera-ryu master Emperor Isliid. Both incredibly sharp and lightweight, it perfectly suits the school's focus on swiftness. Word claims that enacting the secret technique Raiko with this weapon will produce an unavoidable attack surpassing the speed of light. None can verify the truth, yet none have been able to evade it.

1314.lore: The brilliant sword of Emperor Isliid. The historic emperors passed it down along with their mastery of Sumera-ryu. The customary sun motif of the hilt lends it a grandeur equal to any of the Imperial Blades. Although seemingly meant for ceremonial use, it has been used in battle for ages. The alternate name of Mutant Slayer was earned by being the sole weapon that can pierce their flesh.

1316.lore: The bracelet Valerie the adventurer wears as she travels alongside Rayas through Altohelm. An experimental medical device to address her innate mana deficiency, it provides what her body cannot produce. She can also choose to remove the limit and supersaturate herself with energy, pushing her physical abilities to their extreme.

1317.lore: The dress uniform of Verzard, trusted retainer of Erath the Paraselene of the Great Six Demons. Imbued with unique magic, it aids him in controlling the Red World's power. He can exert an invasive effect over the real world using it. That strength is by nature too great for any of the Eight Great Races to command, but his ability to do so is one of many enigmas yet surrounding him.

1319.lore: Worn during the Fenrir Corps' "heat acclimation training" on the beach. Although the design has a greater focus on cuteness than allure compared to other bikinis, wearing it still demanded bravery on her part. What she lacked in experience was compensated with all the effort she could muster, and she believed that effort would be rewarded. As for her anticipated reward...

1320.lore: Worn during the Fenrir Corps' "heat acclimation training" on the beach. He tried surfing for a relatively honest reason: "Might impress the ladies." Indeed, his first attempt on the waves earned him the attention of every female along the shore. As the sun set, a swarm of women invited him to a nearby bar. One thing led to another, and by morning, he was begging his junior to borrow Gren yet again.

1321.lore: Worn during the Fenrir Corps' "heat acclimation training" on the beach. It was her secret weapon to win Jay's heart. Everything was manufactured to his tastes: the design, the exposure, and above all, the class. As he apparently distanced himself as of late, she hoped to close the gap in one fell swoop. If needed, she could even resort to skin contact. Her bold yet elegant battle had only just begun.

1324.lore: What he wore during swim breaks while searching for treasure among the south islands. His purchase was settled from the moment he laid eyes on the falcon-shaped flame design. He flaunted it before arriving like a giddy child, putting off even Venna and Yuna. However, Firyl was pleased to see this yet-unfamiliar side to the captain.

1325.lore: What she wore during swim breaks while searching for treasure among the south islands (despite not being invited). The white, wine-red, and black coloring brings to mind a fancy deck of playing cards. Azel, seeing that it was clearly made-to-order, recalled how embarrassed she was by Azel's prancing the day before and quipped, "Like you're any less excited."

1326.lore: What Firyl wore during swim breaks while searching for treasure among the south islands. These were provided by the Company for long-distance swimming practice. Azel mocked his lack of a personal style, but he found himself no less attached to them. The symmetric lines and wave-patterned accent along with the snug fit made for suitable performance. This summer, he was determined to not let others influence his preferences.

1327.lore: Captain Riviera's beach sandals. Although she normally wears boots in preparation for rough seas and roughhousing, sometimes she'll sport these as if ready to enjoy a quick dip. Her shield-bearing crewman warns such exposure is dangerous, but she retorts that boots with a swimsuit is "weird". He briefly considers mentioning her insistence on wearing a swimsuit could also be seen as weird, but he defers to her (or his) preference.

1335.lore: Fen, having returned to the beach to take his surfboarding to the next level, reveals this feather-shaped accessory around his waist. Its light blue color perfectly fits the tropical summer scenery. His fuzzy companion asks if the weight won't be a hindrance, but he just shrugs in response. Surfing is addictive because it is play. Anyone who seeks to master it must not forget that, and this represents his playful side.

1344.lore: The twin swords of hunter girl Atra. Left behind by the primordial Beast known as the Fanged Hunter, her tribe of those descendants used them for hunting across generations. Though they are formal implements of honorable origin, she will not hesitate to dissect game with them. She claims they conveniently slice through the toughest parts with ease. However, due to sanitary concerns, they are not brought out when cooking.

1345.lore: The weapon of hunter girl Atra, said to be one of the armaments among the Legacy of the Fanged Hunter. A Meister of the Ancients developed this Ether-driven mechanical bow that could be split into a pair of blades. Attaching the handles to each other would reform the bow shape, but its mysterious construction shortens the two shafts into the length of one.

1364.n: Good Wife Wise Princess Santa Blade

1385.lore: A substance she created while trying to make chocolate for Valentine's Day. The ooze inside the bowl wobbles and moans as if alive (what she calls "lovesick sighs"). Its formation is all the more baffling due to how it contains no unusual ingredients. Hart found its taste relatively normal, but he lost consciousness soon after swallowing. Anyone else who dares take a bite of this culinary surprise should have a remedy on hand.

1402.lore: The gigantic weapon of undercover agent Simon. When loaded with an Origin Bullet cartridge, the scythe shifts into a mallet shape. Slamming the protruding tip into a target generates explosive force, enough for a certain kill according to the inventor's claims.

1403.lore: The scythe Simon wields as the feared Undertaker. Capable of both slashing and bludgeoning, such sheer offensive focus gives it massive destructive potential. A single swing can annihilate most any foe. In his hands, this uncivilized weapon takes on a mystical aura.

1408.lore: Simon's outfit order-made from the town tailor. The black color scheme and gothic styling show his commitment to living in the shadows and bearing his secret mission. Slits around the waist allow for quick movements while the belt anchors his torso for greater force in swinging his weapon.

1410.lore: The official name is "Ultra Emotional Fusion Sword". When the emotion of the two magical girls' hearts flare in unison, they can overlap Igniters to transform them into the "ultimate strongest" form. That edge of cleansing fire can annihilate any evil. Although it lives up to its "ultimate" label, the one shortcoming is how long it takes to meet the necessary conditions.

1411.lore: They are successor models of Professor Liza's Emotion Booster given to her younger sister Cestina (of the original Primawitches) during the battle against secret society Ghost a year ago. They were made to suit the new users, in colors of red and blue, to fight off the Muma Kingdom's sudden invasion.

1412.lore: The swimsuit-style outfit worn by Charlotte after transforming in episode 16 of "The Magical Primawitches - Twin Fairies". This was its only appearance in the series, feeding on her desire to play on the beach. Although functionally identical to the usual outfit, Charlotte's Summer Passion Power increased its mana transmission speed, boosting the fusion sword's destructive force.

1413.lore: The swimsuit-style outfit worn by Valerie after transforming in episode 16 of "The Magical Primawitches - Twin Fairies". This was its only appearance in the series, feeding on her longing to swim in the ocean. She was very fond of the design, going so far as to take selfies of herself modeling it in the cafe's break room after battle.

1414.lore: She remembered having bought a similar article long ago. It was for the private inquiry of a tropical tourist spot, a secret mission with Sieg, Freed, and that other person. She chuckled to think about the fun they had, then her mind turned to how it was almost botched because of the two boneheads. That was enough to ever-so-slightly sour her mood.

1415.lore: She thought about the concept of "cute". Henrietta told her to "pick a cute swimsuit", but she lacked the sense to recognize it. To her, functionality was all that mattered in clothing. After asking for the shop clerk's opinion, along with receiving some abrupt input from Henrietta, she ended up choosing this.

1416.lore: Torch-shaped items invented by Professor Liza installed with second-generation transformational devices. They light the flame of emotion in the holder's heart to change her into a magical girl. The fire's shape can also shift into any weapon imaginable. The form of a blade is known as Sword Mode.

4001.lore: A supernatural bow only obtained on rare occasions by those who defeat Inferno Dragon Degilmagna. Even fewer have used it, for it demands Godlike might to do so. Those who can are feared as demigod avatars of the Inferno Dragon. According to one regional fairy tale, the Winter of Thaumazein was ended by a single bolt from this bow, firmly establishing its reputation.

4002.lore: A supernatural instrument only obtained on rare occasions by those who defeat Azure Phoenix Freydal. Even fewer have used it, for it demands Godlike might to do so. Those who can are feared as demigod avatars of the Azure Phoenix. Minstrels have immortalized that power in song, telling how its melody of diamond dust could cover the entire world in a sheet of pure silver.

4003.lore: A supernatural whip that rarely appears to those who have subdued Elpnuemas. As merely handling it demands God-like strength, none have mastered it use. Regardless, owning it is enough to become revered as the Dragon's demigod emissary. The barb at the end is coated in the same poison used to punish those who defile the sacred woods, rotting the flesh like overripe fruit.

4004.lore: A supernatural blade that rarely appears to those who have subdued Radachne. As merely handling it demands God-like strength, none have mastered it use. Regardless, owning it is enough to become feared as her demigod emissary. All of its victims are sent to the world of everlasting darkness where they will find sorrowful rest in the Insect Princess' embrace.

4005.lore: A supernatural weapon that rarely appears to those who have subdued Code XTF: Eraser. As merely handling it demands God-like strength, none have mastered it use. Regardless, the very act of owning it is enough to command fear as an incarnation of slaughter. Many technicians have tried to reverse-engineer it, but a perfect reproduction has yet to be made.

4006.lore: A supernatural shield that rarely appears to those who have subdued Tonetaurus. As merely handling it demands God-like strength, none have mastered it use. Regardless, the very act of owning it is enough to command fear as an emissary of lightning. It gathers particles from the air to produce powerful shocks, reducing any weakling who touches it into ash. Whoever is able to carry this is a superior being worthy of ruling the world.

4007.lore: A supernatural substance that rarely appears to those who have subdued Oldeus. As merely handling it demands God-like strength, none have mastered it use. Regardless, the very act of owning it is enough to command fear as one who controls the fate of all life. It has Oldeus' power to summon the souls of the dead, but this is highly taboo for how it drastically affects the world.

4008.lore: A supernatural sword that rarely appears to those who survive against Ragsherum Phantom. Since wielding it demands equally supernatural strength, the mere act of ownership makes one as feared as an undead creature. The many grudges inside eat away at the holder's heart, eventually transforming them into a true phantom.

4009.lore: A supernatural helmet that very rarely appears to those who survive against Ragsherum Phantom. Since wearing it demands equally supernatural strength, the mere act of ownership makes one as revered as a higher deity. When its true power is unleashed, the accumulated hatred of the Demons will burst forth, ravaging the world in a torrent of magic.

4013.lore: A rare potion that can be obtained from defeating the enormous phoenix Flogassa. Though rumored to offer a power beyond mortal comprehension, the veracity of this is yet unclear since many who have taken it perished as a result. Whether it is panacea or poison, one thing for certain is whoever seeks strength must own it in sufficient measure as well. What is imperative is not a worthy cause but a will stout enough overcome the fear of death.

4014.n: Super Divine Tool "Frozen Lake White Phoenix"

5001.lore: Head armor only those who held back a calamity may wear. It shines beautifully, like the stars twinkling in the sky.

5002.lore: Chest armor worn by those who stand against calamity. Its ill-starred look fills all who see it with awe.

5003.lore: Arm armor holding the tremendous power of the King of the Skies. A blow from these arms splits the sky.

5004.lore: Waist armor marked by a commanding red. Power wells up as if you had become a wyvern yourself.

5005.lore: Rathian head armor that gains new performance from special techniques and Hyper materials.

5006.lore: Rathian leg armor that gains new performance from special techniques and Hyper materials.

5007.lore: A Sword & Shield made from Thunderlord materials. Its wielder fills the Hunter Arts gauge faster.

5008.lore: An elegant katana left by a warrior hailed as a god of war. Its blade, lovely as the dawn moon, cuts down all who stand in the way.

5009.lore: A crimson great sword holding the power of a Flame Dragon. Despite its noble look, one swing turns everything for a league around into scorched earth.

5010.lore: Kirin chest armor that gains new performance from special techniques and Hyper materials.

5011.lore: A deep-green hunting bow framed with Rathian shell. Its graceful bend is like the body of a queen.

5012.lore: A Palico great sword made from Rathalos scraps. Each slash spouts flames like a Rathalos's breath.

5013.lore: The scissor blade used by Ryuko Matoi. It was made in order to fight against Goku Uniforms and can cut Life Fibers. She only carries half of the scissor and, for some reason, she is searching for the one who holds the other blade.

5014.lore: The favorite sword of Satsuki Kiryuin. For most weapons it is impossible to cut Life Fiber, but not for Bakuzan. This incredible ability is the result of the skill of Satsuki, who can unleash its fullest potential.

5015.lore: The Two-Star Goku Uniform that was given to Mako Mankanshoku, the president of the Fight Club. She was originally considered a No Star student but unexpectedly revealed battle powers beyond imagination when wearing this Two-Star Goku Uniform.

5016.lore: The weapon chosen by Mako Mankanshoku, a student at Honnouji Academy. When wearing the Fight Club-Spec Two-Star Goku Uniform, she puts this knuckle on her fist to punch her enemies without mercy. Though a simple weapon that merely strengthens her fist's impact, its destructive power is extremely high.

5017.lore: The sentient black sailor uniform created by Ryuko Matoi's father, Isshin Matoi. It is made purely from Life Fiber which mere mortals cannot wear. It awakens and unleashes its power by absorbing Ryuko's blood. Only Ryuko can hear Senketsu's voice.

5018.lore: Another Kamui created by Ryuko Matoi's father, Isshin Matoi. Like Senketsu, it is made only from Life Fiber, which mere mortals cannot wear. The burden for the wearer, Satsuki Kiryuin, is so severe she cannot wear it for long.

5019.lore: The cape that Saitama, a professional Hero, wears during his superhero activites.

5020.lore: The mechanical arm of the S-Class Hero Genos. Countless weapons are installed inside.

5021.lore: The red gloves that Saitama, a professional Hero, wears during his superhero activites.

5022.lore: The red boots that Saitama, a professional Hero, wears during his superhero activites.

5023.lore: The trademark black dress worn by the S-Class Rank-2 Hero, Terrible Tornado.

5024.lore: Saichi Sugimoto's trusted firearm. It was issued for the Imperial Japanese Army and was well regarded for its good accuracy and range. By attaching a bayonet to the end of the gun, it can also be used in close-range combat.

5025.lore: The cap that Sugimoto always wears. It was worn by those in the Imperial Japanese Army, so it was quite common. For whatever reason, Sugimoto almost never takes his cap off.

5026.lore: The bow favored by Asirpa. Although it is very flexible, it is still quite tough. Poison coats the tips of the arrowheads. Once pierced by one of these poisoned arrows, even a brown bear would die within ten steps.

5027.lore: The bandana always worn by the Ainu girl Asirpa. Ainu patterns are embroidered into its blue cloth.

5028.lore: The sword favored by Toshizo Hijikata. It is an absolute masterpiece of a sword that Hijikata has used since his Shinsengumi days. The sword was even kept in a bank safe as a work of art. It is said that Hijikata raided the bank to take back his sword.

5029.lore: A cutting-edge shotgun that Hijikata obtained from a foreign source. It contains up to 14 bullets and can be loaded with one hand, making it ideal for long gunfights. These features make it a very powerful weapon for close-range battles.

5030.lore: The true form of Scissor Blade, a weapon created by Ryuko Matoi's father, Isshin Matoi. By cutting the Life Fiber from each side at the same time, it is possible to seal the strong regenerating power of the Life Fiber.

5031.lore: The pet dog of the Mankanshoku family. It wears a hoodie. He gets along well with Mataro, Mako Mankanshoku's younger brother and they often hang out together. He was named "Guts" because of how he always gorges on food.

5032.lore: One of the weapons that Mako Mankanshoku used when she was the leader of the Fight Club. Also usable as a close combat weapon, this bat shoots powerful missiles from the end that leave a trail of thick smoke wherever they land.

5033.lore: A machine discovered in an ancient ruin. It is controlled from the inside, though practice is needed to effectively wield the induction guns on its arms. Despite its weaponry, it is believed to have been designed for a wide variety of uses like construction.

5034.lore: A war machine discovered in some ruins. A modified version of the Power Suit believed to be specialized for battle. Equipped with remarkable flight ability and powerful artillery, its offensive capability is far beyond its original state. However, this makes controlling it that much more difficult, and those lacking a natural aptitude are unable to handle it at all.

5035.lore: A weapon recovered from a newly discovered ruin. The arrowhead has a unique shape and is made of a strange ore called nanometal. Its unique properties grant it strength far beyond that of a standard arrow.

5036.lore: A vehicle that flies through the air. With its real propulsion device and side attitude control devices, it can be maneuvered in a wide variety of ways. The cannon on the front gives it even greater utility, letting it be used for combat as well for scouting.

5037.lore: A device that allows one to summon the bringer of doom, King Ghidorah. With strength that rivals Godzilla, the mere mention of its forbidden name sends a chill down the spine. It is said to live in another dimension but can appear in other worlds at any time to seal their fate.

5038.lore: This is the Katana made for Rimuru by Kurobei, a Kijin blacksmith. It's highly efficient and even stops Gazel Dwargo's attack who is a dwarf king called a hero. Although Rimuru is learning sword skills under Hakuro, an old Kijin swordmaster also known as a savant, Rimuru's skills are still developing.

5039.lore: The necklace that Milim, also known as "The Destroyer," wears. It is attached to her clothes, so it can also be counted as part of her clothes. Although it is made simple by just putting a string through three colored comma‐shaped beads, Milim's fashion itself is simple, so it seems that this necklace is just her taste.

5040.lore: The clothes that Milim, the oldest Demon Lord, wears. The key point to her clothes is that it is quite revealing. Having both Demon Lord taste and childish tase to it, it suits Milim very well.

5041.lore: The clothes that Benimaru wears. It was made for the battle between the Orc Lord by dwarf blacksmiths and Shuna, a Kijin girl. Hell Moth cocoon and Magicules are woven into the cloth, so it is long lasting and has high protection.

5042.lore: The clothes that Rimuru wears during a fight. It was made by dwarf blacksmiths, Garm and Dord, and a Kijin, Shuna. It contains Magicule, so it is stronger than regular cloth and has high protection.

5043.lore: The mask that Shizue Izawa, a human from a different world and also known as "Conqueror of Flames" wore. After her death, Rimuru who is also a human from the same world of her has been wearing it. It can seal magic powers. Thus, when Rimuru wears it his Magicules are sealed and will not be recognized as a monster.

5044.lore: The katana that Benimaru, a young Kijin, uses. It was made for the battle between the Orc Lord by Kurobei, an excellent blacksmith. Benimaru's sword skills are extremely high since he had been learning sword skills from the swordmaster Hakuro from childhood.

5045.lore: A cheap sword used by Goblin Slayer. It's rather short, but this makes it ideal to use in the narrow caves and holes where goblins live. Not to be sniffed out by the enemies, he never cleans it, and when it becomes unusable due to accumulated blood and flesh, he simply abandons it.

5046.lore: This is the helm Goblin Slayer wears every day. Since he does the maintenance by himself, the broken horns remain unreplaced, and the scratches unbuffed. It hides his face completely, but the gaps allow his baleful red eyes to be seen.

5047.lore: Goblin Slayer uses this dagger to help him in his quests. He often uses it as a throwing weapon. He has dedicated all of his martial training to the slaying of goblins, and they say his blade throwing skills are extraordinary.

5048.lore: Priestess carries this holy staff with her daily. It is topped with the sacred symbol of the Earth Mother, and the staff itself is the same height as Priestess. When she uses her miracles, the gold rings sparkle with holy power.

5049.lore: The sacred garb worn by Priestess. This is the usual robe worn by the devotees of the Earth Mother, adorned with designs fitting a holy servant of the Goddess. After Goblin Slayer recommended it, she began to wear chainmail underneath this robe. Now, she is deeply attached to it.

5050.lore: This is a hat worn by those who dedicate their lives to the Earth Mother. Just like the robe, this hat is protected by divine power and helps defend the holy believer's good works. The design matches the robe, with a clean, simple appearance.

5051.lore: This long-bow of durable wood is used by the High Elf Archer. The Archer herself often says that "Any sufficiently advanced skill is indistinguishable from magic" and her incredibly skilled shooting proves it right, as her arrows seem to move at her command.

5052.lore: The High Elf Archer wears this clothing on her adventures. It is light and well fitted, but it is made from materials that offer good defense in battle. In addition, her mantle hides the obsidian knives sheathed at her hips.

5053.lore: This demon sword was sealed in an ancient ruin. The sword in itself is mediocre, but it is filled with a magic power which allows the wielder to cut only what really has to be cut. An old story even narrates of an adventurer who slew many monsters killing only the evil spirits possessing them, but nobody knows if it is true. However, judging by the mysterious glow of the blade, everyone would believe that the story is true.

5054.lore: The necklace worn by the B-Class Rank-1 Hero, Hellish Blizzard.

5055.lore: The coat worn by the B-Class Rank-1 Hero, Hellish Blizzard.

5056.lore: The dress worn by the B-Class Rank-1 Hero, Hellish Blizzard.

5057.lore: The shuriken of Speed-o'-Sound Sonic. Using this weapon he unleashes his attack "Exploding Shuriken".

5058.lore: The katana of Speed-o'-Sound Sonic. This extremely sharp blade is the weapon that fulfills Sonic's power.

5059.lore: The trademark mask of Speed-o'-Sound Sonic.

5064.lore: The favorite jacket of Ryuko Matoi, a girl who transferred to Honnouji Academy. Not only is it her favorite outfit, but it is also made strong and firm despite not using Life Fibers.

5065.lore: The battle uniform (female ver.) of Nudist Beach, an organization that opposes the threat of Life Fibers. Being a rebel organization, they hardly or never wear any clothes and instead wear this battle uniform and fight to free humans from clothes.

5066.lore: These are the boots of Priestess, who dedicates her life to the Earth Mother. Once saved by Goblin Slayer, she followed his advice and purchased useful equipment. These boots fit her very well, and she takes excellent care of it. These beautiful boots representing her dignity as a priestess tells us how much her and Goblin Slayer are prepared for their adventures.

5067.lore: This is the small shield that a man called Goblin Slayer favored. At first glance, it looks like an ordinary shield, but it is excellent for fighting in small places such as tunnels. It is convenient in areas with obstacles and also to be used as a weapon. Thanks to its high versatility, it is perfect for Goblin Slayer, who likes simple but strong equipment.

5068.lore: The sacred treasure that Naofumi Iwatani, the Shield Hero, received as one of the Four Holy Heroes. It is one of the Legendary Weapons that is passed to Melromarc's protectors. It enhances in proportion to the Hero's level and there are various ways of enhancing its abilities. It is possible to insert materials and recipes into the shield to enhance it further. The shield also has a translator, enabling Naofumi to understand the languages of other worlds.

5069.lore: The sacred treasure that Naofumi Iwatani, the Shield Hero, received as one of the Four Holy Heroes. It is one of the Legendary Weapons that is passed to Melromarc's protectors. It enhances in proportion to the Hero's level and there are various ways of enhancing its abilities. It is possible to insert materials and recipes into the shield to enhance it further. The shield also has a translator, enabling Naofumi to understand the languages of other worlds.

5070.lore: Raphtalia's Sword of choice. She changed to this sword from her knife when she leveled up. She got it at the blacksmith that owed Naofumi Iwatani favors. Made out of magical iron, she has used it to protect Naofumi by slashing any enemy that stands in their way.

5071.lore: Raphtalia's Sword of choice. She changed to this sword from her knife when she leveled up. She got it at the blacksmith that owed Naofumi Iwatani favors. Made out of magical iron, she has used it to protect Naofumi by slashing any enemy that stands in their way.

5072.lore: Raphtalia's bracelet that Naofumi Iwatani made for her. He endowed it with magic-enhancing powers.

5073.lore: Filo's hair accessory that Naofumi Iwatani made for her. He endowed it with speed-increasing powers and chose to make it a hairpin since it was unlikely to fall off when Filo transforms...so he says.

5074.lore: Melty's plain dresswear of choice. Its elegant design perfectly matches the second princess' noble tastes.

5075.lore: A Spirit Realm Beast that uses Yusuke Urameshi's heart as his life force. His cute appearance belies his immeasurable potential. Since Puu's life is linked to his master Yusuke's, changes in Yusuke's condition are also reflected in Puu's body. This helps Puu notice right away when there is danger, so that he can fly straight to his master's side. Puu is greatly influenced by his master's heart, leading him to do things like using barriers to protect his allies from evil Demonic Energy.

5076.lore: A shapeshifting sword given to Kuwabara by the Beautiful Suzuki. At first glance, it just looks like a sword handle, but it was made with a type of plant from the Demon World which grows by absorbing energy from its surroundings, and the handle can take the form of a powerful blade in response to the user's energy and emotions. Kuwabara was afraid of this sword at first, but when he overcame that fear, he obtained a blade of unparalleled strength. However, the user of the blade must pay a dangerous price for its power.

5077.lore: A cut rose that turns into a whip when Kurama imbues it with Demonic Energy. The whip has the lovely fragrance of a rose, and its tip pierces through enemies like a thorn. Kurama can even detect the location of his enemies using the scent coming from the whip. With the way Kurama uses fragrance to control fights and sometimes even manipulates his own hair as a whip, it would not be an exaggeration to say that his striking appearance is just like that of a rose.

5078.lore: The sword used by Hiei, the bandit who acquired the Jagan Eye. Its edge is sharp even without the power of Demonic Energy. When coupled with Hiei's expert sword technique, it can slice through all enemies in an instant. Hiei placed so much trust in this sword that when its blade was broken during a battle, it became a vessel for the Sword of the Darkness Flame using Hiei's fiery Demonic Energy. Hiei's swordsmanship would not be the same without this sword. Although it is unclear who the swordsmith is, this sturdy and streamlined blade is quite apt for the solitary Hiei.

5079.lore: The elder of the two Toguro brothers. He, like his brother, is a Yokai who used to be a human. He has the power to shapeshift, manipulating his body to use it as a weapon, as well as an incredible ability to heal. He sometimes turns his own body into a sword or a shield so that his younger brother can use him to torment their enemies. The perfect synchronization between the two brothers is a result of their many years together, and now that they have become Yokai, their connection is only growing stronger. Of course, the elder Toguro brother is incredibly powerful even when on his own.

5080.lore: An Imperial Army bayonet used by Sugimoto Saichi. While it can be attached to the tip of a rifle, it can also be used as a handheld sword or a regular knife too. This bayonet has survived death many times with Sugimoto, to the point that it could be considered a part of his body.

5081.lore: Asirpa's beloved tashiro, a kind of Ainu hunting knife. It can be used for anything from cooking to crafting tools needed in the mountains. It is incredibly versatile when used with the knowledge of the Ainu people, which has been passed down from generation to generation.

5082.lore: The clothing worn by Toshizo Hijikata of the Shinsengumi during the last days of the Tokugawa shogunate. The Merciless Vice-Commander, as his nickname goes, is sprightly despite his age and wields his sword in these Western-style garments. When Hijikata puts these on, he gives off an incredible air of dignity.

5083.lore: The belt worn by the strongest hero Saitama. The golden buckle shines brightly, even today.

5084.lore: The bodysuit worn by the strongest hero Saitama.

5085.lore: The vest worn by S-Class hero Genos. You can find his name written inside.

5086.lore: The 'Spirit User' Emilia's cloak. There are cat ears on the hood.

5087.lore: The 'Spirit User' Emilia's cloak. There are cat ears on the hood.

5088.lore: The frilly pink ribbons that hold up the twin drills of the Forbidden Library's caretaker. It must take a long time to curl that hair every day.

5089.lore: The frilly pink ribbons that hold up the twin drills of the Forbidden Library's caretaker. It must take a long time to curl that hair every day.

5090.lore: The signature Morningstar for Rem, a maid at the Roswaal Mansion. It can crush someone's body with just one blow.

5091.lore: The signature Morningstar for Rem, a maid at the Roswaal Mansion. It can crush someone's body with just one blow.

5092.lore: The Roswaal Mansion's mop. You can't clean without it. Ram's name is written on it.

5093.lore: The Roswaal Mansion's mop. You can't clean without it. Ram's name is written on it.

5094.lore: Subaru Natsuki's tracksuit. It breathes and is fast to dry while also being quite durable. It makes for an easy wardrobe choice.

5095.lore: Plushies of Rem and Ram. Now they can be together forever.

5096.lore: The pouch that Emilia's friend Puck is never without. It holds more inside it than meets the eye.

5097.lore: A uniform accessory for servants of the Roswaal household. It is sophisticated while not gaudy, featuring delicate decorations.

5098.lore: The uniform centerpiece for servants of the Roswaal household. For some reason, there is a lot of female stock but male uniforms are in scarce supply.

5099.lore: A Christmas outfit prepared by the people of Reigrad for Rimuru. Although it was made to thank Rimuru for defeating the beasts, it was very uncomfortable that the people thought Rimuru was very cute in the outfit.

5100.lore: A Christmas outfit prepared by the people of Reigrad for Milim. She likes how cute the low-cut hem makes her look. Several men approached her with unsavory expressions, but they all came to regret it moments later.

5101.lore: A Christmas outfit prepared by the people of Reigrad for Shion. Although it was made to thank her for helping save the town, it was obviously meant to be more a gift for themselves than her. Regardless, she seemed unaware of their intent and wore it proudly.

5102.lore: Long stockings prepared by the townspeople to match Milim's Santa outfit. Made from magical fabric, they allow her to more easily control her own strength. It was the most thoughtful choice after hearing how many times her unrestrained power has caused problems...

5103.lore: A huge sword carried by Shion. Few can withstand its overwhelming strength. When she offered to slice a fish to help with the Christmas cooking, it seemed she also cut through the table and even left a large dent in the floor...

5104.lore: Cute red boots prepared by the townspeople to match Milim's Santa outfit. Despite how they look, they are sturdy enough to defend against any attack, mostly her own.

5105.lore: Rimuru made this based on past New Year memories after seeing Reigrad's celebration. Though an unfamiliar design in Raktehelm, its dignified look left an impression on the other men. There are even rumors they'll adopt it for future New Year's festivals.

5106.lore: A kimono made by Rimuru to match own New Year's Haori. Its low-cut design lets her move easily, so she likes it quite a lot. This sentiment is shared by the other ladies of Reigrad, starting up a new fashion trend.

5107.lore: A pair of Japanese style shoes made by Rimuru to match own New Year's Haori. They are made of steel with magical power to withstand the power of the rampaging Milim. As a result, they are very heavy, and only Milim can wear them.

5108.lore: Made by Rimuru to restrain Milim's strength. It has a weakening effect to hold her crushing might in check. The equipment used its full potential to keep the city from being destroyed, during the battle in Raktehelm

5109.lore: Rimuru made this based on past New Year memories after seeing Reigrad's celebration. It was originally just an accessory to complete the look with own Haori, but Rimuru truly appreciates its high defensive power and warmth.

5110.lore: A hairpin Rimuru made for Milim to match own New Year's Haori. Though she wasn't comfortable with her new look at first, she soon came around since it was a gift from him.

5111.lore: The favorite vegetable of the electronic diva Hatsune Miku. It won't break after millions of swings, always staying fresh and springy. It doesn't actually exist in her world; she received it from a higher being called The Maestro. In her hands, it moves at a steady tempo like a conductor's baton.

5112.lore: The fashionable headphones of electronic diva Hatsune Miku. They contain the memories of The Maestro. Whenever she gives a performance with her beautiful voice, she always puts on these first.

5113.lore: The costume of electronic diva Hatsune Miku. It draws out her natural charm with its chic, cute design. Made with advanced technology, it lets her create a wide variety of sounds like an instrument from her world. It is said to give any singer who wears it the power to pierce the hearts of all living things with their song. Some believe this is because of an enigmatic feature called "absolute territory" but not even she knows for certain.

5114.lore: A plush doll of Kagamine Rin, a singer with a girlish voice. Although she looks like the spitting image of Kagamine Len, she wears a large, cute ribbon. It was brought to Raktehelm by Hatsune Miku, who supports them both as a senior and as a fan. Cuddling it is believed to melt away exhaustion in an instant, and many also enjoy finding ways to pose it with the matching Len Plushie.

5115.lore: A plush doll of Kagamine Len, a singer with a boyish voice. Although he looks like the spitting image of Kagamine Rin, he sports a cool hairstyle. He has many who enjoy his energetic singing. It was brought to Raktehelm by Hatsune Miku, who has more experience than them but still supports their efforts. In their world, a mere picture can cheer up his fans.

5116.lore: The signature guitar of electronic diva Hatsune Miku. Once belonging to a higher being known as The Maestro, it was converted so she could play it after seeing how she loved its color. The sound when she first played it for The Maestro, while she was still an amateur singer, is still vivid in her memory. It is said that its cheerful, dazzling tones can capture the heart of any who hear it.

5117.lore: Hair accessories worn by Miku when she announced spring's return. There is a special tree in her world that symbolizes the start of the season, and these were designed after the fruit that grows on them. When she puts them on, her hair color changes from her usual blue-green to the cheerful pink of cherry blossoms. Her singing voice can then create warm, refreshing breezes that carry petals far and wide. The day she visited Bamint, they saw spring like they had never seen it before.

5118.lore: The clothes worn by Miku when she saved Bamint from the Giants' winter. While she sang in the capital city, spring flowers began to bloom and bright colors emerged, as if she were unfurling a blanket of warmth all around her. That day, she left her mark on Bamint's history as the Spring-Calling Fairy.

5119.lore: A Curse Series weapon activated by powerful negative emotions in Naofumi Iwatani, one of the Four Cardinal Heroes. It provides excellent offense and defense with its black flames but reduces the Status of its holder in return.

5120.lore: Worn by the Raphtalia, the sword to Shield Hero Naofumi Iwatani. Its high flexibility allows it to keep up with her swift movements in battle.

5121.lore: Worn by Melty, the second princess of Melromarc. They match the refined elegance of her dress.

5122.lore: Worn by Filo when she is in human form, an ability granted by her status as a Filolial Queen. It is sewn with threads made of her own magical power.

5123.lore: The necklace worn by Asakura Yoh, a shaman who links the physical and spiritual worlds. The bear claws are its most distinguishing feature.

5124.lore: A long-handled blade carried by Tao Ren, rival to Asakura Yoh and hopeful Shaman King. It allows him to unleash devastating attacks like the Vorpal Dance.

5125.lore: A blade forged by a swordsmith for his samurai friend long ago. Although the samurai died before he could give it to him, Asakura Yoh helped make his wish come true 600 years later.

5126.lore: The red headphones worn by Asakura Yoh, a shaman who links the physical and spiritual worlds. He uses them to listen to his favorite tunes when he wants to relax.

5127.lore: The spirit beads worn by Kyoyama Anna, the Itako of Osorezan and Asakura Yoh's fiancée.

5128.lore: The red bandana worn by Kyoyama Anna, the Itako of Osorezan and Asakura Yoh's fiancée.

5129.lore: Worn by Hao, the strongest shaman who calls himself the Future King. They are engraved with a star design.

5130.lore: The necklace worn by Asakura Yoh, a shaman who links the physical and spiritual worlds. The bear claws are its most distinguishing feature.

5131.lore: A long-handled blade carried by Tao Ren, rival to Asakura Yoh and Shaman King hopeful. It allows him to unleash devastating attacks like the Vorpal Dance.

5132.lore: One half of two swords modeled after a pair of scissors. It was created to cut Life Fibers as an anti-Goku Uniform weapon. Its wielder, Ryuko Matoi, is in search of the other half's owner.

5133.lore: The favorite sword of Satsuki Kiryuin. For most weapons it is impossible to cut Life Fiber, but not for Bakuzan. This incredible ability is the result of the skill of Satsuki, who can unleash its fullest potential.

5134.lore: The Two-Star Goku Uniform that was given to Mako Mankanshoku, the president of the Fight Club. She was originally considered a No-Star student but unexpectedly revealed battle powers beyond imagination when wearing this Two-Star Goku Uniform.

5135.lore: Ryuko Matoi's Scissor Blade transformed after fully synchronizing with Senketsu for her final clash against Satsuki Kiryuin.

5136.lore: A set of swords reforged from Bakuzan after Ragyo Kiryuin broke it at the Cultural & Sports Grand Festival. Bakuzan-Gako was given to Nonon Jakuzure and Bakuzan-Koryu was given to Ira Gamagoori before passing it to Uzu Sanageyama who was more familiar with swordplay. After Satsuki Kiryuin was rescued from Honnouji Academy, both were returned to her.

5137.lore: Worn by No-Star students of Honnouji Academy like Ryuko Matoi's best friend Mako Mankanshoku. The number of stars determines rank, so they are considered inferior to the One-, Two-, and Three-Star students.

5138.lore: The vehicle used by Ryuko Matoi to retrieve the pieces of Senketsu after Nui Harime tore him up. Going from Kobe, Kyoto, then to Osaka, she finally went to obtain the last part from Satsuki Kiryuin.

5143.lore: The vehicle used by Ryuko Matoi to retrieve the pieces of Senketsu after Nui Harime tore him up. Going from Kobe, to Kyoto, then Osaka, she finally went to obtain the last part from Satsuki Kiryuin.

5144.lore: The weapon chosen by Mako Mankanshoku, a student at Honnouji Academy. When wearing the Fight Club-Spec Two-Star Goku Uniform, she puts this knuckle on her fist to punch her enemies without mercy. Though a simple weapon that merely strengthens her fist's impact, its destructive power is extremely high.

5145.lore: The sentient black sailor uniform created by Ryuko Matoi's father, Isshin Matoi. It is made purely from Life Fiber which mere mortals cannot wear. It awakens and unleashes its power by absorbing Ryuko's blood. Only Ryuko can hear Senketsu's voice.

5146.lore: Another Kamui created by Ryuko Matoi's father, Isshin Matoi. Like Senketsu, it is made only from Life Fiber, which mere mortals cannot wear. The burden for the wearer, Satsuki Kiryuin, is so severe she cannot wear it for long.
