5147.lore: One of the weapons that Mako Mankanshoku used when she was the leader of the Fight Club. Also usable as a close combat weapon, this bat shoots powerful missiles from the end that leave a trail of thick smoke wherever they land.

5148.lore: A present from the Boreas Greyrat family to Rudeus on his tenth birthday. Its name means "prideful water dragon". Specially made out of the finest materials by the best staff-maker in the Asura Kingdom, it greatly enhances the effects of any spell.

5149.lore: One of Eris Boreas Greyrat's favorite outfits.

5150.lore: Worn by Rudeus' childhood friend, the quarter-elf girl Sylphiette.

5151.lore: The hat worn by Roxy, a Migurdian magician skilled in Saint-level water magic.

5152.lore: The hat worn by Roxy, a Migurdian magician skilled in Saint-level water magic.

5153.lore: The weapon favored by Eris, young lady of the Boreas Greyrat family. It was received from Roxy's father at the Migurd village.

5154.lore: The weapon favored by Eris, young lady of the Boreas Greyrat family. It was received from Roxy's father at the Migurd village.

5155.lore: The vest worn by Natsu Dragneel of the wizard guild Fairy Tail.

5156.lore: Worn by Lucy Heartfilia of the wizard guild Fairy Tail.

5157.lore: Belongs to Lucy Heartfilia of the wizard guild Fairy Tail. It opens a Gate to another world that calls forth a celestial spirit, powered by her concern for them.

5158.lore: A sword created by Gray Fullbuster of the wizard guild Fairy Tail. Created with his powerful Ice-Make magic, it strikes with a sharpened sub-zero edge.

5159.lore: Worn by Gray Fullbuster of the wizard guild Fairy Tail.

5160.lore: One of the weapons belonging to Erza Scarlet of the wizard guild Fairy Tail. The wings on the hilt represent its origin as part of the Heaven's Wheel Armor from her "The Knight" magic.

5161.lore: Natsu's friend, a unique cat that walks on two legs. He can speak Human language, but his tongue is sharper than his cute appearance lets on.

5162.lore: A flag emblazoned with the Fairy Tail guild crest. The same mark can be found on the bodies of each member.

5163.lore: The scarf worn by Natsu Dragneel of the wizard guild Fairy Tail. A gift from his foster parent Igneel, he is never seen without it.

5164.lore: The scarf worn by Natsu Dragneel of the wizard guild Fairy Tail. A gift from his foster parent Igneel, he is never seen without it.

5165.lore: The everyday outfit worn by Erza Scarlet of the wizard guild Fairy Tail.

5166.lore: The fashionable headphones of electronic diva Hatsune Miku. They contain the memories of The Maestro. Whenever she gives a performance with her beautiful voice, she always puts on these first.

5167.lore: A plush doll of Kagamine Rin, a singer with a girlish voice. Although she looks like the spitting image of Kagamine Len, she wears a large, cute ribbon. It was brought to Raktehelm by Hatsune Miku, who supports them both as a senior and as a fan. Cuddling it is believed to melt away exhaustion in an instant, and many also enjoy finding ways to pose it with the matching Len Plushie.

5168.lore: The everyday outfit worn by Erza Scarlet of the wizard guild Fairy Tail.

5169.lore: The other Scissor Blade taken by Nui Harime when she attacked Isshin Matoi's lab. Unlike Ryuko's, it is colored purple.

5170.lore: Nui Harime's pink one-piece lolita-style dress. Unlike the Kamui or the Goku Uniforms, it is not made from Life Fiber.

5171.lore: Nui Harime's eyepatch designed after her first name written in Japanese. It is sewn directly onto her face.

5172.lore: The parasol carried by Nui Harime. Its surprising durability once blocked a direct attack from Uzu Sanageyama in his Blade Regalia.

5173.lore: Cute sleepwear Ryuko wore when she spent the night at the Mankanshoku household. She also showed up to Honnouji Academy's No-Late Day in it since she needed to wash Senketsu early that morning.

5174.lore: The glove Aikuro Mikisugi gave to Ryuko that lets her easily feed fresh blood to Senketsu. As it too is part of her Kamui, she needs it to completely activate her Senketsu, she needs it to completely activate her powers.

5175.lore: An anti-Honnouji Academy weapon developed by Nudist Beach with Takarada Conglomerate funding. It can combine with Tsumugu Kinagase's model to form the Ultimate Double Naked DTR.

5176.lore: A weapon created by Houka Inumuta and Shiro Iori nicknamed "QQQQ". It both saves people absorbed by Covers and harms Covers.

5177.lore: The other Scissor Blade taken by Nui Harime when she attacked Isshin Matoi's lab. Unlike Ryuko's, it is colored purple.

5178.lore: The parasol carried by Nui Harime. Its surprising durability once blocked a direct attack from Uzu Sanageyama in his Blade Regalia.

5179.lore: Melty's plain dresswear of choice. Its elegant design perfectly matches the second princess' noble tastes.

5180.lore: Filo's hair accessory that Naofumi Iwatani made for her. He endowed it with speed-increasing powers and chose to make it a hairpin since it was unlikely to fall off when Filo transforms...so he says.

5181.lore: The garb of Fitoria, queen of all the world's Filolials.

5182.lore: The garb of Fitoria, queen of all the world's Filolials.

5183.lore: The footwear of Fitoria, queen of all the world's Filolials.

5184.lore: A shield acquired by one of the Cardinal Heroes, Iwatani Naofumi, using Aero leaves. Its "Foraging Skill 1" ability improves the quality of plant-based materials he obtains.

5185.lore: A headpiece that designates the Filolial Queen successor. When Fitoria placed it upon Filo's head, it made a conspicuous cowlick appear.

5186.lore: The Tokyo Manji Gang's flag. The standard bearer was Pah-chin, one of the founding members.

5187.lore: Originally meant as a birthday present from Mikey's older brother Shinichiro Sano. The unique sound of the exhaust boosts his members' morale and rattles his foes.

5188.lore: A long shirt with a checked pattern. Despite his terrifying reputation, Mikey has a childish side which does things like demand a flag on top of his kid's meal.

5189.lore: What Mikey wore during the brawl with Moebius on August 3rd. He managed to show Peh-yan who had defected the error of his ways.

5190.lore: Mitsuya's motorcycle which he nicknamed "Kitty". He revs the engine with a unique rhythm easily identifiable among the other members.

5191.lore: The earring engraved with a cross pattern Mitsuya wears on his left ear. The way he watches out for Takemichi after he becomes the First Division Captain demonstrates his consideration.

5192.lore: Black clothes with "Tokyo Manji Gang" embroidered in Japanese. Draken gave Takemichi the outfit Mikey wore immediately after it was founded.

5193.lore: A precious accessory that symbolizes Takemichi's feelings for Hinata.

5194.lore: Draken's personally customized motorcycle. He boasts it is the greatest machine in all of Japan.

5195.lore: Draken's usual outfit. He has others like it hanging in his room.

5196.lore: The outfit that Chifuyu, the First Division Vice Captain of Toman, wears to school. He attends a different one from his partner Takemichi.

5197.lore: A weapon Empress created with reconstructed atmospheric Arche.

5198.lore: A Hemiteos Unit high-mobility military support vehicle used by Empress. On-board AI gives it the ability to speak, although bluntly.

5199.lore: Combat gear Empress found in a nearby case when she woke up in the year 2062 AD. It is lightweight and customized for a Hemiteos Unit.

5200.lore: A tactical boomerang with a unique design Dead Master keeps stored in her motorbike. She relies on it when unable to use her sniper rifle.

5201.lore: A Hemiteos Unit high-mobility military support vehicle used by Dead Master.

5202.lore: The outfit Dead Master wears as a Hemiteos Unit. It offers full coverage in contrast to Empress'.

5203.lore: Massive artificial limb weapons worn by Strength. Either fist has enough power to crush a vehicle.

5204.lore: A Hemiteos Unit high-mobility military support vehicle used by Strength.

5205.lore: Worn by Strength as a Hemiteos Unit. Its thickness provides excellent defense for close combat.

5206.lore: Combat gear Empress found in a nearby case when she woke up in the year 2062 AD. It is lightweight and customized for a Hemiteos Unit.

5207.lore: The outfit Emilia wore at the Roswaal Mansion. It is simple yet has an air of refinement.

5208.lore: The clothes Rem wore while growing up in the demon village. It is both cute and easy to move in.

5209.lore: The clothes Ram wore while growing up in the demon village. The color matches her hair, just like her twin sister's.

5210.lore: The miniature headpiece Beatrice always wears. Its elegance suits her graceful bearing.

5211.lore: The gown worn by Beatrice. The abundance of frills and ribbons gives her a doll's charm.

5212.lore: A device Subaru brought from his home world. Although it creates some amusing lights and sounds, it gets no signal.

5213.lore: A device Subaru brought from his home world. Although it creates some amusing lights and sounds, it gets no signal.

5214.lore: Though simple at first glance, using it lets a player instantly change their equipment. *Effect in the world of OVERLORD.

5215.lore: A massive bardiche that gives off a pale green luminescence. Attributes besides its high attack power are unknown.

5216.lore: A Divine Class item that uses three layers of protection to cover the entire body. Incredibly resistant to physical blows.

5217.lore: A pure white dress with an elaborate design and open sleeves. It accents her beautiful curves.

5218.lore: A gothic-styled umbrella in purple with red lines. Shalltear carries it everywhere, mostly to protect her from the sun rather than as a weapon.

5219.lore: A Divine Class item. Its syringe design lets it absorb X% of damage dealt to recover the user's health. *Effect in the world of OVERLORD.

5220.lore: A violet ballroom gown. The billowing skirt and ribbons add volume to Shalltear's figure.

5221.lore: Though simple at first glance, using it lets a player instantly change their equipment. *Effect in the world of OVERLORD.

5222.lore: The guild weapon created by the members of Ainz Ooal Gown. Although a Divine Class item, its status as guild weapon means it holds far more data than anything else in its level.

5223.lore: A ring that allows the wearer to cast the Super-tier spell "Wish Upon a Star". Due to the incredible power and the near-instantaneous effect, it was considered one of the best cash items. *Effect in the world of OVERLORD.

5224.lore: A magnificent robe of black and violet, lined with gold. Like everything else Ainz has equipped, it is a Divine Class item.

5225.lore: Appears at first glance to be a plain timepiece. Using it allows the instant casting of a Super-tier spell.

5226.lore: A staff with a unique shape, silver at the center and coated with gold. Although equipped by Narberal, she does not use it often.

5227.lore: A white hairpiece worn by Narberal to tie her ponytail. It produces an air of grace and refinement.

5228.lore: A combat outfit lined with silver armor she wears when preparing for serious conflict as a member of Pleiades.

5229.lore: A limited-time item given to players who played Yggdrasil for over two hours on Christmas Eve. Its red color gives the impression of anger rather than jealousy.

5230.lore: A limited-time item given to players who played Yggdrasil for over two hours on Christmas Eve. Its red color gives the impression of anger rather than jealousy.

5231.lore: The clothes that Rimuru wears during a fight. It was made by dwarf blacksmiths, Garm and Dord, and a Kijin, Shuna. It contains Magicule, so it is stronger than regular cloth and has high protection.

5232.lore: The mask that Shizue Izawa, a human from a different world and also known as "Conqueror of Flames" wore. After her death, Rimuru who is also a human from the same world of her has been wearing it. It can seal magic powers. Thus, when Rimuru wears it his Magicules are sealed and will not be recognized as a monster.

5233.lore: A huge sword carried by Shion. Few can withstand its overwhelming strength. When she offered to slice a fish to help with the Christmas cooking, it seemed she also cut through the table and even left a large dent in the floor...

5234.lore: Rimuru made this based on past New Year memories after seeing Reigrad's celebration. It was originally just an accessory to complete the look with own Haori, but Rimuru truly appreciates its high defensive power and warmth.

5235.lore: When Illya Installs the Saber Class Card, the Heroic Spirit of King Arthur gives her this special outfit.

5236.lore: A Mystic Code named after its creator, the Wizard Marshal Zelretch. The blade is a massive crystal instead of sharpened metal, making it more of a staff than a sword.

5237.lore: A tight-fitting turtleneck sweater, mini-skirt, and knee-high socks.

5238.lore: The outfit Illya wears when she transforms into a magical girl. According to Magical Ruby, she gains Magic Barrier, Physical Defense, Healing Factor, and Enhanced Physical Ability and other A-rank passives.

5243.lore: A Kaleidostick, one of the highest level Mystic Codes. She supplies endless power to whoever forms a magical girl contract with her, and she also has the miraculous ability to make whatever that can be imagined reality. She was created along with Magical Ruby.

5244.lore: A shield used by the hero Aias in the Trojan War from Greek mythology. Seven petals of light protect the holder. Shirou can use it with the Archer Class Card.

5245.lore: A Kaleidostick, one of the highest level Mystic Codes. She supplies endless power to whoever forms a magical girl contract with her, and she also has the miraculous ability to make whatever that can be imagined reality. She was created along with Magical Ruby.

5246.lore: A legendary spear used by Cú Chulainn, a hero from Celt mythology. Miyu can also wield it when she Installs the Lancer Class Card.

5247.lore: The outfit Miyu wears when she Installs the Rider Class Card, based on Medusa from Greek mythology. She can also summon Pegasus as it was born from the Gorgon's blood.

5248.lore: A shield used by the hero Aias in the Trojan War from Greek mythology. Seven petals of light protect the holder. Shirou can use it with the Archer Class Card.

5249.lore: A simple but smart t-shirt and hoodie combination.

5250.lore: The outfit Miyu wears when she transforms into a magical girl. She gains constant Magic Barrier, Physical Defense, Healing Factor, and Enhanced Physical Ability and other A-rank passives.

5251.lore: A famed pair of swords created in ancient China. Chloe can use them when she Installs the Archer Class Card.

5252.lore: The strongest of holy swords made famous in the legend of King Arthur, said to have been received from Fairies. This version was created by a Class Card for Saber Alter, boasting immense power and range.

5253.lore: A famed pair of swords created in ancient China. Chloe can use them when she Installs the Archer Class Card.

5254.lore: The weapon wielded by Heracles, a famed hero from Greek mythology. The name represents his sheer vigor and force of will.

5255.lore: The magical girl costume of Chloe (but more like her original clothes since it was what she wore when she first appeared).

5256.lore: The strongest of holy swords made famous in the legend of King Arthur, said to have been received from Fairies. This version was created by a Class Card for Saber Alter, boasting immense power and range.

5257.lore: Worn by the legendary King Arthur Pendragon, known throughout all of England. This particular version belongs to the Class Card Heroic Spirit.

5258.lore: A magical sword from Celtic mythology. Its name means "lightning". With the power of the Archer Class Card, Chloe can create modified copies of it to shoot like arrows.

5263.lore: A specially woven cloth that stretches from nose to chest. It not only hides his face but filters out smoke and dust.

5264.lore: A specially woven cloth that stretches from nose to chest. It not only hides his face but filters out smoke and dust.

5265.lore: The standard outfit for ninja, a combination of billowing sleeves and fastened legs.

5266.lore: Footwear worn by Iwagakure Village ninja.

5267.lore: A warrior's weapon is their very soul, and this tenet also applies to the Yamada Asaemon. The edge is always kept sharp enough to decapitate with a single slice.

5268.lore: Ceremonial clothes worn by Yamada Asaemon members when performing an execution. The white color represents mourning for the criminal.

5269.lore: A covering that extends from the back of the hand to the elbow to protect from cold and the grime of battle. Sagiri only wears one over her left arm.

5270.lore: In Japan's Edo period, women used these to tie up their hair. Men would also do the same, but with a string made of paper.

5271.lore: Small ninja daggers Yuzuriha carries on her arms. Although mainly meant for throwing, they have other uses like digging or climbing.

5272.lore: Yuzuriha's hairpin, decorated with a large pink bead.

5273.lore: Small bamboo containers Yuzuriha carries at her waist. They contain snake venom and other dangerous liquids. She can also drink small amounts to use with her ninpo.

5274.lore: The standard field work outfit worn by ninja. Yuzuriha's reveals more skin than usual.

5275.lore: The weapon taken from one of the Shinsenkyo monsters, a soshin, Chobe personally killed. According to him, their own weapons are most effective against them.

5276.lore: The garb of a monk Chobe wears in his own style. It is unclear where he found it.

5277.lore: A string of prayer beads Chobe wears around his neck.

5278.lore: A string of prayer beads Chobe wears around his neck.

5279.lore: This is the Katana made for Rimuru by Kurobei, a Kijin blacksmith. It's highly efficient and even stops Gazel Dwargo's attack who is a dwarf king called a hero. Although Rimuru is learning sword skills under Hakuro, an old Kijin swordmaster also known as a savant, Rimuru's skills are still developing.

5280.lore: The necklace that Milim, also known as "The Destroyer," wears. It is attached to her clothes, so it can also be counted as part of her clothes. Although it is made simple by just putting a string through three colored comma‐shaped beads, Milim's fashion itself is simple, so it seems that this necklace is just her taste.

5281.lore: The katana that Benimaru, a young Kijin, uses. It was made for the battle between the Orc Lord by Kurobei, an excellent blacksmith. Benimaru's sword skills are extremely high since he had been learning sword skills from the swordmaster Hakuro from childhood.

5282.lore: A Christmas outfit prepared by the people of Reigrad for Rimuru. Although it was made to thank Rimuru for defeating the beasts, it was very uncomfortable that the people thought Rimuru was very cute in the outfit.

5283.lore: A Christmas outfit prepared by the people of Reigrad for Milim. She likes how cute the low-cut hem makes her look. Several men approached her with unsavory expressions, but they all came to regret it moments later.

5284.lore: A Christmas outfit prepared by the people of Reigrad for Shion. Although it was made to thank her for helping save the town, it was obviously meant to be more a gift for themselves than her. Regardless, she seemed unaware of their intent and wore it proudly.

5285.lore: Rimuru made this based on past New Year memories after seeing Reigrad's celebration. Though an unfamiliar design in Raktehelm, its dignified look left an impression on the other men. There are even rumors they'll adopt it for future New Year's festivals.

5286.lore: A kimono made by Rimuru to match own New Year's Haori. Its low-cut design lets her move easily, so she likes it quite a lot. This sentiment is shared by the other ladies of Reigrad, starting up a new fashion trend.

5287.lore: The coat worn by Rimuru Tempest after becoming a Demon Lord. The transformation itself did not change Rimuru's clothes; this was chosen as more fitting for the Walpurgis Banquet.

5288.lore: Protective gear worn by the Demon Lord Milim Nava in her combat form. She also used it in her battle against Beast Master Carrion, whose Beast Roar attack could not even scratch it.

5289.lore: The butler's outfit worn by Diablo. When Rimuru named him, it transformed into its current look.

5290.lore: The coat worn by Rimuru Tempest after becoming a Demon Lord. The transformation itself did not change Rimuru's clothes; this was chosen as more fitting for the Walpurgis Banquet.

5291.lore: Protective gear worn by the Demon Lord Milim Nava in her combat form. She also used it in her battle against Beast Master Carrion, whose Beast Roar attack could not even scratch it.

5292.lore: The butler's outfit worn by Diablo. When Rimuru named him, it transformed into its current look.

5293.lore: The weapon used by the Destroyer, Demon Lord Milim Nava, when she transforms into combat mode. Having slain majins and even other Demon Lords, it is truly legendary.

5294.lore: A weapon of Soei, secret agent for Demon Lord Rimuru. Similar to a Japanese-style sword, he uses a pair of these to behead any who dares speak ill of his master.

5295.lore: The weapon wielded by Hakuro, known as the Sword Oni. He trained many with it, including Demon Lord Rimuru. The simple design gives it the appearance of a staff when sheathed.

5296.lore: A large knife wielded by Vorpal Bunnies, rare enemies that appear near Firstia. They seldomly drop but deal extra critical damage in the VR game "Shangri-La Frontier".

5297.lore: A large knife wielded by Vorpal Bunnies, rare enemies that appear near Firstia. They seldomly drop but deal extra critical damage in the VR game "Shangri-La Frontier".

5298.lore: A collar that draws out the wearer's Vorpal Soul in the VR game "Shangri-La Frontier". Although it halves experience gain, the stat boosts from leveling are increased by 2.5. It is only available in a Unique Scenario and cannot be removed until the king of the Vorpal Bunnies permits it.

5299.lore: The main weapon of Psyger-0, known for her "Attack Master" title. As intimidating as it is powerful, it can only be obtained from a special quest. The black color contrasts with her white armor, establishing her signature look.

5300.lore: The head portion of Psyger-0's full-plate armor. The entire ensemble, also called the "Two-Faced Mail", can only be obtained from a specific quest. The majestic ivory sheen pairs well with her dangerous black sword.

5301.lore: Paired earrings worn by Arthur Pencilgon, the vice-captain of notorious PK clan Asura Kai. They dance gracefully along with her movements.

5302.lore: Paired earrings worn by Arthur Pencilgon, the vice-captain of notorious PK clan Asura Kai. They dance gracefully along with her movements.

5303.lore: The main weapon of Arthur Pencilgon, the vice-captain of notorious PK clan Asura Kai. Its tip is as sharp as her gaze.

5304.lore: Worn by OiKatzo in the VR game "Shangri-La Frontier". The system treats them not as items but part of his outfit. This not only means he fights unarmed, but also that they aren't damaged by enemy attacks or his own aura flames.

5305.lore: The outfit worn by OiKatzo. This along with the "Acolyte's Sash" are locked to his main job of Monk.

5306.lore: A massive blade belonging to Adamantite-rank adventurer Momon. His strength is so great, he can wield two at once.

5307.lore: Full-body protection for the Adamantite-rank adventurer Momon. It was magically formed by Ainz Ooal Gown's "Create Greater Item" spell.

5308.lore: Bracers worn by the Adamantite-rank adventurer Momon. They hide Ainz Ooal Gown's hands of bone.

5309.lore: A red cape for the Adamantite-rank adventurer Momon. Although it appears to be magical, its true properties are unknown.

5310.lore: Black footgear worn by the Adamantite-rank adventurer Momon. Their name gives the impression they increase movement, but the actual effect is unclear.

5311.lore: The usual attire of Demiurge, Guardian of Nazarick's seventh level. It bears his characteristic striped orange design.

5312.lore: Frames worn by the cunning Demiurge, a Guardian in the Great Tomb of Nazarick. They fit his intelligence.

5313.lore: Worn by the cunning Demiurge, a Guardian in the Great Tomb of Nazarick. They are probably made of leather.

5314.lore: A deep-red hooded cloak worn by Evileye. It is believed to be one of the treasures of the fallen kingdom of Inveria.

5315.lore: What Evileye often wears to hide her face. It is said the red jewel in the center is one of the treasures of Inveria, a bygone kingdom.

5516.lore: A simple black dress and white apron. Combined with her hat, it embodies the ideal concept of an ordinary magician.

5517.lore: The longer katana of the half-phantom gardener. Forged by yokai, it possesses incredible cutting power. A single swing can supposedly kill ten phantoms.

5518.lore: The folding fan of Hakugyokurou's mistress. Dyed in an eye-catching lilac hue, the graceful dances as she holds it change her image from calm to majestic and charismatic.

5519.lore: The shorter katana of the half-phantom gardener. It has the power to cut confusion, letting phantoms pass on to the heavenly realm.

5520.lore: The longer katana of the half-phantom gardener. Forged by yokai, it possesses incredible cutting power. A single swing can supposedly kill ten phantoms.

5521.lore: A turquoise vest and skirt over a white shirt worn by the half-phantom swordswoman. There is a spirit mark over the left side of her chest. She does not find spirits frightening, but ghosts are.

5522.lore: Worn by the half-phantom swordswoman. Its black color gives her a sharp look that suits her attitude. The ribbon adds a touch of charm.

5523.lore: The folding fan of Hakugyokurou's mistress. Dyed in an eye-catching lilac hue, the graceful dances as she holds it change her image from calm to majestic and charismatic.

5524.lore: The outfit of Hakugyokurou's mistress. The blend of styles gives it a dress-like appearance. The wispy impression is helped by its billowy sky-blue sleeves.

5525.lore: The headdress of Hakugyokurou's mistress. Its ruffled brim gives it the appearance of a nightcap. The triangular band indicates her status as a ghost.

5526.lore: Based on the younger of the vampire sisters in the Scarlet Devil Mansion. The simplified detail still shows her innocence and danger.

5527.lore: Based on the older of the vampire sisters in the Scarlet Devil Mansion. The simplified detail still shows her arrogance and extravagance.

5528.lore: Based on the head maid of the Scarlet Devil Mansion. The simplified detail still shows her elegance and coolness.

5529.lore: A rabbit-eared top hat for the Bounding Bunny Bash with ears crafted to sway realistically in the wind. Rimuru was somewhat against them, but they looked so good on the Demon Lord that no one could understand why.

5530.lore: The attached rabbit ears are made from a soft, flexible material and move like real ears such as Zephyr's.

5531.lore: A rabbit-eared top hat for the Bounding Bunny Bash with ears crafted to sway realistically in the wind. Rimuru was somewhat against them, but they looked so good on the Demon Lord that no one could understand why.

5532.lore: A white and blue uniform for the Bounding Bunny Bash. The fringe where the cape attaches to the shoulders shows the intricacies of Falfanian style along with the choice fabric.

5533.lore: White footwear made for jumping in the Bounding Bunny Bash. The fur along the ankles helps cushion impact, but it was originally added as a cute decoration.

5534.lore: Drawn with a likeness of Rimuru's slime form by the BBB's head organizer. Milim is particularly fond of the design, ensuring it will never leave her possession.

5535.lore: The attached rabbit ears are made from a soft, flexible material and move like real ears such as Zephyr's.

5536.lore: The pink fur and plethora of frills met her standards for the ultimate in cuteness, but the price was apparently rather high.

5537.lore: One thigh-high stocking with pink and white stripes, a heart-adorned garter belt, and a fluffy pair of boots. They were tough enough to withstand her mountain-surpassing leaps, making the mountain seem weaker in comparison.

5538.lore: Awarded for outstanding performance in the Bounding Bunny Bash. The accessory shaped like slime-form Rimuru adds a cute touch. Naturally, Milim claimed ownership at first opportunity.

5539.lore: An egg painted in the colors of Benimaru, Shuna, Shion, and Soei. Whether or not Shion's hue appears poisonous depends on the viewer.

5540.lore: A present for Rimuru from the BBB's head organizer. It contains dolls resembling Rimuru's group. Veldora's is noticeably larger than the rest, protruding from the package in an amusing fashion.

5541.lore: Obtained after defeating the Demon Monarch Baran, one of Jinwoo's most devastating weapons. Imbued with an intimidating aura, he uses it to unleash a flurry of attacks in the blink of an eye.

5542.lore: A lightweight blade with a pointed tip. Made to be held in one hand, it still boasts phenomenal sharpness. She uses it to live up to her reputation as the Dancer by performing incredible feats with grace.

5543.lore: Obtained after defeating the Demon Monarch Baran, an unusually long weapon in the arsenal of dagger-wielding Jinwoo. With girth and aura befitting an overlord, it can cause massive destruction.

5544.lore: Obtained after defeating the Demon Monarch Baran, one of Jinwoo's most devastating weapons. Imbued with an intimidating aura, he uses it to unleash a flurry of attacks in the blink of an eye.

5545.lore: A stylish but unassuming outfit to help him lay low. Far from eye-catching, they no less embody his desire to seek greater power.

5546.lore: A dagger obtained when Jinwoo defeated the Blue Venom-Fanged Kasaka by breaking through its tough scales. In addition to high attack power, it possesses paralysis and drain effects.

5547.lore: A dagger Jinwoo purchased from the system's shop. It inflicts additional damage to armored magic beasts.

5548.lore: Armored gloves that protect her hands from enemy attacks. The unique curves allow her to smoothly handle her sword.

5549.lore: A lightweight blade with a pointed tip. Made to be held in one hand, it still boasts phenomenal sharpness. She uses it to live up to her reputation as the Dancer by performing incredible feats with grace.

5550.lore: Red protective gear modeled after a knight's. Covering the shoulders, shins, and forearms, it defends while permitting her to exhibit the full might of her swordplay.

5551.lore: A flowing cape in a mature, calming burgundy. The golden shoulder guards protect and grant an impactful weight. As there are no sleeves, he has full range of movement to cast whatever spell he needs.

5552.lore: A sword nearly as long as he is tall. Only one of his talent can handle its heft. How it shares his blue and black color scheme shows that he and it have become one.

5553.lore: His signature black-rimmed spectacles. They both match his suit and give him an air of intelligence.

5554.lore: The outfit he wears into battle. Unlike his violet business suit, this one is in brilliant white to reflect his prestigious title as the ultimate weapon.

5555.lore: A flowing cape in a mature, calming burgundy. The golden shoulder guards protect and grant an impactful weight. As there are no sleeves, he has full range of movement to cast whatever spell he needs.

5556.lore: A sword nearly as long as he is tall. Only one of his talent can handle its heft. How it shares his blue and black color scheme shows that he and it have become one.

5557.lore: Highly protective layers of metal that perfectly cover the body. Even if an attack lands, he can withstand it effortlessly. The deep red hair-like decoration on the helmet was the origin of his title before he became a shadow.

5558.lore: A ponderous weapon held in his right hand. One side has a sharp edge and the other forms a hammerhead. This ability to both slash and crush with a single implement is suitable for one of his might.

5559.lore: A barrier he holds in his left hand. Large enough to cover half of his body, it absorbs nearly any attack. It symbolizes his status as a defensive keystone.

5560.lore: A powerful potion that can heal any illness. Jinwoo fought against high-ranked demons for the sake of obtaining the materials for it and curing his mother's Eternal Slumber condition.

5561.lore: A dagger Jinwoo purchased from the system's shop. It inflicts additional damage to armored magic beasts.

5562.lore: A barrier he holds in his left hand. Large enough to cover half of his body, it absorbs nearly any attack. It symbolizes his status as a defensive keystone.

5563.lore: A treasure handed down the Astrea family line linked to the Sword Saint. Only those with the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint can wield it, and the sword itself must also recognize the opponent as requiring its might before being unsheathed.

5564.lore: An artistic weapon Emilia created on Subaru's suggestion. It is shaped by her powerful ice magic and imagination to provide a variety of uses.

5565.lore: A treasure handed down the Astrea family line linked to the Sword Saint. Only those with the Divine Protection of the Sword Saint can wield it, and the sword itself must also recognize the opponent as requiring its might before being unsheathed.

5566.lore: Given to only the best of the best in the Imperial Knights of Lugunica. They always wear it while on duty.

5567.lore: An artistic weapon Emilia created on Subaru's suggestion. It is shaped by her powerful ice magic and imagination to provide a variety of uses.

5568.lore: What Subaru imagined when daydreaming about his future with her. The pure white color makes her beautiful enough to freeze one's breath in their lungs.

5569.lore: Resembles the great cat spirit which protects Emilia as her guardian. Life-sized but will not get mad at being touched like the real thing.

5570.lore: Subaru named it "Guiltywhip". He practiced whip techniques to make more tricks and tactics available to him, a survival strategy that he polished after careful consideration of how he can fight.

5571.lore: The Morningstar she wields. It reacts to the demonified Rem's power, magnifying its terrible destructive might. Specialized for offense, she can swing the spiked ball to strike within the chain's reach whether close or mid-range.

5572.lore: As black as funeral clothes. It matches with Echidna's white hair to create a charming contrast that accentuates her beauty.

5573.lore: The Morningstar she wields. It reacts to the demonified Rem's power, magnifying its terrible destructive might. Specialized for offense, she can swing the spiked ball to strike within the chain's reach whether close or mid-range.

5574.lore: What she uses as a weapon when casting magic. It is compatible with her style and sharpens precision.

5575.lore: What Echidna offered Subaru during her tea party in the Sanctuary. It was made from her own body fluids, but he was not told that until after gulping it down. His reaction was predictably agitated.

5576.lore: As black as funeral clothes. It matches with Echidna's white hair to create a charming contrast that accentuates her beauty.

5577.lore: Instructed her on what to do by telling the future. It eventually stopped updating, the final pages left blank.

5578.lore: The clerical outfit of Petelgeuse Romaneeconti, the Sin Archbishop in the Witch Cult representing Sloth. Although nearly identical to the standard robes, it seems to augment his wicked aura.

5579.lore: The original Crest Blade, said to cut through matter, time, space, and consequence. Unable to grasp its overwhelming might, she uses it simply to defend those dear to her.

5580.lore: The Magistone scepter of God princess Liza. It lent power to her by fusing with Magical Sapphire to make Mercurius Sapphire.

5581.lore: The original Crest Blade, said to cut through matter, time, space, and consequence. Unable to grasp its overwhelming might, she uses it simply to defend those dear to her.

5582.lore: The Imperial Sword of Coruscation said to have been received from the Gods. Soon after arriving in the world of Raktehelm, she immediately called upon it to protect Miyu.

5583.lore: The Imperial Sword of Conquest with an immense effect against Demons. When fighting against one of great size, Liza suggested she use it from among her various weapons.

5584.lore: The Imperial Sword of Command, the only one that felt slightly cold in Illya's hand. She has yet to tell anyone of this.

5585.lore: An outfit resembling the omnipotent Emperor Isliid she gained after Installing. The dignified figure of the man who once reigned over the world's largest nation is no less reflected in her slight body.

5586.lore: The Magistone scepter of God princess Liza. It lent power to her by fusing with Magical Sapphire to make Mercurius Sapphire.

5587.lore: The outfit of the Starstream Witch Liza she gained after Installing. Although not from this world, the similar styling suits her perfectly.

5588.lore: An enhanced magic wand formed by the combination of Magical Ruby and Magical Sapphire. When the power of one is not enough, the bonds of two will make things possible.

5589.lore: Templar Captain Vox's katana involuntarily recreated via Tracing. Though not as keen as the original, it is incredibly sharp. When she fights with her full strength, it shifts into Overedge state.

5590.lore: An imitation of a weapon from Celtic mythology created with Shirou's expert projection magecraft. It is inferior to the original yet no less capable of destroying other Heroic Spirits.

5591.lore: Templar Captain Vox's katana involuntarily recreated via Tracing. Though not as keen as the original, it is incredibly sharp. When she fights with her full strength, it shifts into Overedge state.

5592.lore: An outfit Chloe was forced to wear based on the Demon Templar Captain Vox. Although more formal than her usual outfit, she wore it rather well.

5593.lore: What he wears after leaving behind his human nature. He was supposed to have protected mankind, but now he only fights for the sake of his sister.

5594.lore: An imitation of a weapon from Celtic mythology created with Shirou's expert projection magecraft. It is inferior to the original yet no less capable of destroying other Heroic Spirits.

5595.lore: The Noble Phantasm of Medusa, a monster from Greek mythology. It controls a winged horse as it charges through the battlefield like a gale.

5596.lore: The Noble Phantasm of Gilgamesh, said to have once constrained the Bull of Heaven. It can suppress any sort of resistance to ensnare the target.

5597.lore: The simple red design speaks of his own approach in fighting for his ideals.

5601.lore: The Cleaners' uniform issued to Rudo.

5602.lore: A mask that keeps out the pollutants in the contaminated air of the "Forbidden Zone". Without it, a person dies in about 15 minutes.

5604.lore: The Cleaners' uniform Enjin wears. Long-coat type.

5605.lore: A mask that keeps out the pollutants in the contaminated air of the "Forbidden Zone". Without it, a person dies in about 15 minutes.

5606.lore: Zanka's Vital Instrument. Just a stick. But Zanka knows his Vital Instrument inside out, so he can use it in intricate ways.

5607.lore: Riyo's Vital Instrument. A pair of haircutting scissors that grows as tall as she is in battle. Riyo wields it freely with her feet.

5608.lore: Zanka's Vital Instrument. Just a stick. But Zanka knows his Vital Instrument inside out, so he can use it in intricate ways.

5609.lore: The Cleaners' uniform Zanka wears, adapted to the traditional dress of his hometown.

5610.lore: A mask that keeps out the pollutants in the contaminated air of the "Forbidden Zone". Without it, a person dies in about 15 minutes.

5611.lore: Riyo's Vital Instrument. A pair of haircutting scissors that grows as tall as she is in battle. Riyo wields it freely with her feet.

5612.lore: The Cleaners' uniform Riyo wears. It bares her midriff and shows a lot of skin.
